title: Agentic Platform Engineer (gn) @ AI Venture, Berlin
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

AI models have moved faster than most companies’ ability to put them to work. The capabilities are there; knowing how to combine them effectively is still catching up.

Frontier labs naturally put their own models first. Companies often follow suit, asking one general-purpose model to handle ten very different jobs. We believe there is far more to unlock in the models that already exist, even before the next generation arrives. That is the opportunity we are building around.

We bring closed providers and open-weight models together behind a single API. Our engine breaks requests into their component parts, routes each to the right model within a cost budget, fine-tunes on customer data and checks the result against agreed quality standards. With no proprietary model to promote, we can choose the right combination for the task.

Lower costs matter because of what they make possible: giving a small team the freedom to build something that would previously have required a much larger one.

Our founder brings considerable drive, a hands-on approach and a strong sense of urgency to building the company. Backed by Atlantic at pre-seed, we are growing the engineering team to bring the product into production, with people already waiting to use it.

About the Role

As one of our first platform engineers, you will build the foundations that every product feature depends on: the gateway and router, usage and billing systems, customer key management and the European infrastructure underneath.

Much of that platform is still taking shape. Working directly with the founder, CTO and founding AI engineer, you will help turn early architectural decisions into systems that remain reliable as the product grows.

You will take capabilities from design through to production, thinking through their APIs, failure modes, deployment, observability and ongoing operation. In a team this small, building and running the system belong together. You will also work alongside our founding AI engineer on evals, embeddings and open-weight model serving, bringing platform engineering depth to the ML side of the product.

Agentic engineering is central to how we work. You will operate in an agentic way by default, using coding agents as a core part of how you design, build, test and ship software. You'll develop the harnesses and workflows that allow you to delegate and parallelise work effectively, increasing what a small engineering team can deliver. This requires strong coding fundamentals and the judgement to review, challenge and take responsibility for everything that reaches production.

There is a lot to build and an ambitious timeline ahead. We work with intensity, move quickly from decisions to execution and value people who take initiative and see things through.

What You’ll Work On

Your first area of ownership will depend on your strengths and our priorities. From there, you will contribute across the platform as it develops.

  • Gateway and routing: build a consistent API across model providers, with reliable streaming, fallbacks and safe handling of retries and provider errors.

  • Agentic engineering workflows: build and refine the harnesses, tooling and workflows that enable coding agents to work effectively across the development lifecycle, from implementation and testing to debugging and deployment.

  • Cost optimisation: develop caching, history compression and model selection, measuring savings while keeping estimated costs distinct from actual spend.

  • Usage and billing: build accurate accounting for model calls, usage reports, plan entitlements and invoice reconciliation.

  • Agent infrastructure and integrations: support tool calls, cost limits, human approvals and runs that can recover safely from interruptions, alongside connectors for services such as Gmail, Slack and calendars.

  • Tenancy and secrets: maintain workspace isolation, secure authentication and encrypted customer key management.

  • European infrastructure and model serving: build and operate our cloud infrastructure, including the GPU capacity used to serve open-weight models.

  • Production reliability: make systems observable, migrations reversible and releases safe, with tests that protect data integrity and logs that keep customer content and secrets private.

The platform will evolve quickly. You will need to move comfortably between improving what exists and learning enough about a new problem to build the next piece well.

Our Stack

Our backend is built in Python, with a TypeScript frontend in a shared monorepo.

  • Backend: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic and LiteLLM.

  • Data and queues: Postgres with row-level security and pgvector, Redis and arq.

  • Frontend: Next.js, React and TypeScript.

  • Cloud and infrastructure: Scaleway, Terraform and Kubernetes for GPU workloads.

  • Auth and secrets: Zitadel, Secret Manager and KMS.

  • Observability and testing: OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, Sentry, pytest and testcontainers, alongside frontend testing tools.

You should be comfortable with the core backend technologies and ready to learn the rest as the work requires.

About You

You enjoy the craft of engineering and the responsibility of seeing your work used in production. Faced with an unclear problem, you can identify what matters, make sensible trade-offs and carry a solution through to release without someone planning every step. You naturally look for ways to multiply your output through agentic workflows, rather than approaching every engineering task as something to execute manually.

We are looking for:

  • Experience building and operating production systems: several years of backend engineering with real users, typically three to six, and meaningful ownership of what you shipped.

  • Strong Python fundamentals: confidence with async code, typing and testing. TypeScript experience is a plus.

  • Agentic engineering as a default way of working: you have hands-on experience using coding agents as a core part of your engineering workflow. You know how to break down problems, delegate and parallelise tasks, provide the right context and build effective agentic workflows. Crucially, you have the technical depth to review, debug and take ownership of the resulting code.

  • Platform engineering depth: practical experience with Postgres, Redis, queues, networking and Terraform. Kubernetes experience is useful, particularly for our GPU infrastructure.

  • Sound engineering judgement: clear APIs, tenant isolation, data integrity, partial failure and safe rollouts. You can explain both your decisions and what you chose to leave out.

  • A working understanding of ML systems: familiarity with LLMs, embeddings, evals, model serving and fine-tuning. Experience with LLM APIs, streaming and token costs is a strong plus.

  • A disciplined approach to measurement: you benchmark changes, question assumptions and use evidence to understand whether an improvement holds up.

  • Initiative and drive: you enjoy getting deep into a problem, finding a way forward and putting in the work to make it happen.

  • This is an experienced individual-contributor role, with ownership of the capabilities you build and close collaboration across the founding team.

  • Fluent English is required; German is a plus.

Why Join

At this stage, platform engineering decisions have a direct influence on the product and how quickly the team can build it. You will work close to the founder and CTO, with room to shape the systems you own and see the results of your work first-hand.

The challenge spans AI infrastructure, distributed systems, security and cost efficiency. You will build across those boundaries, take real responsibility early and receive a meaningful equity package in the company you help develop.

We are competing with teams that have more people, more funding and an earlier start. Our approach depends on technical depth, focused decisions and the drive to turn them into working software. We believe agentic engineering can fundamentally change what a small, technically strong team is capable of building, and we're looking for people who want to push that approach forward. For someone who enjoys a demanding build, close collaboration and visible impact, there is a lot to get involved in.

This is a full-time role, based in our Berlin office five days a week, starting as soon as possible.

description:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to join bunch’s Reporting team. You’ll own the products and workflows that turn fund and portfolio data into correct, trusted reporting that’s ready to send to investors.

You’ll work at the heart of how fund managers communicate performance and activity to their investors. That means building intuitive reporting experiences and report-generation capabilities customers can trust.

As Senior Product Manager, Reporting Platform, you will:

  • Own key parts of our reporting product and its workflows end-to-end

  • Make sure the numbers investors see are right, from the data fund managers enter, through the calculations, to the final reports and the LP portal

  • Drive product decisions that balance accuracy, compliance and usability

  • Partner closely with engineering, design and operations to deliver a system customers can rely on

This role focuses on the Reporting side of the platform. Typical areas include:

  • Portfolio data capture: how fund managers record investments, valuations and portfolio events like follow-ons, conversions and exits, with a strong focus on intuitive UI/UX, data quality and completeness

  • The calculation layer between fund accounting and investor reporting: turning the fund’s books and portfolio valuations into correct investor numbers, with checks that tie them together

  • Report generation workflows: quarterly and annual packages, capital account statements and PDFs ready to send to investors

  • Configuration and customisation: templates, branding, disclosures, and language and currency formatting

  • Data readiness and correctness for reports: validation, completeness checks and auditability

  • Distribution and delivery: review and approval flows, delivery to investors, and access controls

  • Observability for reporting runs: errors, retries, performance and transparency for customers

Top Responsibilities

  • Drive roadmap and execution for reporting workflows and the reporting experiences customers see

  • Translate domain requirements into clear product specs (inputs → transformations → outputs) with strong edge-case handling

  • Partner with engineering to define the right building blocks for scalable report generation (templates, data contracts, versioning)

  • Collaborate with design to make complex reporting setup and review flows intuitive and fast

  • Work with fund accounting, operations and customer-facing teams to identify friction, ensure correctness and improve time-to-report

  • Define and track success metrics across adoption, report quality, operational efficiency and reliability

  • Maintain a high bar for data integrity, traceability and customer trust

About You

  • 7+ years of product management experience building B2B fintech products

  • Strong product execution skills: shipping, iteration loops, prioritization and stakeholder alignment

  • A solid grasp of financial reporting basics: how they work and why every number has to trace back to a source. Experience from accounting, banking, payments, treasury or financial data products all counts

  • Ability to turn complex requirements into simple product surfaces and crisp product logic

  • Analytical mindset: you can define metrics, investigate root causes and make data-informed tradeoffs

  • Excellent communication: you write clear specs and collaborate well with technical and non-technical partners

  • Experience working closely with engineering on systems that need reliability, monitoring and rigor on edge cases

  • Nice to have: exposure to fund or investment reporting (NAV, capital accounts, fees, IRR, TVPI, DPI). You don’t need a private markets background. We’ll teach you, and you’ll work every day with our fund accounting experts

Workplace & Benefits

  • Competitive salary plus equity

  • Customizable benefits package (wellbeing, sport, mobility, food and more)

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Hybrid setup with 2 days a week in the office

  • Up to 4 remote calendar weeks a year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 140+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Hiring process

  • First interview with the People team (20 min) to get to know bunch and explore whether what we’re offering matches what you’re looking for

  • Hiring manager interview with our VP of Product (45 min) to discuss your experience, your approach and your fit for the role

  • Product case interview with our Product & Design team (60 min) to show your product thinking, communication and execution style

  • Stakeholder interviews (3 x 30 min) with members of Operations, Engineering and our Founders to align on vision and expectations

Curious to learn more?

Get a feel for who we are, how we work, and what we’re building:

  • About bunch – Our mission, product, and journey so far

  • Case Studies – About those who already build on bunch

  • Gathering insights – Our latest bunch of blog posts

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.

title: Principal Engineer - Quality Assurance
description:
YOUR FUTURE, ON DEMAND

The ideal blend of stability and flexibility. A genuinely human employer that cares for people and the planet. True autonomy to shape what comes next, for us and you. This is the perfect platform to take your career where you want.

Back in 2005, we pioneered Europe’s first TV streaming service. Today, we're a leading TV streaming provider with millions of monthly users, and since 2021 we've been ClimatePartner-certified. Over 200 colleagues of 47 nationalities. We’re the grown-up start-up, helping to shape a better future since day one.That hasn’t changed, even if the world has. We’re friendly, international, inclusive – and our people say we’re reliable and transparent, too. It’s why they trust us and believe in what we do.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a Principal Engineer QA as a senior individual contributor. You will define how quality risk is assessed, measured, and gated across the full streaming path - and embed that craft into engineering teams, who own day-to-day tests and suite health.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Quality strategy & risk - Build and maintain a living risk model for the streaming chain. Raise effort where failure hurts most. Make coverage vs. speed and pre-release vs. production trade-offs explicit with product and eng.
  • Release constraints & quality gates - Define what “releasable” means for backend, middleware, and clients - including how continuous backend/middleware delivery is gated relative to client store cadences (web/TV/mobile). Keep gates fast, trustworthy, and hard to bypass.
  • Rollout practice (build with the teams) - Define and establish staged rollout, canary, and rollback strategies together with eng and SRE/ops. Own the definition; establish and operate them collaboratively.
  • Test architecture - Set the pyramid and ownership boundaries (unit through E2E, performance, playback/stream validation) so each layer has a clear home inside eng. Drive cross-stack design that exercises real policy and format decisions.
  • Incident & reliability partnership - Join major quality incidents with a quality lens; strengthen production feedback for streaming health; turn escapes into durable tests, monitors, gate changes, and rollout improvements.
  • Tooling & automation standards - Set practical standards for frameworks, CI integration, test data, environments, and reporting so teams share patterns with clear ownership and measurable ROI.
  • AI-enabled quality engineering - Define where AI raises quality leverage: test generation and maintenance, risk-based test selection, failure triage, and incident analysis. Set standards for AI-assisted testing and shape quality expectations for AI-authored code as delivery speed and change volume increase.
  • Mentoring & influence - Embed quality craft into eng: risk-based testing, quality in PRs, middleware policy and multi-platform client testing. Socialize lightweight, strong-default standards (definition of done, flake policy, critical-path coverage). Influence design reviews when quality risk is material.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

  • Org-wide quality strategy, risk model, and whole-stack standards
  • Release constraints and quality gates; definition of “releasable”
  • Definition of staged rollout/canary/rollback strategies (to be established with partners)
  • Test architecture principles and automation norms
  • Cross-stack escape analysis and quality debt for gates and tooling
  • Embedding quality craft in engineering; influencing high-risk designs
  • Standards for AI-assisted testing and quality expectations for AI-authored code

WHO YOU’LL PARTNER WITH

  • Engineering - They implement and own tests/suites in services and clients; you set architecture, gates, and standards, and build quality practice into delivery.
  • Product - Journey and tenant/feature priority; acceptance of residual risk within the gates you define.
  • SRE / Ops - Establish and operate rollout strategies together; production signals, incident response, capacity/reliability.
  • Platform/tooling - CI, environments, shared frameworks, observability for quality signals.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • Track record as a senior IC in quality engineering (or equivalent) for complex, multi-service products - ideally streaming, media, or similarly high-availability consumer platforms
  • Experience designing whole-stack quality strategy: backend services, configuration/policy layers, and multi-platform clients
  • Ability to define and land test architecture (pyramid, ownership, cross-stack integration/contract/playback-style validation) that engineering teams can run and own
  • Strong influence without authority: you raise the bar inside eng teams, socialize standards, and hold the line on gates without managing a QA org
  • Strong software engineering skills at senior level or above; you write production-quality code, not just test scripts
  • Designing and coding for testability, and building automation as a first-class engineering product
  • Deep familiarity with CI/CD, with a track record of making pipelines faster and more reliable
  • Hands-on experience applying AI to quality engineering, with judgment on where it reduces risk and where it adds noise
  • Comfort partnering on incidents and turning production failure modes into durable quality improvements
  • Practical judgment on automation: enough to protect risk, not so much that brittle suites block the org
  • Bonus:
    • Hands-on engineering background with video ingest, encoding/packaging, playback, or multi-tenant config/policy surfaces
    • Work across web, TV, and mobile client quality risk (device/OS/store constraints)

WHY JOIN US?

At Zattoo, you’re always on firm ground with real freedom to explore. You’ll have the support and opportunity you need to go far, while you’re helping us create a sustainable and entertainment-filled future for all.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

  • Recharge: 30 days vacation plus public holidays

Plus:

  • We’re inclusive: ‘Zattooies’ are a fun, engaged, and diverse team made up of 47 nationalities

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Web + Infrastructure)
description:
Searoutes makes the emissions data that shippers use to run and reduce their
logistics. It is an operational problem before it is an environmental one, and
in our hands it is mostly an engineering one.

We are hiring a senior engineer who works across our web frontend and our
infrastructure — the same two codebases, in the same week. Someone who ships a
product screen on Monday, changes an identity-provider flow on Wednesday, and
considers those the same job.

We are looking for a broad profile rather than a specialist. The next year is
mostly platform work with a user-facing edge — user management, API gateway
management, payments, SEO, and a great deal of compliance, GDPR and ISO 27001.

If you are passionate about the environment, proactive and pragmatic in getting
things done, and love to work in a complex but fascinating industry where you
learn every day — then this is the place for you.

The work in front of us

Some of the items on our tech roadmap for the coming year. Bets are picked a
cycle at a time and shared out, so you would take the ones that suit you and
grow into the rest.

  • Product and marketing UI in React — multi-brand, WCAG AA, strong on
    technical SEO, fast enough to hold a performance budget.
  • User management and identity — Keycloak realms, organisation hierarchies,
    partner brokering, and the entitlement model in the app.
  • API gateway work in APISIX — routes, plugins and auth policy as code.
  • Payments and billing.
  • ISO 27001 and GDPR — access control, change management, audit logging,
    observability and alerting, consent and retention.
  • The infrastructure underneath — Pulumi in TypeScript, Docker Swarm on
    Hetzner, Cloudflare at the edge, Tailscale for all engineer and CI access.
  • Third-party integrations — usually the seam between two systems that were
    never designed to meet.

Nobody arrives fluent in all of that, and we are not expecting it. We want
someone strong across a good part of it, comfortable being new to the rest, and
used to working things out — with a team and with agents, rather than alone.

Also in daily use: Postgres and PostGIS, Valkey, ClickHouse; Vite, Tailwind and
Radix; Jest and Playwright; GitHub Actions; HAProxy. Most of what we write is
TypeScript, strict — though our core API is Java and Spring, and the identity
layer has Java in it too, so how far you go into that side is up to you.

How we work

LLM-native, in the codebases you would work in. They are built around
agent-assisted development rather than merely tolerant of it — the conventions,
the tooling and the review gates all assume it. Agents do most of the
implementation and much of the review; humans design, verify and approve. What
we are really hiring for is judgement over output you did not write by hand:
knowing what to specify, what to check, and what to throw away. The bar did not
move when the tooling did.

Shape Up, and you own what you take. Roughly three weeks of building, then a
week of cooldown, with bets chosen at a betting table. We are small enough that
an area becomes yours quickly — you make the calls inside it and you answer for
how it turns out. We hand out problems, not the steps that solve them.

Remote first, with most of the team in Europe and everyone together in person at
least twice a year. Significant technical decisions get written down, and a
green build is never on its own enough to merge.

Requirements

You'll thrive here if you have…

  • Senior full-stack experience — you have owned features from the browser to
    the machine they run on.
  • A track record of taking something and running with it — a domain, a
    migration, a subsystem you took on, decided and stayed accountable for.
  • Taste. You can tell a good design from a merely plausible one, and you
    will reject work that functions but is not right — your own, and an agent's.
  • React beyond the client — server rendering, static generation, data
    loading and hydration; you know what runs where and why it matters.
  • TypeScript at strict — typed boundaries, and an instinct for when types
    are carrying real weight.
  • Infrastructure as code — Pulumi ideally; Terraform if you are ready to
    pick up Pulumi.
  • Containers and Linux in production — not writing a Dockerfile, but
    debugging a service on a machine you have to SSH into.
  • Postgres beyond queries — backup and restore, migrations, what a schema
    change does under load.
  • Wholehearted LLM-assisted development — you use coding agents daily, have
    opinions about steering them, and review their output as critically as a
    colleague's.
  • Integration instincts — third-party APIs, webhooks, OAuth/OIDC, and
    patience for other people's undocumented edge cases.
  • A working day that overlaps ours: based within CET ±3.
  • Fluent in English, our working language.

Nice to have

  • Identity and API gateways in depth — Keycloak, OIDC, SAML brokering, APISIX.
  • Compliance from the inside — an ISO 27001 certification lived through, or GDPR
    beyond a cookie banner.
  • Payment systems, billing models, or PSP integrations.
  • Observability and alerting — Prometheus, Grafana or equivalent.
  • Experience in the maritime, logistics or freight industry.
  • Familiarity with emissions accounting frameworks (GHG Protocol, GLEC, EU
    ETS..).

Benefits

As part of our team, you will:

  • 🌱 Have a chance to re-shape the future of climate in the logistics.
  • 👩‍💻 Be empowered to deliver your best work remotely, and get a stipend to set

    and won't be tied up in politics.
  • 🎓 Have a high degree of learning and ownership in a dynamic environment.

title: Technical Support & Enablement Specialist (m/f/d)
description:

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn about our Product & Tech team!

Deine Position

When a branch or market team can’t get something done in our systems, they come to you. Our teams work across a connected landscape of internal tools, from first customer contact through offer and project planning to installation and invoicing. You find out why: is it a bug, a gap in knowledge, or a missing feature? Then you make sure the right fix happens and you stay on it until the user can work again. What you see in the tickets helps us make these systems easier to use.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Support branches and market teams in Germany, Australia, Sweden, Denmark, Spain, the Netherlands and Finland, in German and English
  • Diagnose each issue and deliver the matching fix: a guide or training for a knowledge gap, a bug report with reproduction steps for Engineering, a feature request with use case and impact for Product
  • Where a simple automation closes the gap for a bug or a missing feature, you build it yourself. It goes live after a review with Engineering.
  • Use ticket data and the support metrics we agree on (volume by topic, time to resolution, share of repeat requests) to find where time is lost, and propose changes
  • Improve our support setup: ticket categories, templates, routing and handover rules
  • Write and maintain help articles and run onboarding sessions for new users and new markets This role is a good starting point in our tech organisation. You work across the full system landscape and all seven markets, and you learn how Product and Engineering make decisions. From here you can develop in several directions, for example towards product operations, ownership of an internal tool, or automation and engineering.

Dein Profil

  • 1 to 2 years of experience in support, customer success or a similar role. Internships and working student positions count.
  • German and English at C1 level or higher, written and spoken
  • Experience with business software, for example a CRM or ticketing system
  • Good technical understanding of how SaaS tools connect: data fields and objects, user roles and permissions, integrations, APIs and webhooks
  • A structured way of troubleshooting: you can reproduce an issue, narrow down the cause and describe it so that Engineering can act on it without follow-up questions
  • Experience in training or onboarding other people, or in building automations with low-code tools (e.g. n8n, windmill). One of the two is enough.
  • Experience in a startup or scale-up is a plus

Benefits

  • You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen
  • With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate
  • Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues

  • You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe’s most thriving scaleups

  • Whether city bike or e-bike - be flexible with our job bike leasing and do something good for the environment at the same time

This role will be part of the team building, implementing, monitoring and optimising two sets of models: the IFRS9 impairment models that measure our credit risk and support accurate reporting to auditors and investors, and the decisioning models and policy rules behind automated lending, which are critical to delivering fast, consistent and well-controlled credit decisions and a better customer journey as the bank grows.

The role requires the technical ability and practical mindset to take models and decisioning changes from initial problem definition through data identification, cleansing and analysis to model development, implementation and ongoing monitoring. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between structured model development and fast-paced ad-hoc analysis, working closely with Finance, Credit Risk, Underwriting, Collections, Product, Data, Engineering, Capital Markets and Model Risk colleagues. title: Support Engineer
description:
Support Engineer

Edinburgh

Wordsmith

Wordsmith is building the legal operating system for in-house teams, and we are growing fast.

We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents and disconnected systems.

Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgement matters, and every step is captured as work happens.

We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend and become a function the business can run with.

More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by over $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI.

The role

We’re hiring a Support Engineer to provide fast, thoughtful and technically rigorous help to Wordsmith customers.

You’ll own technical questions and incidents from first response through to resolution. You’ll understand what the customer is trying to achieve, reproduce reported behaviour, investigate the underlying cause and explain the outcome clearly.

This is more than scripted customer support. You’ll be expected to investigate application behaviour at a technical level, including reading logs and tracing issues through the product and its codebase. Where appropriate to your experience, you may also propose and submit code fixes through our normal engineering review and release process.

Wordsmith supports customers globally through a follow-the-sun model. You’ll work the standard hours for your region and hand over unresolved issues clearly to colleagues in other regions. There is no routine expectation that you work another region’s hours.

What you’ll do

  • Own technical support requests — triage, investigate and resolve customer questions and incidents from first response to confirmed resolution.

  • Diagnose problems thoroughly — gather the right context, reproduce reported behaviour, inspect logs and data, and trace issues through the product and codebase.

  • Resolve technical issues — correct configuration or usage problems directly and collaborate with Engineering when a product or infrastructure change is required.

  • Contribute code fixes where appropriate — depending on your experience, propose and submit well-tested fixes through the standard engineering review and deployment process.

  • Communicate clearly — give customers timely and accurate updates, explain technical issues without unnecessary jargon and set honest expectations.

  • Manage escalations — bring in Engineering, Product or other specialists when needed while retaining ownership of the case and its communication.

  • Support global handovers — document investigation, impact, current status and next actions so colleagues in another region can continue work without losing momentum.

  • Protect service quality — recognise high-impact incidents quickly, follow the appropriate escalation process and contribute to incident reviews.

  • Build customer knowledge — create and maintain troubleshooting guides, known-issue documentation and help-centre content.

  • Reduce repeat problems — identify patterns in support demand and recommend improvements to the product, documentation, tooling and customer experience.

  • Improve support operations — help develop service levels, escalation paths, reporting and technical-support processes as the function scales.

What we’re looking for

  • Experience in technical support, product support, software engineering, solutions engineering or another customer-facing technical role.

  • Strong diagnostic ability — you can work methodically from symptoms to root cause rather than relying on guesswork.

  • A working understanding of modern web applications, APIs, authentication, integrations and common browser or network issues.

  • Experience using diagnostic information such as application logs, monitoring tools, browser developer tools and database queries.

  • Enough familiarity with software code to navigate a codebase, follow application logic and use it to investigate reported behaviour.

  • Clear customer communication — you can remain calm under pressure, set expectations honestly and explain complex issues at the right level of detail.

  • Strong ownership — you remain responsible for moving an issue forward even when other teams need to contribute.

  • Sound prioritisation — you can assess urgency and customer impact and recognise when an issue requires immediate escalation.

  • Care and precision — you document what you tested, avoid unsupported conclusions and confirm that the customer’s problem has actually been resolved.

  • Interest in AI systems — you’re curious about how AI-enabled products behave and comfortable investigating issues that may not always be deterministic.

  • No legal background is required, but you should be motivated to learn how in-house legal teams work.

Desirable, but not essential

  • Experience writing and debugging production software.

  • The ability to create automated tests and submit code fixes for engineering review.

  • Experience supporting AI-enabled or data-intensive applications.

  • Familiarity with incident-management and observability tools.

How we work

We’re an in-person team based in Edinburgh. You should expect to work from the office as your default.

We support customers globally using a follow-the-sun model. You’ll work the normal hours agreed for your region and create clear handovers when an issue needs to continue beyond them. Any exceptional on-call or out-of-hours arrangements would be agreed and communicated separately.

We set a high bar, move quickly and give people meaningful ownership. Support is a core part of the product experience, and we expect it to be technically credible, responsive and human.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Product, Transformation and Customer Success. Customer Success owns adoption and customer health; Transformation owns implementation; Account Management owns renewals and commercial growth; and Support Engineering owns technical investigation and resolution.

Why Wordsmith

You’ll support a fast-growing product used for important work inside some of the world’s most ambitious organisations.

Because we’re building in a new technical category, the problems are interesting. You’ll work across software behaviour, integrations, data and AI systems rather than following a script.

You’ll have the opportunity to shape our support tooling and operating model, influence the product through direct customer evidence, and develop towards senior support engineering, support leadership, solutions engineering or product engineering.

description:
About us

EggAI is a fast-growing AI consulting and development startup. We build agentic AI solutions for enterprise clients. We are growing in several European markets.

The role

You will own the design of a shared AI platform for our clients. The platform has two parts. An AI Control Plane governs what agents may do, through identity and delegated permissions, policy enforcement, approvals, budgets and durable audit records. A managed AI Runtime is where the agents run. Both integrate with the client's identity, security, delivery and audit services.

You will set the architecture, define how services and controls fit together, and make sure what the team builds is sound, assured and ready for production. The role reaches across engineering, security, audit, risk and the client's architecture function. You will take designs through their governance, record the decisions, and give the engineers a design they can build and the client a design they can approve.

You will be EggAI's accountable architecture lead on the engagement, leading design for a delivery team of platform engineers. You make the technical decisions within the team's remit, recommend on the rest, and secure the client's approval where their architecture or risk governance requires it. 

What you will do

- Own the architecture of the AI Control Plane and AI Runtime and keep it aligned with the client's architecture standards, cloud substrate, API gateway, identity provider and audit services.
- Define service interfaces and contracts. Decide where each security and policy control is enforced: in the gateway, the control plane, the runtime or the client's own services.
- Keep the design record. Write architecture decision records (ADRs) and record every deviation from the client's standards or our reference designs for a client decision.
- Take designs through the client's architecture and risk forums. Secure approvals in time for dependent work, so that design precedes implementation.
- Lead design and quality review across all platform services. Review engineers' changes, cross-service tests and fault exercises with the CTO.
- Define how the architecture will be proven. Agree acceptance criteria with engineers and client control owners for each interface, control and infrastructure contract, including behaviour when a dependency fails, and review the test evidence showing they are met.
- Hold the build to the design's principles: policy enforced outside the agent, decisions recorded before actions take effect, fail closed with stop always available, and audit evidence that is administered independently of the people who build and run the platform, reconciled against what actually happened, and readable with the client's own tools.
- Maintain the inventory of platform controls. Record for each one whether it is enforced or only monitored, whether it is implemented, tested or still open, and what evidence it produces, so acceptance reviews work from a current record and coverage gaps are visible.
- Assess proposed technology, scope and dependency changes for their effect on the design, controls, effort and running costs, and give the programme lead a clear basis for plan and cost decisions.
- Evaluate new runtimes and managed services against the platform's control requirements. Compare shared controls with provider-native ones on integration effort, operating cost and assurance gaps, separate what is verified from what is assumed, and recommend whether to adopt, change the design or hold scope.
- Lead the technical assessment of production readiness. Review recovery, containment and fault-exercise evidence, and give the programme lead a clear view of what is ready and what is not.
- Stay with the platform through go-live and the support period after it. Resolve the architectural issues that production exposes, and decide when a fix is a design change rather than a defect.
- Prepare the client's receiving engineers to maintain the design. Lead the architecture parts of training and handover, and leave documentation, decision records and guidance they can extend without you.

Essential experience

- You have been the accountable solution or platform architect for systems that went into production, and have led engineers through building them.
- You have delivered cloud platforms into production in a regulated environment and taken designs through formal architecture and risk governance.
- You know a major cloud platform in depth: networking, identity, secrets, Kubernetes and managed services. Azure is strongly preferred.
- You have hands-on experience with API gateways, identity and delegation using OAuth and OIDC, and policy as code.
- You work with infrastructure as code, GitOps and software supply-chain controls, and understand how they underpin reproducible environments, conformance tests and release assurance.
- You have designed systems that must produce audit evidence and fail safely: durable records, immutable storage, separation of duties and deny-by-default access. You have sound judgement about retries, partial failure, idempotency, identity propagation and recovery.
- You write clear architecture decision records and can explain and defend a design to senior architects, risk owners and engineers.

Nice to have

- Delivery in financial services or banking.
- LLM or agent platforms in production, including model gateways, agent orchestration and protocols such as MCP and A2A.
- Audit, evidence retention or AI risk controls, including EU AI Act, PRA or FCA expectations.
- Products in this space such as Kong, Open Policy Agent or Microsoft Foundry.

Practical details

- You will need to complete the background and security checks required by the client.

What this role is (and isn't)

Most ERP deployments are people moving data around for a year. Incumbents quote six figures for it, and the client gets the same software they had, just newer. Ours run in eight to twelve weeks and deliver two things at once: a new ERP that runs buying, selling, stock and production, and AI agents inside it that read the orders, recompute the production load, prepare the purchases, and ask a human only when it matters.

This is not a product or a sales role, you are a deployment strategist. In one project, you replace a company's ERP and you put AI agents to work inside it.

Why now

Since day one, the founders have run every deployment themselves. Clients are now coming in faster than we can handle, and we need someone to own deployments. You work directly with Eric, CEO, who also leads product. That puts you as close as it gets to what success means at Piston: the success of our clients.

What you'll do

  • Deploy the ERP, with AI. The client's sales, purchasing, stock and production move onto Piston: data migrated from their old ERP and their Excel files, configuration built from their own documents, training, go-live. AI does the heavy lifting, you do the judgment.

  • Write the deployment playbook. Every go-live feeds a playbook that our next deployment hires and our system integrator partners will follow.

You bring the energy to deploy AI at scale in industrial companies. You learn fast from discovery, and you're as comfortable with founders and leadership teams as with operators on the shop floor.

  • You've already taken a complex B2B software live

  • Comfortable with AI

  • You've worked around manufacturing or food operations: lots, BOMs, production orders, campaigns

  • Seed / Series A experience, where nobody's job description holds for long

Talent beats checklists. If you're intrigued, apply anyway.

How we'll measure success

  • ERP go-lives on the date we promised

  • Agents still running three months after launch, and the hours of work they take off the client's hands

What you'll get

  • €45–60k + equity

At evenito, we build enterprise event management software centered on human connection. By combining cutting-edge technology with personal support, we empower event teams to automate routine logistics and free up time for what truly matters: crafting memorable, sustainable event experiences.

As our Head of Customer Success (CS) you will have a front row seat. Together with your team you will be responsible for evenito’s customer excellence. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will not only ensure that our customers receive professional support, but also be the strategic business owner of our post-sale organization and act as a key customer voice within the company. You will develop and execute a scalable CS operating model and play a pivotal role in shaping our product and the future of evenito.

Are you ready to make an impact?

Your Mission:

Drive customer success, develop a high-performing team and turn everyday user insights into strategic product growth.

  • Lead by Example: You set the tone through your actions. From onboarding our largest enterprise clients (ICPs) to handling support tickets alongside your team, you showcase what great customer service looks like while equipping your team with the tools and support they need to succeed.

  • Team Development & Coaching: You will lead and coach a team of five. Through regular 1-on-1s, clear goals and constructive feedback, you will foster a positive, supportive work environment focused on steady growth and a resilient team setup.

  • Escalations & Problem Solving: You view complex situations as opportunities to build trust with our clients. When high-stakes issues arise, you partner directly with Product and Management to find clear solutions, using customer data to guide thoughtful decisions.

  • Cross-Functional Advocacy: You serve as a key connector between our clients and internal teams. By sharing real customer insights with Product, Sales and Marketing, you help shape and prioritize our product roadmap while keeping team priorities aligned with company strategy.

  • Process & Project Innovation: You stay current on Customer Success best practices and enjoy improving how things work. You will have the freedom to introduce new CS workflows that streamline daily operations and support our current growth stage.

  • Commercial Impact & Growth: You ensure Customer Success is a growth engine by delivering clear, measurable value. You will drive product adoption and offer high-impact paid services, positioning expansions as a natural result of client success. This, while tracking performance with clear, business-focused metrics.

  • Knowledge Base Development: You will own and champion our self-service tools (Knowledge Base, Video Academy, Automation). By making resources clear and accessible, you help our customers find quick answers independently and keep support queues manageable.

Your Story

You have a solid B2B SaaS experience, a practical doer mindset and a genuine drive to grow people and businesses - all fueled by a real enthusiasm for the magic of event tech.

  • SaaS Experience: You bring 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Implementation or Account Management in the B2B SaaS environment.

  • Hands-on Doer Mindset: You keep your cool and stay positive when things go sideways. You are pragmatic, humble and jump into daily support queues without hesitation.

  • Effective Communicator: You are a skilled communicator and workshop facilitator who connects effortlessly with enterprise executives, end-users and internal teams alike.

  • Tech Savvy and Agile: You are at home analyzing usage data, mapping workflows and collaborating with Product on technical escalations. You adapt quickly to new software, shifting priorities and changing processes.

  • Leadership Drive: You genuinely care about people. Ideally, you have led a small team before and take true fulfillment in coaching others, building confidence and helping your team grow.

  • Passion for Events and Tech: Events are all about emotion and experience. We are looking for someone who brings that exact enthusiasm for events, event tech and / or digital products.

  • Languages: Fluent in English and German, with the ability to comfortably follow Swiss-German in client meetings.

What We Offer

Unlock your full potential in an inspiring and fast-paced environment. We provide the stage; you take the reins.

  • Impact: Take ownership of a role where your work directly shapes evenito's growth and sets new standards for the industry. You will work closely with management, an amazing team, passionate clients and drive projects that make a difference.

  • Flexibility: As one of our core values, we strongly believe in hybrid remote work options and flexible schedules that allow you to align your professional commitments with your personal life.

  • Time to Recharge: Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation, plus an additional day off for every year of service, giving you plenty of time to rest and recharge.

  • Modern Zurich HQ: Located just a five-minute walk from Zurich HB, our centrally located office offers an inspiring work environment with local coffee, a variety of snacks and access to many lunch spots.

  • Unique Events: Events are our DNA. Beyond building great software, we truly enjoy spending time with each other - whether through spontaneous summer swims in the Limmat-river, Friday Beer um Vier drinks, our annual Global Team Event or legendary Christmas parties.

  • Mobility Support: We contribute toward your public transport pass (öV-Abo) to support convenient and sustainable commuting.

  • Growth Potential: Thrive in a workplace with flat hierarchies, fast decision-making and an open feedback culture designed to help you continuously develop.

Are you ready to shape the future of events with us?

Discover more about life at evenito on our career page, send us your CV and tell us what excites you most about joining our team. We are building something special at evenito - and we can’t wait to meet the person behind the application.

title: Senior Sourcing Specialist
description:
Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups.

We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential.

Responsibilities
  • Plan your sourcing. You take the bill of materials and build a sourcing plan for each commodity. You weigh criticality, lead time and single or dual source options.
  • Find the right suppliers. You run market scans, requests for information and requests for quote. Then you shortlist the suppliers worth a closer look.
  • Judge capability together. You work with R&D, Production, Finance and Compliance to build one clear view of what each supplier can do.
  • Negotiate the deal. You agree pricing, volume tiers, tooling and payment terms. You also set up the NDAs, supply agreements and long-term agreements that back them.
  • Set suppliers up properly. You onboard new suppliers and keep vendor data, price breaks and lead times current in our ERP system.
  • Lead supplier qualification. You coordinate our tiered qualification process, including quality agreements and first-article inspections.
  • Audit on site and remotely. You check suppliers for quality management, traceability and compliance. You also screen them against trade compliance requirements.
  • Keep builds moving. You place and expedite orders for prototype, validation, pilot and pre-series builds. You track supplier performance on delivery, price and quality.
  • Bring costs down. You work with suppliers on cost reduction, using should-cost and landed-cost models.
  • Grow our supplier base. You qualify suppliers for additional production sites and regions, reusing existing qualification records.
  • Make it repeatable. You document sourcing processes, templates and playbooks, so the purchasing team can take over mature suppliers.

    • Requirements
  • You have 6+ years in sourcing, purchasing or new product introduction for hardware products, across a variety of product types, complexities and technologies.
  • You can read technical drawings and specifications, and you work closely with engineers.
  • You’re willing to travel regularly, including international trips of several days.
  • You’ve audited suppliers hands-on or worked within a quality management system such as ISO 9001.
  • You have working knowledge of trade compliance rules.
  • You’ve used an ERP system for purchasing and vendor data.
  • You have a qualification in engineering, supply chain, business or a related field.
  • You communicate excellently in English and build good working relationships with colleagues and suppliers.

    • Plus
  • Experience in aerospace, drones or other safety-critical products
  • Experience sourcing custom electromechanical parts such as plastic parts, motors, batteries and avionics
  • Experience qualifying suppliers for production in more than one region
  • Experience with supplier scorecards and performance reporting
    • If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you.

What we're looking for

You've built partnerships or channels before, and you know the ecosystem from the inside. You understand how SIs, consultancies, PE’s and referral partners actually think, what makes them commit, and what makes a partnership real rather than a logo on a slide.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Do you want to work out how you actually measure whether an AI system is doing a good job, and then make it better? We're looking for a sharp, analytical data scientist to own the evaluation and quality loop of our AutoQA product. You can be early in your career (recent graduates with strong LLM fundamentals are welcome), we have room and a clear path for you to grow.

In a nutshell

  • Join a fast-growing SaaS company in an international environment (steep learning curve guaranteed).

  • Own a high-impact problem: making LLM-powered quality assurance measurably accurate at scale.

  • Sit at the intersection of AI and CX, working directly with enterprise customers and their real-world QA rubrics.

  • Grow into a Senior Data Scientist, AI Engineer, or ML Engineer role. We invest in progression.

  • Enjoy the perks: flexible hours, open holiday policy, an office in the heart of Amsterdam with hybrid flexibility, visa sponsorship, great gear, workations, and team events.

About Kaizo

At Kaizo, we build a performance development and quality platform for customer support teams. Our AutoQA product uses LLMs to review support conversations against each customer's own quality rubric, automatically and at scale. Behind it sits a microservices-based stream processing platform handling over 200 million events per day (Kafka, Kubernetes on Google Cloud, ElasticSearch, MongoDB, BigQuery), and an LLMOps stack built around LangSmith for experimentation, prompt management, and tracing.

The hard part isn't calling an LLM. It's knowing, with evidence, how well the system performs on every customer's unique rubric, and having a reliable, repeatable way to improve it. That's where you come in.

What you'll focus on

  • Translate customer rubrics into AutoQA instructions. Work with real customer quality criteria and turn them into precise, testable instructions that LLMs can score reliably.

  • Run experiments that move accuracy. Design and execute evaluation experiments on large, representative datasets using LangSmith and BigQuery, and track quality with our performance metrics.

  • Build the datasets that make evaluation possible. Curate raw production data into golden datasets with balanced coverage, and generate synthetic data to cover the rare cases that matter most. QA is a discipline of rare occurrences: distributions are skewed, positives are scarce, and resourcefulness beats volume.

  • Build LLM-as-a-judge pipelines to assess system quality internally and make evaluation repeatable.

  • Make results actionable. Your experiments should end in a decision: change a prompt, adjust which tools the system uses, surface context the AI is missing, or flag where new capabilities are needed. You'll work with the AI team to ship those decisions.

  • Evaluate across the full stack. Beyond scoring quality, you'll help validate retrieval (RAG/IR), tool calling, and speech pipelines (transcription and diarization quality).

  • Join customer calls with the team to understand how QA leaders define quality, and feed what you learn back into the product.

What you'll grow into

  • Shaping how customers monitor quality themselves, catch drift, and keep their AutoQA setup improving over time.

  • Smarter categorization and routing of conversations to power analytics and get the right tickets to the right evaluation.


  • A solid understanding of how LLMs work and hands-on experience prompting them for accuracy (coursework, thesis, internships, or side projects all count; production experience is a bonus).

  • Good applied statistics: experiment design, classifier evaluation, precision/recall trade-offs, and working with heavily imbalanced data.

  • Strong Python skills and fluency with the standard data toolkit (Pandas, NumPy, Jupyter). SQL is a plus.

  • An analytical, evidence-first mindset: you'd rather measure than assume.

  • Product sense and empathy for end users. You'll be building for QA managers and support agents, not just for benchmarks.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication. You'll present findings to the team and join customer conversations.

  • 0 to 2 years of industry experience. Recent graduates with strong relevant work are encouraged to apply.

  • A team player who's comfortable wearing multiple hats. We're an early-stage company and things move fast.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with LangSmith or similar LLMOps/evaluation tooling

  • Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, Docker, or Kubernetes

  • Speech/audio processing or ASR evaluation

  • Fine-tuning or building synthetic datasets for LLMs

Who you'll work with

You'll join our AI team (two data scientists, an AI engineer, and an ML engineer) and collaborate closely with our data engineers, frontend engineers, designer, product manager, and CX teams. You'll have mentorship from day one and real ownership fast.

What's in it for you?

  • An office in the heart of Amsterdam, with the flexibility of hybrid working

  • Visa sponsorship available for eligible candidates

  • Great office gear: MacBook, tools, desk, chair, whatever you need

  • Flexible working schedule and an open holiday policy

  • Fun workations and team events

  • A clear growth path into Senior Data Scientist, AI Engineer, or ML Engineer roles

title: Senior Marketing Specialist
description:
Senior Marketing Manager

Location: Europe, Amsterdam preferred (hybrid or remote possible)
Competitive salary
Start date: as soon as possible

Let’s be blunt: Kaizo doesn’t have a real marketing engine yet.

We’ve had marketers before, but the company we are today is a different company. Over the past 18 months we’ve signed enterprise customers like Canva, Instacart, UiPath and Indeed. We’ve also rebuilt our product around a new reality: support teams now run on a mix of human agents and AI agents, and someone has to check the quality of both. Kaizo is the independent Agentic QA layer for that hybrid workforce. We work across helpdesks and Customer Service platforms, and we don’t build AI agents of our own, so we have no reason to mark our own homework.

The problem is that the market doesn’t know this yet. We’re the customer service industry’s best-kept secret.

  • The website architecture has just been rebuilt, but the content is outdated and doesn’t tell today’s story.

  • We have strong enterprise customer stories that nobody has written up.

  • Inbound is no longer enough. AI search has changed how buyers find vendors, so pipeline now has to come from outbound, partners, events and reputation.

  • We’re going to the field and starting to attend international events.

  • Sales doesn’t have all the decks, battlecards and collateral it needs.

  • Outbound has started, and it needs content behind it.


That’s where you come in.

What this role really is

We need a senior marketer who wants to build from scratch, and who sees a blank page as an opportunity, not a threat. You’ll be the one who:

  • Brings the website to life so it reflects who we are today and gets found, by people and by AI search.

  • Turns our enterprise wins into case studies and references that open new doors.

  • Owns our review and analyst presence: a proper G2 strategy, competitor and comparison pages that convert, and support for analyst relations.

  • Gives Sales and CS the content, one-pagers, battlecards and decks that win deals and renewals.

  • Starts product marketing: positioning, launches, and clear messaging on AutoQA, Agentic QA, Insights and AI Coaching for customers and prospects.

  • Builds our brand through thought leadership, PR and executive content on the future of CX quality in an AI-agent world.

  • Owns our social channels and online reputation.

  • Defines and runs a field marketing plan, so Kaizo shows up at the international events that matter to our enterprise ICP.

  • Works with Sales on outbound and partner campaigns, including our helpdesk and Customer Service ecosystem partners.

You won’t inherit a polished machine. You’ll be the architect, the builder and the driver of Kaizo’s marketing.

The deal

  • Location: Amsterdam preferred, flexible across Europe, hybrid or remote possible.

  • Reporting: directly to Thibaud, Co-CEO, as part of the commercial leadership team.

  • Real ownership, a fast feedback loop with Sales and Product, and a seat at the table where positioning gets decided.

Why this matters

Marketing is the missing piece in Kaizo’s growth engine. The product is there, the enterprise customers are there and the deals are there. Now the market needs to know it, and we need demand that scales.

If you succeed, your fingerprints will be all over Kaizo’s next growth chapter:

  • From a handful of enterprise logos → recognised category voice

  • From inbound dependency → repeatable, multi-channel pipeline

  • From scrappy content → thought leadership

→ If you’re looking for a comfortable role with a big team, a big budget and playbooks already written, this isn’t it.
→ If you want to build the marketing engine that takes Kaizo from great product to visible market leader, let’s talk.


Who you are

  • A content-first marketer. Storytelling is your edge, not growth hacks.

  • You’ve marketed complex B2B SaaS, ideally to enterprise buyers with long sales cycles and buying committees.

  • You’re hands-on: you write, edit, brief designers, manage freelancers and run campaigns yourself.

  • You know what good marketing ops looks like, and you can get by with lean tools (we run on HubSpot).

  • You understand how AI search is changing B2B discovery, and you know how to adapt SEO and content to it.

  • Your English is native or near-native. Everything we publish has to read sharp and professional.

  • Bonus: AI, QA and CX excite you, and acronyms don’t scare you. You’re keen to learn our product, our customers’ pain points and the trends on both the CX and QA sides.

  • Bonus: experience with field events, G2 or analyst relations, or partner and ecosystem marketing.

Equal opportunities

At Kaizo, we believe diversity drives innovation. We’re committed to an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected, supported and able to do their best work. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, disability, religion or beliefs. We work in a flexible hybrid model from our Utrecht HQ and our homes across the Netherlands.

 

Just as travel is about discovery, we’re looking for people who want to go one stop further, joining a journey that inspires personal transformation through train travel.

                                                                                                

We’re on the search for…

At Interrail, we help people experience Europe by train. We are looking for a PO to make that experience more connected, rewarding, and transformative. You will lead the strategy and roadmap for products that bring travellers together, recognise their journeys, and give them more reasons to return to Interrail and make them feel a sense of belonging. 

 

From social connection, community, to loyalty, referrals, and gamification, you will create experiences that turn a great trip into a lasting relationship with our brand. Some of these experiences will also support informal learning, intercultural exchange and personal development through travel.

 

You will work closely with Design, Engineering, Data, Lifecycle Marketing, Customer Experience, and Commercial teams to build products that customers genuinely value and that strengthen engagement, retention, advocacy, and lifetime value.  

The role exists to solve one fundamental challenge: how do we create meaningful reasons for travellers to remain engaged with Interrail between journeys, and return not only to travel again, but to participate, contribute and advocate for the brand?

 

What you’ll be doing

  •  Define and deliver the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for community, loyalty, referrals, and gamification. 

  • Own the digital loyalty experience and economics. 

  • Design products that enable meaningful interactions and real-world connections between travellers, while maintaining a safe, respectful and inclusive environment.  

  • Develop product experiences that encourage cultural exchange, curiosity and informal learning through social interaction.  

  • Work with Institutional Initiatives to translate relevant programme objectives into engaging traveller experiences, where these align with the broader Social Connection & Loyalty product strategy. 

  • Build experiences that help travellers connect, share, contribute, and discover useful travel content. 

  • Create loyalty, recognition, and referral journeys that encourage advocacy and repeat travel. 

  • Work with Design, CX, and Engineering to deliver simple, scalable web and mobile experiences. 

  • Partner with Lifecycle Marketing to connect campaigns with relevant in-product journeys. 

  • Use customer insight, behavioural data, AI, and experimentation (A/B testing) to identify opportunities and personalise experiences. 

  • Work with Customer Support and relevant partners to ensure community experiences are safe, trustworthy, and useful. 

  • Define and track success metrics across Traveller Participation Rate, engagement, retention, repeat purchase, referrals, loyalty participation, and customer lifetime value. 

 

What we’re looking for

It's already a possible match when you share the same mindset as us, being forward-thinking, results-driven, caring and embracing diversity.

 

In terms of your experience and skills:

  • 8+ years of product management experience, with experience building and scaling B2C digital products across web and mobile.

  • A track record of building products that improve engagement, retention, loyalty, community participation, or growth. 

  • Demonstrated experience building social, community-driven or interaction-led digital products, with a strong understanding of how to create meaningful interactions between users. 

  • Experience owning a product area from strategy and discovery through delivery, scaling, and optimization. 

  • Experience designing for trust, safety, inclusion and healthy community participation, particularly where digital experiences facilitate interaction between people who do not already know one another. 

  • Strong qualitative user research and behavioral insight skills, with the ability to understand why people connect, participate and contribute, not only what they click or use. 

  • Strong product judgment and the ability to turn customer insight into simple, valuable experiences. 

  • Confidence using data, experimentation, and product metrics to make decisions and measure incremental impact. 

  • Experience working closely with Design, Engineering, Data, Marketing, and other business stakeholders. 

  • A thoughtful approach to customer trust, privacy, safety, and responsible engagement design. 

  • Comfort working in a fast-moving, international environment. 

 

Nice to have:

  • Experience translating institutional, educational or social-impact objectives into compelling consumer-facing digital experiences.

  • An interest in travel, rail, and the ways people discover and share experiences.

  • Experience with user-generated content, personalisation, CRM platforms, or notification systems.

 

Our offer

  • We offer a flexible hybrid model that combines remote work with in-office days each week, enhancing teamwork and connection.

  • A complimentary NS train card to travel across the Netherlands for work and leisure.

  • An annual free Interrail/Eurail travel pass for you and a companion, so you can explore Europe and share the same experiences as our customers.

  • Unlimited access to OpenUp for lifestyle & well-being recommendations.

  • Support for your well-being through a personal allowance of €1500.

  • We provide a training allowance of €4000 to support learning opportunities relevant to your role.

  • Variable annual bonus (target 4%), based on company and individual performance.

  • An annual team trip across Europe to experience our product first-hand.

  • 20 working days per year from abroad.

  • An annual leave package of 28 days, plus study days, volunteer days, and a culture day.

  • Salary Scale: 61, Monthly gross salary (excluding 8% allowance): €7000 - 8000 (full-time) based on experience.

 

Curious to apply?

Apply directly via our website (https://www.interrail.com/en/careers).

 

  • We'll ask you to share your resume in English (our business language) and tell us why you're interested in Eurail and this particular role. It doesn't hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through.

  • As part of the process, we may also ask you to complete a short assessment to showcase your skills.

 

If we think you might be a good candidate, the next step is a relatively informal interview. For you, this is a chance to understand if Eurail is your ideal workplace, and for us, it tells us more about the value you would bring.

 

To support fair and unbiased hiring, we use a blind recruitment process in the early stages. Personal details such as your name, date of birth, photo, contact information, social media links, gender, and nationality are hidden, allowing us to focus on your skills, experience, and potential.

In the meantime…

If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a sense of our culture and values?

 

Got questions? Our People & Culture team would be happy to help — just drop us a note at

 

While you're here, explore our travel passes and get inspired for your next journey at  https://www.interrail.com/en.
