title: Business Development Representative (m/w/d) - AI Agent Platform
description:
Ninox ist eine Berliner Low-Code-Plattform, mit der Teams genau die Geschäftsanwendungen bauen, die sie brauchen. Rund 80 Mitarbeitende, tausende Kundinnen und Kunden in ganz Europa, vom kleinen Team bis zum Großunternehmen. Ein Produkt, an dem Menschen wirklich hängen. Wir sind seit 12 Jahren am Markt, etabliert, wachsen und sind solide mit Wagniskapital finanziert.

Worum es geht

Du machst Outbound. Zu 100 %, und vor allem am Telefon.

Du bekommst Zielaccounts aus Branchen, die wir vorab festlegen, findest dort die Menschen, die das Problem tatsächlich haben, rufst sie an — und buchst qualifizierte Erstgespräche für unsere Account Executives. Nach dem Handover übernimmt der AE. Dein Ergebnis ist das stattgefundene, qualifizierte Gespräch, nicht der Abschluss und nicht der Kalendereintrag.

Der größte Teil unseres Geschäfts sind kleine und mittlere Unternehmen, dazu kommt ein solider Anteil Mid-Market. Innerhalb der Verticals, die für uns nachweislich funktionieren, gehen wir gelegentlich auch in größere Organisationen. Damit es keine Missverständnisse gibt: „Enterprise" heißt bei uns Unternehmen mit einigen hundert bis wenigen tausend Mitarbeitenden — nicht DAX-Konzern mit zweijährigem Beschaffungsprozess und Rahmenvertragsverhandlung.

Du arbeitest auf Deutsch und auf Englisch, jeden Tag. Deutschland und Großbritannien sind unsere Kernmärkte, weitere europäische Länder kommen situativ dazu.

Dein Umfeld, ehrlich beschrieben: Unser Vertrieb arbeitet heute Full-Funnel. Die Account Executives machen neben allem anderen rund eine Stunde Outbound pro Tag. Dazu kommt eine Kollegin bzw. ein Kollege mit ebenfalls reinem Outbound-Fokus, allerdings auf Kooperationen, Webinare und Partner. Du bist damit die erste Person bei uns, die ausschließlich und direkt auf Neukunden-Erstgespräche geht. Das heißt: Es gibt Erfahrung im Haus, an die du andocken kannst, und ein Playbook, das gerade entsteht. Welche Branchen wir angehen und mit welchen Kampagnen, verantworten unser Head of Sales und unser CRO. Dein Part ist das Gespräch, und was du dort hörst, fließt direkt in die nächste Runde ein.

Aufgaben

  • Telefon ist dein Hauptkanal. Cold Calling ist der Kern der Rolle, nicht ein Kanal unter mehreren. E-Mail und LinkedIn ergänzen die Ansprache

  • Ziellisten aus den Verticals abarbeiten, die Head of Sales und CRO festlegen. Die Listen kommen aufgebaut aus Clay und Cognism. Du priorisierst innerhalb der Liste und bereitest jeden Account kurz vor, bevor du anrufst

  • Kampagnen und Sequenzen in Lemlist setzen Head of Sales und CRO auf. Du führst sie aus und passt deinen Gesprächseinstieg im Call an dein Gegenüber an. Lemlist ist dein täglicher Arbeitsplatz, Clay und Cognism füttern ihn

  • Erstgespräche buchen, sauber vorbereiten und mit belastbarem Kontext an die Account Executives übergeben

  • Zurückspielen, was du im Markt hörst: welche Branche reagiert, welche Botschaft funktioniert, welche Einwände wiederkehren. Marketing und Sales-Leitung brauchen das

  • HubSpot sauber und aktuell halten — nicht als Selbstzweck, sondern weil Pipeline-Bewertung und Forecast darauf beruhen.

  • Enge Abstimmung mit Marketing und den AEs zu Kampagnen und Übergabekriterien

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 1,5 Jahre Outbound-Erfahrung im B2B, idealerweise SaaS oder erklärungsbedürftige IT-Lösungen. Du musst nicht alles gesehen haben, aber du solltest den Job kennen und nicht bei null anfangen — ein spürbarer Teil dieser Zeit sollte am Telefon stattgefunden haben und nicht nur in Sequenzen. Das ist keine Einstiegsposition.

  • Deutsch verhandlungssicher auf muttersprachnahem Niveau (C2), Englisch mindestens C1. Beides täglich. Der Maßstab ist das Telefonat: Du führst auf Englisch ein Kaltgespräch, reagierst auf Einwände und hältst den Small Talk davor und danach aus, ohne dass die Sprache zum Thema wird. Wir hören uns das im Prozess an.

  • Du kannst nachvollziehbar erklären, warum deine Ansprache funktioniert hat — mit Zahlen und mit einer Begründung, nicht mit Bauchgefühl.

  • Du kommst mit Geschäftsführerinnen und Inhabern zurecht. Im Mittelstand hast du häufig direkt die Person am Telefon, die entscheidet — und die dir drei Minuten gibt, bevor sie wieder in den Betrieb muss. Erst in größeren Häusern sprichst du mit Fachbereichsleitungen und gelegentlich mit der IT.

  • Recherchefähigkeit: Du findest heraus, wer in einem Unternehmen ein Problem hat, bevor du zum Hörer greifst.

  • Selbstorganisation: Du strukturierst deine Woche selbst und brauchst keine tägliche Ansage, um in die Aktivität zu kommen.

  • Ein realistisches Verhältnis zu Ablehnung. Der größte Teil deiner Versuche führt zu nichts. Das ist normal und sollte dich weder überraschen noch aus der Ruhe bringen.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit CRM und Sales-Engagement-Tools. Unser Stack ist HubSpot, Lemlist, Clay und Cognism — genau diese Tools musst du nicht kennen, vergleichbare schon.

  • Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit KI-Tools. Recherche verdichten, Textvarianten durchspielen, ein Unternehmen vor dem Call in fünf Minuten verstehen — das geht heute schneller, wenn man weiß wie. Wir erwarten keine Zertifikate, aber auch niemanden, der ChatGPT einmal ausprobiert und wieder weggelegt hat.

  • Von Vorteil: Du hast schon aktiv nach Großbritannien akquiriert und kennst den Unterschied im Gesprächseinstieg. Ebenfalls hilfreich: Erfahrung mit Low-Code/No-Code-, ERP-, CRM- oder Datenbankthemen.

Formale Abschlüsse sind uns weniger wichtig als belastbare Outbound-Praxis. Wenn du das kannst, interessiert uns dein Studienfach nicht.

Benefits

Was wir bieten

  • 60.000 – 70.000 € Zieljahresgehalt (OTE) bei einem Split von 70 % Fixum und 30 % variabel. Der variable Anteil hängt an Kriterien, die du beeinflussen kannst, und ist erreichbar geplant. Den Plan legen wir vor Vertragsunterschrift offen.

  • Strukturierter Einstieg: Produkt, ICP, Einwände und Gesprächsleitfäden in den ersten Wochen — plus regelmäßige 1:1s und Call-Reviews statt Zurufmanagement.

  • Kurze Wege. Du berichtest an Tim Genkinger, unseren Head of Sales, und hast direkten Zugang zu den Menschen, die über Produkt und Go-to-Market entscheiden.

  • 30 Urlaubstage, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, BVG-Ticket und weitere Benefits.

  • Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro am Monbijouplatz in Berlin-Mitte.

  • Ein Stack, der die Arbeit tatsächlich trägt: HubSpot als CRM, Lemlist für Sequenzen, Clay für Listenaufbau und Anreicherung, Cognism für belastbare Telefonnummern. Dazu KI-Assistenz als fester Teil des Arbeitsalltags, bei uns Claude, für Recherche, Textvarianten und Call-Vorbereitung. Du verbringst deine Zeit mit Gesprächen und nicht mit der Suche nach Durchwahlen. Fehlt im Stack etwas, reden wir darüber.

  • Ein Unternehmen, klein genug, dass deine Ergebnisse sichtbar sind, und groß genug, dass sie etwas bewegen.

Was diese Rolle nicht ist

  • Kein Inbound. Anfragen aus Produkt und Marketing laufen an anderer Stelle. Es gibt keine eingehenden Leads und keine Messelisten zum Nachfassen.

  • Kein Closing. Angebot, Verhandlung und Abschluss liegen bei den AEs. Die Stelle ist als Outbound-Rolle ausgeschrieben, nicht als Durchgangsstation — wohin es danach geht, entscheidet sich über Ergebnisse und nicht über eine Zusage im Bewerbungsgespräch.

  • Keine Führungsrolle. Du baust kein Team auf und führst niemanden.

  • Keine reine Remote-Rolle. Wir hätten dich gern etwa zwei Tage pro Woche im Büro, im Haus sind das meist Dienstag bis Donnerstag. Mehr ist willkommen, weniger im Einzelfall auch machbar. Berlin als Lebensmittelpunkt setzen wir voraus.

  • Kein Produkt, das sich von selbst erklärt. Ninox ist keine Wissenschaft — in einer Demo versteht fast jeder, was es tut. Der Aufhänger liegt trotzdem nie im Produkt, sondern beim Gegenüber: das Excel-Konstrukt, das niemand mehr pflegen kann, die Standardsoftware, die nicht passt. Darauf musst du Lust haben.

Bewerbung

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätze zu einer Ansprache, die funktioniert hat: wen du angesprochen hast, warum genau so, was dabei herauskam und was du daraus für den nächsten Versuch mitgenommen hast. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht.

Unser Prozess besteht aus drei Terminen:

  1. Erstgespräch mit Tim Genkinger, Head of Sales und Hiring Manager dieser Rolle.

  2. Case Study. Du bekommst vorab eine Aufgabe und stellst sie Tim und Michael Blazek, unserem CRO, vor. Teile davon führen wir auf Englisch.

  3. Meet the Team. Du lernst die Kolleginnen und Kollegen kennen, mit denen du täglich arbeiten wirst.

Danach entscheiden wir. Wir halten den Prozess bewusst kurz und melden uns bei jeder Bewerbung zurück, auch bei einer Absage.

Ninox steht für ein Arbeitsumfeld ohne Diskriminierung. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht, Alter, Religion, Behinderung oder sexueller Identität.

  • Support data migration, reconciliations, systems setup, and integration coordination

  • Track milestones, drive follow-through, and keep internal and external stakeholders aligned throughout the onboarding process

  • Hands-on ERP experience (NetSuite, SAP, Workday, etc.), including requirements, configuration, data migration, and go-live

  • Strong understanding of core accounting workflows (close, reconciliations, ASC 606) and how they translate into systems

  • Customer-facing with strong communication and stakeholder management skills

  • Systems-minded with solid project management skills; able to run multiple workstreams

  • Comfortable in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and highly detail-oriented

title: Software Engineer (Data)
description:
Our Mission

We’re not your average benefits platform – we’re the driving force that uplifts people’s lives. Our technology connects the entire benefits ecosystem, creating better outcomes for employers, employees, brokers, and providers.

Our mission is clear: to build a world where everything works at its best, ensuring every employee gets the support they need to thrive—both at work and beyond.

Your Mission

As our Software Engineer (Data), you’ll build and run the pipelines, orchestration, and infrastructure that move data across Ben: in from our product and the tools we use, in from our customers, and back out to them again. It’s the plumbing the whole company and our customers depend on, and it has to stay reliable. We serve global enterprise customers with strict security and reliability requirements.

You’ll own real work from day one. You’ll have a strong team of cross functional engineers alongside you, room to grow into harder problems, and the freedom to do the job your way.

What you’ll be working on

  • Own everything that flows into Ben: build and maintain the ingestion pipelines that bring data into our warehouse, with Fivetran for managed sources and custom pipelines where we need them.

  • Keep everything running on time: own the orchestration that keeps data moving on schedule and recovers cleanly when something breaks.

  • Scale and manage our data infrastructure: build and manage our data infrastructure as code with Terraform, using mainly AWS services.

  • Connect Ben to every system our customers run: build enterprise-grade pipelines and connectors for our customers, bringing their data in, for example from HR and payroll systems, and getting accurate data back out to them, reliably and securely, even at the volumes large customers bring.

  • Build the data layer our agents act on: help connect our data to the AI agents and services we're building, including through MCP connectors, so they get the right context at the right time.

  • Shape what we build: work with product and other stakeholders to scope problems and agree on simple but scalable solutions.

  • Build it to enterprise standard: build to current security practice, for example the OWASP Top 10 and the AWS Well-Architected Framework.

Behind the scenes

Ben runs on Python 3, Django, PostgreSQL, and React, on AWS.

Our data platform today is built around Fivetran, AWS DMS or custom pipelines for ingestion, dbt for transformation, PostgreSQL on AWS RDS as the warehouse, and n8n or AWS Lambda for automation between systems. We manage our infrastructure as code with Terraform and use different AWS services depending on requirements.

We have adopted frontier level agentic development practices and continue to push the envelope of what’s possible with current technologies.

Your skills and experience

  • Strong experience with Python and SQL.

  • A few years building and running production data pipelines that other people relied on.

  • Comfortable with infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform, and hands-on with AWS, for example Lambda, ECS, Glue, S3, RDS.

  • A good grasp of ETL/ELT and orchestration.

  • Experience building or running data integrations and connectors, especially ones that other companies or customers depend on, is a real plus.

  • Solid software engineering fundamentals: clean code, sensible design, and tests you can rely on.

  • You keep security in mind when you build applications and configure infrastructure, and you know what enterprise customers expect of their data.

Nice to have, not essential:

  • Experience working on customer-facing data integrations such as HRIS or payroll feeds via SFTP and in EDI format

  • Experience with MCP server development, or different ways of preparing data for AI agents such as ontology modelling, context, knowledge graphs, and semantic layers.

We don't expect all of it. We do expect curiosity about it.

Why join us?

Ben's customers are large enterprise employers, and the hundreds of thousands of people who work for them rely on us to get their benefits right, every time. That depends on data moving accurately between their systems and ours, every cycle. You get to work on the data infrastructure that makes this run like clockwork.

At the same time, Ben is an AI-native organisation. Agents are already doing a lot of impactful work here, and they can only do it on data they can trust. That raises questions a dashboard never had to answer. How fresh does this need to be for an agent to act on it? How do you match the same entity across tools? How do you control what an agent is allowed to see? Very few engineers have answered those in production. You'd be one of them.

You'll take ownership of large, complex problem spaces, help design how they scale, and build an agentic layer few engineers have built anywhere yet, and you'll see the impact of it: Ben supports hundreds of thousands of people across 30+ countries.

You'll work directly with Paddy, our co-founder, with the freedom to try things fast and the backing to scale what works

  • Growth mechanisms: Lead magnets, micro products, tools and campaigns that bring syndicate leads and fund managers to Odin. You build the actual thing with AI, not a strategy deck about it. Think a calculator every new fund manager bookmarks, or a tool that turns a syndicate lead's first deal into a week's work instead of a month's. Ship it, see what works, double down.

  • Events: Pitch nights, GP-LP mixers and founder dinners for a community that backs everything from AI labs to small nuclear reactors. You'll turn that into new customers.

About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health. 

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US. 

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.


Role overview

As Performance Marketing Manager – Paid Social, you will own Hilo’s paid social strategy and performance across our key markets and prepare the channel for Hilo’s next stage of growth. Creative strategy is a core driver of paid social performance: You turn customer insight and campaign data into compelling concepts, run a rigorous testing program and work with creative partners to bring the strongest ideas to market.

You connect that work to measurable business outcomes, improving conversion and return on investment while making sure every health claim is accurate and approved.

Reporting to the Head of Performance Marketing, you will play a key role in our performance marketing team, working with internal teams and external partners to drive growth.

Work location: Our company operates on a remote-first model. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in Europe. Fluent English and German are a must. Occasional travel to our office in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, or to team events may be required.

Core responsibilities

  • Lead paid social strategy, planning and execution across the US, UK, Germany and other growth markets.
  • Develop creative hypotheses based on customer research, market differences and performance data.
  • Brief, test and refine ad concepts, messages, formats and landing pages in partnership with creative and product teams.
  • Manage campaign budgets, audiences and optimisation across Meta, TikTok and other relevant platforms.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey and conversion rate, from ad click through to purchase.
  • Measure performance against acquisition cost, revenue and return on investment and turn findings into clear decisions and next steps.
  • Work with clinical, regulatory and legal colleagues to ensure advertising claims and health messaging are accurate and approved.
  • Steer agencies and freelancers, set clear priorities and ensure high-quality execution and continuous performance improvement.

Requirements

Background & Experience

  • At least 5 years of hands-on paid social experience in an international setting, including direct ownership of campaigns and budgets.
  • Strong creative strategy skills and a track record of turning insights into ads that perform.
  • A data-driven approach to testing, measurement, and decision-making.
  • Experience improving conversion rates and managing campaigns against ROI goals.
  • Deep knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and experience with other relevant social platforms.
  • Ability to adapt messaging and execution across markets while keeping the brand consistent.
  • Clear communication and sound judgment when working with sensitive health topics.
  • Nice to have: experience in health tech, medical devices, wearables, or subscription products.

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do: 

Move the Needle — You focus on what truly drives impact for our customers and company. You use data and clarity to guide your decisions and prioritize what matters most. You push boundaries with bold, thoughtful innovation and hold yourself accountable for results.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with high quality. You treat mistakes as learning opportunities, experiment thoughtfully and iterate quickly. You take ownership, act hands-on and always look for smarter, faster ways to get things done, including leveraging AI and new tools.

Team First — You put the team above individual interests, building trust through openness and respect. You encourage healthy debate, challenge directly while caring personally and stand behind team decisions. You act as an owner, stepping in when needed and doing what’s necessary for the team’s success.

Why Join Us?

  • Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies and you can be part of this exciting story.
  • Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
  • Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
  • Collaborate with a diverse, passionate and talented team.
  • Competitive compensation, equity program and other benefits (depending on location).

Ready to Move the Needle?

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

Kraken’s technology is written and maintained by a multi-discipline engineering team of around 1,400 people globally, which includes server-side, client-side, and mobile engineers. We follow an agile way of working, where individual teams are given the freedom to choose the tools that are most appropriate for managing their work.

Kraken is a great place to learn, work with talented engineers and level-up your skills. Some of our coding conventions are open-source.

 

Our technology

Our backend developers use Python. Most of our websites are powered by Django and GraphQL (Graphene). Our CircleCI CI/CD pipeline runs tens of thousands of tests, deploying into AWS EKS defined by Terraform over 100 times per day and observed with tools like Sentry and Datadog. This allows us to move fast and at scale, without compromising reliability. Teams work differently but the commitment to quality is the same.

Developers at Kraken are empowered to use cutting-edge AI tools and models. Any generated code is still owned by a human.

 

What we do

Kraken Engineering has multiple disciplinary groups with their own management structures and teams working together to create a unified Kraken that can be deployed to any territory in the world to achieve clients’ goals.

Client Engineering is the development arm responsible for making sure our clients receive the best possible experience and their needs are met with high quality solutions.

 

🚀 What you’ll own

  • We have lots of difficult design challenges to solve. The French energy market is complicated, outdated and process-heavy - there's an awful lot of domain modelling that we need to get right. Strong attention to detail is essential.

  • You will be working in a multi-disciplinary software engineering team; solving design challenges; domain modeling; solving technical problems; engineering solutions for smart meters, writing robust fault-tolerant software primarily in Python and Django, Celery, and async processing

  • We have challenging technical problems to solve; like processing tens of millions of meter readings a day. We need the right technology in place to handle this smoothly as well as feeding data into a machine learning pipeline that models and predicts consumption. Or thinking about how we adapt Kraken to improve other utilities like water and broadband.

  • There's a great opportunity for disruption in the French energy market. The big suppliers still dominate, but are not exactly popular. The energy landscape is changing as we move to more dis-aggregated forms of generation, with less predictability, more dynamism and smarter technology.

🧠 What you bring to the party

  • Python (minimum 7 y.e.)

  • Django (or equiv. web framework)

  • Fluent in French, and level B2 at least in English

  • Domain modelling

  • HTTP and REST APIs

  • Writing robust and fault-tolerant software

  • Celery and async processing

  • Postgres

⭐️ Bonus points

  • AWS

  • Terraform, Packer, Consul

  • React and Redux

description:
About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we combine patient-derived tumor models, experimental drug screening and computational modelling to improve oncology drug development. Our research brings together functional treatment-response measurements, molecular profiles and clinical information where available, creating opportunities to investigate how experimental responses translate into patient outcomes. Our platforms are designed to help anticipate clinical trial outcomes, evaluate therapies and identify new therapeutic opportunities.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalised. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

About the Role

We are looking for an Alliance & Delivery Manager to own Orakl's pharma partnerships after signature: the partner relationship, the delivery of each research program, and the growth of each account.

Orakl runs research programs for pharmaceutical companies on its virtual patient cohorts, combining compound screening, multi-omics and O-Predict analyses on the partner's assets. Several programs run in parallel on the same wet-lab and dry-lab teams, and the portfolio is growing. Delivery quality directly drives renewals and follow-on contracts.

This is a high-ownership, partner-facing role. You are the partner's main contact, you are accountable for delivery across our wet-lab and dry-lab teams, and you grow existing accounts. You will also scale our delivery processes and tooling: project tracking, capacity planning and partner reporting, automated wherever possible.

You will work closely with the Scientific Program & Operations Lead, Business Development, the Wet Lab, Data Science and Computational Biology leads, and Product. As the ideal candidate, you have already delivered complex scientific programs for pharma clients, and you are an expert at establishing partner trust.

What You'll Do

Own partner relationships: act as the main point of contact for each pharma partner from kick-off to final delivery. Map decision-makers, priorities and expectations for their asset, run the steering committees, attend key international conferences a few times per year and present results alongside our scientific teams.

Lead program delivery: translate each signed contract into an executable plan for the Wet Lab and Dry Lab teams, with owners, milestones and deliverables. Own the timeline, coordinate the experimental and computational work, and ensure every deliverable passes internal QC and review before it reaches the partner.

Manage capacity across programs: plan capacity with the Wet Lab and Dry Lab leads, arbitrate conflicts between programs and protect committed timelines. Centralise requests on delivery teams coming from partners and Business Development.

Manage risk and change: anticipate delivery risks, including results that change the plan, and escalate to the Scientific Program & Operations Lead with a recommendation. Agree and document scope and timeline changes with partners.

Scale delivery processes and tooling: scale our project management system in Asana, from program templates and timelines to portfolio and capacity views. Automate reporting and follow-up, deploy AI tools where they remove manual work, and document how we run programs.

Grow existing accounts: identify, qualify and convert follow-on opportunities within existing partnerships. Work with Business Development on scoping, proposals and pricing, and provide a feasibility assessment before anything is committed.

Plan scientific and BD materials: schedule conference and BD material cycles as part of the delivery plan, and coordinate partner approvals for any communication based on partnered programs.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4+ years in project management, alliance and/or account management, or partner delivery in biotech, pharma, a CRO or a techbio.

  • Master's degree in a scientific or engineering field. A PhD is a strong plus.

  • Demonstrated delivery of complex scientific programs: you have led multidisciplinary projects from plan to final deliverable, including when results reshaped the plan.

  • Pharma-facing experience: you have managed pharma stakeholders through steering committees, negative results and scope negotiations.

  • Commercial track record: you have identified and converted follow-on opportunities within existing accounts.

  • Hands-on systems building: you have designed project management systems and automated recurring workflows.

  • Working knowledge of oncology or molecular biology, sufficient to lead scientific discussions with our teams and partners.

  • Fluent in English

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in precision oncology or at a pharma-facing CRO.

  • Familiarity with patient-derived tumor models, omics or drug screening.

  • Scripting (Python) or experience deploying automation and AI tools.

  • Experience working with SOWs and contracts.

  • Professional French.

Who You Are

  • An owner: you take responsibility for outcomes across teams you do not manage, and you make explicit trade-offs when programs compete.

  • Scientifically fluent: you understand what a result means for the partner's asset before you plan around it.

  • Steady under pressure: you replan quickly if the data changes, and you deliver difficult news to partners clearly and early.

  • A builder: you treat every recurring manual task as something to standardise or automate.

  • Commercially minded: you recognise when a partner's needs extend beyond the signed scope and turn it into a proposal.

Why Join Orakl

  • Own a portfolio of pharma partnerships. Represent Orakl from signature to final delivery, with direct access to partner decision-makers.

  • Work on distinctive science. Deliver programs built on virtual patients cohorts, functional drug screening & multi-omics.

  • Build the delivery model. Design how Orakl runs partnered programs as the portfolio scales.

  • Work across disciplines every day. Alongside the biologists, data scientists and computational biologists who generate the results.

  • Help shape the team. Define the delivery capabilities and future team needs as the partnership portfolio grows.

Interview Process

  1. Hiring Manager Call: align on motivation, role scope and expectations.

  2. Technical Deep Dive: discuss a pharma program you delivered: the plan, the problems, how you managed the partner and the outcome.

  3. Delivery Case: using an anonymised, representative scenario, build a plan, triage issues and prepare a steering committee. Present it to the team.

  4. Reference Call: speak with one or two people who have seen you manage partners and deliver programs.

  5. Founder Interview: discuss Orakl's partnership strategy and mutual ambitions.

title: Manufacturing Engineer - Industrialization & Production
description:
Sunflower Labs is an internationally operating company providing a fully autonomous, AI-powered drone security system built to protect commercial, industrial, and residential properties. Security that flies ahead of every threat.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Manufacturing Engineer to join our Manufacturing team and act as the technical bridge between R&D and Production.

You will take ownership of released product data and turn it into stable, documented, and efficient production processes. This includes DFM/DFA review, production readiness, assembly instructions and SOPs, tooling and test-process support, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.

We are seeking you, a professional with a strong foundation in manufacturing electronic or electromechanical products, hands-on technical troubleshooting, and practical programming or scripting used in production or test environments. Experience with robotics, autonomous systems, or similarly complex hardware is a plus.

Your Responsibilities

R&D to Production / Industrialization :

  • Own the transfer of released products, revisions, BOMs, drawings, specifications, and technical data from R&D into production.

  • Perform DFM/DFA reviews and identify issues affecting manufacturability, assembly, testing, quality, cost, or cycle time.

  • Provide structured manufacturing feedback to mechanical and electrical teams.

  • Define production readiness and ensure engineering changes are correctly implemented on the production floor.

  • Support New Product Introduction (NPI) and transition prototypes into repeatable production.

Production Documentation & Daily Support :

  • Create, approve, and continuously maintain assembly instructions, SOPs, test instructions, inspection instructions, and rework procedures.

  • Ensure production documentation always matches the latest released product revision.

  • Provide day-to-day technical support to technicians and remove process or tooling-related production blockers.

  • Troubleshoot assembly, test, fixture, tooling, and configuration issues and drive root-cause resolution.

  • Work with R&D when production issues require design, software, test, or documentation changes.

Tooling, Lean & Continuous Improvement :

  • Develop, improve, and maintain production fixtures, jigs, test setups, tools, and supporting scripts.

  • Improve assembly sequence, workstation layout, standard work, material flow, and production methods.

  • Reduce rework, waiting time, manual workarounds, process variation, and cycle time.

  • Apply Lean Manufacturing principles such as 5S, standard work, visual management, and continuous improvement.

Requirements

  • Several years of hands-on experience in manufacturing engineering, production engineering, industrialization, NPI, or a similar role.

  • Practical experience manufacturing and troubleshooting electronic or electromechanical products.

  • Strong understanding of assembly processes, production tooling, fixtures, testing, and manufacturing documentation.

  • Ability to independently review drawings, tolerances, BOMs, specifications, and released engineering data.

  • Practical knowledge of DFM/DFA, root-cause analysis, and structured problem solving.

  • Programming or scripting skills sufficient to understand, modify, and debug production or test tools; Python or similar is a strong fit.

  • Experience creating and maintaining assembly instructions, SOPs, and controlled production documentation.

  • Ability to work independently across R&D and Production and take ownership of manufacturing readiness.

  • Good spoken and written English.

  • EU/EFTA citizenship or a valid Swiss work permit.

Nice to have :

  • Experience with robotics, drones, aerospace, automotive, or other complex hardware products.

  • Experience with both mechanical and electrical assemblies and production test systems.

  • Experience designing production fixtures, jigs, or test equipment.

  • Experience with FMEA, 8D, 5 Why, Lean, 5S, or Kaizen.

  • Experience with ERP/MRP or PLM systems such as Odoo, Aligni, or similar tools.

  • Basic German.

Benefits

  • Flexibility to work from home when tasks allow, without fixed weekly work-from-home days.

  • Comprehensive training on products and production procedures.

  • Hands-on experience with advanced drone and robotics technology.

  • On-site parking, occasional team lunches, and team events.

title: Flight Test Instrumentation & Data Engineer
description:
The Flight Test Instrumentation (FTI) & Data Engineer will be responsible for the end-to-end handling, quality assurance, accessibility, and long-term management of all flight data. The primary objective is to ensure that full-aircraft data, from the onboard sensors and DAQ systems to the final processing tools, is available to every engineering team through a reliable, efficient, and standardized workflow.

Tasks

Flight Test Instrumentation (FTI) & DAQ Pipeline

  • Manage the data pipeline from the physical sensor and Data Acquisition (DAQ) level for the full aircraft, ensuring seamless and accurate transmission into the telemetry and storage systems.
  • Maintain sensor configuration, calibration records, and metadata to guarantee the accurate translation of raw physical signals into usable engineering units.
  • Collaborate with hardware, software and integration teams to define sensor requirements, DAQ architectures, scaling, and telemetry bandwidth allocations.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve data anomalies at the DAQ and sensor level (e.g., signal noise, dropouts, faulty scaling) before they propagate into downstream databases.

Data Infrastructure & Accessibility

  • Maintain reliable extraction of flight data from InfluxDB.
  • Develop and maintain standardized local data structures for analysis, plotting, and visualization.
  • Optimize access to large flight datasets while minimizing CPU and memory usage.
  • Design and maintain an efficient local storage solution for processed flight data.
  • Support future improvements to the flight data architecture as storage requirements, sensor counts, and analysis needs continue to evolve.

Data Quality & Analysis Support

  • Maintain derived datasets to ensure common calculations and signals are shared consistently across teams.
  • Ensure strict timing synchronization and timestamp accuracy across all recorded data, from the sensor acquisition point to the database.
  • Monitor data quality, completeness, and integrity throughout the entire pipeline.
  • Provide fast data previews for rapid post-flight reviews.
  • Enable efficient access to high-frequency sensor data for detailed engineering investigations.
  • Support custom querying of processed datasets.

Requirements

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 3+ years of professional experience in test instrumentation, data acquisition (DAQ), or sensor-to-database time-series data engineering (aerospace, automotive, or racing/motorsports preferred).
  • Hands-on experience working directly with physical aircraft/vehicle sensor installations, DAQ hardware, and telemetry pipelines.

Technical & Domain Expertise

1. Hardware, Sensors & DAQ Architecture

  • Strong understanding of physical sensors (e.g., strain gauges, accelerometers, thermocouples, pressure transducers, RTDs, LVDTs, pitot-static tubes).
  • Demonstrated knowledge of signal conditioning, sampling rate selection, anti-aliasing filtering, scaling, and sensor calibration procedures.

2. Data Infrastructure & Software Development

  • Proficient in Python or MATLAB for data analysis, automated data processing, and visualization library development (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, SciPy).
  • Experience working with time-series databases, specifically InfluxDB (or similar engines), including writing efficient queries (Flux/InfluxQL) and data retrieval pipelines.
  • Solid foundation in data structures and memory/CPU optimization when handling high-memory high-frequency continuous time-series datasets.

3. Data Integrity & Signal Processing

  • Experience with timestamping and clock synchronization protocols across distributed DAQ hardware and storage nodes.
  • Knowledge of basic digital signal processing (DSP) concepts (filtering, FFT, spectral analysis, decimation/resampling).

Soft Skills & Work Style

  • Cross-functional communication: Ability to bridge the gap between hardware technicians, flight physics/aerodynamics engineers, and software teams.
  • Detail-oriented mindset: Uncompromising rigor regarding calibration metadata, unit conversions, and data accuracy.
  • Adaptability: Drive to continuously improve data infrastructure as aircraft sensor counts, test frequencies, and analytical needs expand.

Preferred / Bonus Qualifications

  • Knowledge of standard FAA / EASA flight test instrumentation requirements or military flight test standards (e.g. IRIG 106).
  • Familiarity with dashboarding tools (e.g., Grafana) for rapid post-flight previews and real-time telemetry display.
  • Experience with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD pipelines for internal engineering tool distribution.
  • Direct experience with DAQ systems and digital bus protocols (CAN bus, ARINC 429, MIL-STD-1553, Ethernet/UDP, PCM).
  • Familiarity with binary flight data formats (e.g., IRIG 106 Chapter 10/11, MDF/MF4, HDF5, Parquet, or custom binary loggers).
  • Experience with performing on-aircraft hardware troubleshooting (e.g., tracking down ground loops, signal noise, dropouts, or faulty scaling).

Reliability & Maintenance Engineer | DSL-01

As Reliability & Maintenance Engineer DSL-01, you are responsible for building and continuously improving the facility's maintenance, reliability, and asset integrity framework. Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you help ensure the plant operates safely, reliably, and efficiently.

The role starts with a strong Maintenance Engineering focus. Your priority will be to help establish the maintenance and reliability foundation of DSL-01 by answering a fundamental question: "how do we maintain our assets safely, reliably, and efficiently throughout their lifecycle?"

You will translate reliability studies, equipment criticality assessments, and integrity requirements into practical maintenance plans, inspection programmes, spare parts strategies, and asset management processes.

As the facility moves into stable operations, the focus gradually shifts towards Reliability Engineering, where you will use asset health monitoring, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement to prevent failures and improve long-term asset performance.

Working closely with operations, maintenance, engineering, and external specialists, you will help reduce technical risk and improve asset reliability from day one.

You will:

  • Develop and continuously improve maintenance, inspection, and asset integrity strategies

  • Translate reliability studies, FMECA analyses, and engineering data into practical maintenance plans within the CMMS/EAM system

  • Act as owner of the asset register from a maintenance, reliability, and integrity perspective

  • Support the implementation and continuous development of the facility's CMMS/EAM system

  • Drive reliability improvements through asset health monitoring, KPI analysis, and predictive maintenance techniques

  • Lead Root Cause Analyses (RCA) and implement sustainable corrective actions

  • Monitor and improve reliability performance indicators such as MTBF, MTTR, availability, and inspection compliance

  • Support asset improvement, modification, and long-term replacement strategies throughout the asset lifecycle

Your profile

As a growing company in a rapidly evolving industry, we are looking for people who embrace change and are motivated to actively contribute to building and scaling our business. About DSL-01

DSL-01 is SkyNRG’s frontrunning renewable fuels facility in Delfzijl, Netherlands. The plant will produce Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) from residual fats and greases using the HEFA (Hydrotreated Esters and Fatty Acids) pathway, with additional renewable products like butane, propane, and naphtha as by-products.

DSL-01 is the first facility in Europe dedicated entirely to SAF and its by-products. Once operational, it will produce 100,000 tonnes of SAF and 35,000 tonnes of sustainable by-products per year, cutting greenhouse gas emissions by around 80% compared to conventional jet fuel.

Construction started in 2026, with first fuel expected in 2028. The project includes the main facility, pipelines, and temporary work areas. At DSL-01, you will be part of a team building a state-of-the-art industrial plant from the ground up, contributing to a truly sustainable energy future.

  • Help je mee de supply chain-organisatie van DSL-01 op te bouwen, inclusief de processen, systemen en werkwijzen die nodig zijn voor operational readiness.

  • Draag je bij aan de inrichting van ERP-systemen, supply chain-processen en de voorbereiding van een veilige, betrouwbare en efficiënte operatie.

Na de start van de fabriek:

  • Speel je een belangrijke rol in de dagelijkse supply chain-operatie, van grondstoffen- en productieplanning tot afstemming met leveranciers en afnemers.

  • Zorg je samen met interne en externe stakeholders voor een stabiele supply chain die een veilige en continue productie ondersteunt.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Ontwikkelen en onderhouden van productie-, supply- en offtakeplanningen voor de korte, middellange en lange termijn.

  • Vertalen van productiebehoeften naar materiaalvereisten en afstemmen van beschikbaarheid met leveranciers, Procurement en sourcing-teams.

Jouw profiel

Je bent analytisch sterk, neemt eigenaarschap en voelt je comfortabel in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt. Je bent in staat verschillende belangen bij elkaar te brengen en durft beslissingen te nemen wanneer informatie beperkt of onvolledig is.

  • Een sterk begrip van supply chain-processen en ERP-systemen.

  • Uitstekende analytische vaardigheden en het vermogen om inzichten te vertalen naar acties en besluitvorming.

  • Een proactieve, resultaatgerichte houding en een sterk gevoel van eigenaarschap.

  • Ervaring met stakeholdermanagement in een complexe operationele omgeving.

  • Het vermogen om prioriteiten te stellen en beslissingen te nemen onder onzekerheid.

  • Goede beheersing van Nederlands en Engels.

  • Ervaring met het opstarten van nieuwe productielocaties of operationele organisaties.

Over DSL-01

In Delfzijl bouwen we aan DSL-01, een fabriek van SkyNRG voor hernieuwbare brandstoffen. Hier produceren we Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) uit reststromen zoals gebruikte vetten en oliën, met HEFA-technologie. Daarnaast maken we bijproducten zoals butaan, propaan en nafta.

DSL-01 wordt de eerste fabriek in Europa die volledig gericht is op SAF en bijbehorende duurzame bijproducten. Als de fabriek in bedrijf is, produceren we jaarlijks 100.000 ton SAF en 35.000 ton bijproducten. Daarmee verminderen we de uitstoot van broeikasgassen met circa 80% ten opzichte van fossiele kerosine, gemeten over de hele keten.

De bouw is gestart in 2026 en de eerste productie staat gepland voor 2028. Het project omvat de fabriek zelf, bijbehorende leidingen en tijdelijke werkterreinen. Je draagt direct bij aan de realisatie van een nieuwe industriële fabriek en de verduurzaming van de luchtvaart.

We werken volgens internationale standaarden en Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving om de impact op mens, natuur en omgeving zorgvuldig te beheersen. Veiligheid, duurzaamheid en samenwerking staan daarbij centraal.

The System Architect for Intelligent Building Management Solutions and Industrial Automation plays a crucial role in designing integrated automation solutions for both buildings and industrial processes.   • Gas safety and process safety: Develop solutions for gas detection, emergency shutdowns, ventilation integration, and fail-safe control systems for industrial environments.

  • Specification and standards management: Implement relevant standards for intelligent building management solutions, process automation, and safety systems, such as IEC 61511 (functional safety) and ATEX regulations.

  • Process optimization: Analyze and optimize industrial processes and systems to enhance efficiency, safety, and sustainability.

  • Stakeholder management: Collaborate effectively with various stakeholders, including clients, end-users, engineers, and project managers, ensuring solutions meet both functional and technical requirements.

  • Continuous learning and development: Stay updated on the latest innovations in smart technologies and automation, applying these to develop improved, future-proof solutions. • Technological consulting: Identify innovations to enhance performance and reliability in intelligent buildings and industrial environments.

  • Documentation and communication: Prepare technical documentation and communicate effectively with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders.

Required Skills and Competencies:

  • Extensive knowledge of intelligent building management solutions, gas safety systems, and industrial process control.

  • Expertise in communication standards and protocols such as KNX, BACnet, Modbus, OPC UA, and PROFIBUS.

  • Proficiency in designing fail-safe systems and safety-critical applications.

  • Experience with IT networks and cybersecurity in automation environments.

  • Strong analytical skills and problem-solving abilities.

  • Flexibility and the ability to continuously adapt to technological advancements.

  • Excellent communication skills to clearly present complex technical issues

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automation Technology, or a related field.

  • Relevant experience in intelligent building management solutions, industrial automation, and safety-critical systems. This role combines technological innovation with safety-critical applications. As a System Architect, you will develop integrated solutions that maximize comfort, safety, efficiency, and sustainability in both buildings and industrial processes.

We offer 

  • A position of 32-40 hours per week with a salary to match. 

  • Challenging projects for leading clients in the Netherlands and internationally. 

  • A work environment in which innovation and sustainability are put into practice daily. 

  • Attention to your own development and vitality with ample training and development opportunities, bicycle and sports arrangements, flexible working hours, 33 vacation days and the possibility of purchasing additional days.

Many of our offices are located near public transport hubs, cycling is encouraged, and your travel expenses are reimbursed 100% on the basis of public transport.

As an independent engineering firm, Deerns specializes in consultancy, design and implementation supervision in the fields of installation engineering, building physics, energy supply and sustainability. title: Hoofdmonteur Warmtepompen
description:
Bij DeWarmte maken we slimme en betaalbare warmtepompen waarmee we woningen van het gas af helpen. We ontwerpen onze producten zelf, assembleren ze in Utrecht en zorgen samen met onze installatiepartners dat ze bij steeds meer mensen thuis komen te staan.

We groeien hard. Tot nu toe worden al onze warmtepompen geïnstalleerd door externe partners, maar daar komt verandering in. We gaan onze eigen installatieteams opbouwen en zoeken daarom een Hoofdmonteur Warmtepompen die hierin het voortouw neemt.

Je bent een ervaren monteur die graag zelf de handen uit de mouwen steekt, maar ook energie krijgt van het begeleiden van anderen. Je gaat samen met je team op pad, bent verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit van de installaties en helpt ons om steeds meer monteurs op te leiden.

Je komt dus niet in een bestaand team terecht. Je helpt het team zelf opbouwen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Hoofdmonteur ben je verantwoordelijk voor de installatie van onze warmtepompen bij klanten thuis. Je begint met het leiden van ons eerste interne installatieteam en helpt ons om de komende jaren onze eigen installatiecapaciteit verder uit te bouwen.

Je installeert warmtepompen en leidt je team

  • Je gaat samen met een collega-monteur op pad om onze warmtepompen bij klanten thuis te installeren.

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de volledige installatie, van de technische uitvoering en het oplossen van onverwachte problemen tot de oplevering.

  • Je zorgt dat installaties veilig, efficiënt en volgens onze kwaliteitsstandaarden worden uitgevoerd.

  • Je bent het aanspreekpunt voor de klant tijdens de installatie. Je legt uit wat jullie doen, beantwoordt vragen en zorgt dat de klant met een goed gevoel achterblijft.

  • Je stemt waar nodig af met onze werkvoorbereiders en collega's op kantoor over planning, materialen en technische uitdagingen.

Je bouwt mee aan ons interne installatieteam

  • Je begeleidt en traint nieuwe monteurs en helpt hen om zelfstandig installaties uit te kunnen voeren.

  • Je denkt mee over het aannemen van nieuwe collega's en hoe we ons installatieteam verder kunnen uitbreiden.

  • Je helpt onze installatiestandaarden en werkwijzen verder te ontwikkelen.

  • Je signaleert wat er in de praktijk beter of slimmer kan en neemt initiatief om dit te verbeteren.

  • Je deelt feedback vanuit het veld met onze engineers, werkvoorbereiders en productontwikkelaars, zodat we onze producten en installaties continu kunnen verbeteren.

Wie zoeken wij?

We zoeken iemand die zijn vak goed verstaat, verantwoordelijkheid neemt en het leuk vindt om anderen beter te maken. Je hoeft niet eerder een heel team te hebben opgebouwd, maar je moet wel zin hebben om die uitdaging aan te gaan.

  • Je hebt ruime ervaring met het installeren van warmtepompen, cv-installaties of andere verwarmingssystemen. Ervaring met warmtepompen heeft een sterke voorkeur.

  • Je hebt een goede technische basis in installatietechniek, elektrotechniek en/of werktuigbouwkunde.

  • Je kunt zelfstandig installaties uitvoeren, technische tekeningen lezen en onverwachte problemen oplossen.

  • Je hebt ervaring met het begeleiden van andere monteurs, of bent klaar om die verantwoordelijkheid op je te nemen.

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en veilig en vindt het belangrijk om goed werk af te leveren.

  • Je communiceert makkelijk met klanten en collega's en kunt technische zaken begrijpelijk uitleggen.

  • Je neemt initiatief, denkt in oplossingen en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor het eindresultaat.

  • Je spreekt goed Nederlands en hebt rijbewijs B.

Een relevante mbo-opleiding en certificeringen zoals VCA, NEN 3140 of CO-vakmanschap zijn mooi meegenomen. Heb je nog niet alle benodigde certificaten? Dan kijken we samen wat je nog kunt behalen.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een salaris van €4.000 tot €6.000 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van je ervaring.

  • Een sleutelrol in ons bedrijf: je wordt de eerste Hoofdmonteur van ons interne installatieteam en helpt dit verder uit te bouwen.

  • Veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid: je krijgt de ruimte om mee te denken over hoe we installeren, samenwerken en nieuwe monteurs opleiden.

  • Goed materiaal: een volledig uitgeruste werkbus en professioneel gereedschap.

  • 26 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV-dagen op basis van 40 uur, met de mogelijkheid om te kiezen voor een hogere beloning in plaats van ADV.

description:

Gain is the Private Markets Super App, a connected global platform transforming how leading investors, advisors, and corporates source, evaluate, and execute deals. Gain operates globally with offices in New York, London, Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Warsaw, and Bangalore.


How we work

  • Predicting what isn't published. Many private companies publish little or no financial detail. Across a database of more than 5 million companies, we predict revenue and EBITDA from sparse labels, and we predict whether and when a company will be bought or sold, which is a time-to-event problem with censored data.

  • Agents on a messy web. Our agents search, navigate and extract company data points from sources that contradict each other, then decide which source to trust before committing to an answer.

  • Quality that holds while everything underneath moves. We're provider-agnostic. Model choices follow the evals, and we switch LLMs when the numbers say so. That only works if the evals are trusted.

What will you do?

The work is roughly half LLM agents and half custom ML, leaning slightly toward agents.

  • The design of our agent pipelines: architecture, tools, and which model for which task. You'll shape the technical direction with our AI Lead.

  • The evaluation behind agents and models: offline reference sets, live production evals, and the call on whether an improvement is real.

  • Our prediction models for financials and deals: features, validation, retraining, and knowing when a simpler model wins.

  • Getting work into production: trace where pipelines fail and fix the weakest links first, with compute, memory and model cost in view.

  • Raising the bar in the team through design reviews, pairing, and an eval-first habit that sticks.

In your first six months you'll own the evals for our agent pipelines, propose where we invest next, and ship measurable improvements to both the agents and the prediction models.

Who are you?

  • You've built and owned ML systems in production for years, typically 6+ in ML or software engineering.

  • In the last 1–2 years you've shipped LLM agents or pipelines that real users depend on, not demos.

  • You have modelling judgement. You've dealt with leakage, distribution shift and calibration on real data.

  • You measure before you claim. You can build an evaluation set and tell an honest improvement from a lucky one.

  • You care about the user outcome more than the technique. Ideas without a clear customer benefit don't get built here, however interesting.

  • Nice to have: time-to-event modelling, noisy or conflicting data sources, financial or private-company data. No finance background needed.

The team

You'll join our Data & AI team of six and report to Renan, our AI Lead who's been building production models for >10 years. Our engineering team runs the infrastructure, and you shape what runs on it.

The stack

  • Core: Python (async, fully typed with Pydantic) and FastAPI

  • LLMs: multiple providers behind our own provider-agnostic layer, with Pydantic AI for typed agents.

  • Evals and observability: Pydantic Evals and Logfire

  • Data: PostgreSQL with pgvector

  • Cloud: GCP (Cloud Run, Cloud Tasks), Docker, GitHub Actions

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. title: Quantitative Researcher - 2027 Graduates
description:
At Graviton, we don't believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge?

As a Quantitative Researcher, you'll work on those questions every day. You'll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly.

This isn't a role where the answers are in a textbook. The problems are open-ended, the data is enormous, and finding the answers is the job.

Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices.

What You'll Work On

You'll work across quantitative research and systematic trading, taking ideas through the full lifecycle: question, hypothesis, experiment, model, validation, strategy, production. Depending on your team and research interests, your work would include:

  • Discovering predictive patterns and sources of alpha from billions of market events
  • Formulating hypotheses about market behaviour and designing experiments to test them
  • Applying probability, statistics, optimization and machine learning to build predictive models and quantitative signals for systematic trading
  • Designing robust backtests and statistical tests to distinguish genuine signals from noise
  • Working with large and complex datasets to uncover patterns that aren't immediately visible
  • Investigating market microstructure and how markets behave at different timescales
  • Evaluating strategy performance, identifying weaknesses and continuously refining models
  • Developing research infrastructure and AI-powered tools and agents that make experimentation faster and analysis deeper
  • Working closely with technologists to translate research ideas into efficient, production-ready systems
  • Exploring new techniques in machine learning, statistics and quantitative finance to uncover new sources of edge

No two research problems are the same. Good research finds patterns. Great research understands why they exist.

What Success Looks Like

Successful researchers at Graviton discover new sources of alpha and turn them into robust trading strategies, build models that hold up under real market conditions and not only in backtests, develop a deep understanding of market behaviour, create research frameworks and tools that make the broader team more effective, work with technologists to take ideas from research into production, and communicate complex quantitative ideas clearly and rigorously. Your impact isn't measured by how many models you build. It's measured by the quality of the ideas you discover and what those ideas enable.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for exceptional problem solvers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious.

  • Degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, physics, computer science, statistics, operations research or machine learning
  • No active backlogs
  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++
  • Solid grounding in probability, statistics, linear algebra and optimization, with experience in machine learning, statistical modelling or data analysis, whether through coursework, research or personal projects
  • Comfort working with large, complex datasets, and strong analytical thinking
  • A passion for applying quantitative thinking and rigorous research to solve open-ended problems in markets
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly

Prior exposure to quantitative research, algorithmic trading, market microstructure, competitive mathematics or machine learning is valuable, but we care more about how you think than whether you've worked in finance before.

Our Culture

More than specific tools or techniques, we care how you think. We look for people who are curious enough to keep asking why, analytical enough to separate signal from noise, persistent enough to pursue difficult problems, intellectually honest enough to abandon an idea when the evidence says so, and humble enough to keep learning.

At Graviton, researchers sit alongside technologists on specialized trading teams that operate with significant autonomy. You'll have meaningful ownership of research problems from day one: forming your own hypotheses, challenging existing approaches and following the evidence wherever it leads, with the infrastructure and datasets to test ideas at scale, competitive compensation, and a culture where the best idea wins regardless of who proposed it.

Markets are among the most complex systems humans have ever created, and they never stop changing. Neither should our thinking. Every day, someone asks a better question and finds an answer nobody had. That someone could be you.

title: Accounting Expert: AI Model Evaluation
description:
About Huzzle Labs

Huzzle Labs partners with frontier AI labs to evaluate and improve frontier models through deep human expertise. Contributors directly assess advanced AI systems in their specialist fields, receive competitive compensation, and help define the standards used to measure model performance.

About the Role

Huzzle Labs is seeking experienced accountants to write realistic accounting tasks that test how well frontier AI systems handle accounting work. You will create prompts that are difficult enough for a frontier model to fail, then write a scoring rubric for each task so reviewers can assess the output consistently. A rubric is a list of objective, checkable criteria that a reviewer marks pass or fail. Your judgement helps define the standards used to measure model performance.

This is an expert judgement role focused on realistic task design, careful review of model output and precise, consistent documentation. Training is provided. Prior AI training or data-annotation experience is required.

Responsibilities

  • Write realistic accounting tasks: Create requests of the kind a client, controller or business owner would send, covering month-end close, bank and credit card reconciliations, AR/AP ageing, accruals and adjusting entries, sales tax, job costing and the clean-up of incomplete or inconsistent books.
  • Build from real material: Review a deal room containing hundreds of files, select the relevant documents and use them to develop prompts and rubrics for tasks a frontier model struggles to complete correctly.
  • Require usable deliverables: Each request should call for a working output, usually a spreadsheet, a journal entry schedule or a short memo.
  • Test against a frontier model: Run each request and review the output with the care you would apply when signing off accounting work. Where the model succeeds, increase the difficulty until a genuine gap appears.
  • Write scoring rubrics: Define objective criteria that another reviewer can apply without repeating your work, for example, “the reconciled ending balance equals $X” and “the $X deposit is recorded as a customer deposit liability, not revenue.”
  • Apply guidelines consistently: Follow the task and rubric guidelines, flag ambiguous cases and help refine the criteria.

Requirements

  • At least 5 years in accounting, bookkeeping or finance operations.
  • Prior AI training or data-annotation experience is required.
  • Hands-on knowledge of month-end close, reconciliations, AR/AP, accruals and adjusting entries, sales tax and job costing.
  • Excellent written English and precision with numbers.
  • Careful and detail-oriented: accurate figures and objective, checkable criteria.
  • Available 20 to 40 hours per week for an initial one-week trial, with potential extension.

Example Assignment

For a client deal room covering a small business with incomplete and inconsistent books, you would:

  1. Review the files and select the relevant documents, such as bank statements, ledgers, invoices and ageing reports.
  2. Write a prompt as the business owner or controller would, asking for a reconciliation and the adjusting entries needed to close the month.
  3. Run the prompt against a frontier AI model and check the spreadsheet or journal entry schedule line by line.
  4. If the model completes the task correctly, increase the difficulty, for example, by adding a customer deposit, a timing difference or a sales tax complication, until it fails.
  5. Write the rubric, such as “the reconciled ending balance equals $X” and “the $X deposit is recorded as a customer deposit liability, not revenue,” so another reviewer can grade any answer without repeating the work.

Confidentiality

An NDA must be signed before the engagement begins.

Benefits

Compensation: $60 - $90 USD / hour

This is a hands-on role with broad ownership. You’ll combine commercial judgement with strong content and practical CRM skills, while ensuring our positioning and the experience prospects have with REPLUG remain consistent.

  • Plan and execute B2B campaigns around the problems, buying triggers and decision-makers within our priority customer profiles.

  • Translate business objectives into a clear marketing plan with priorities, campaigns, timelines, budgets and measures of success.

  • Deliver core marketing activities yourself and coordinate contributions from founders, specialists and external partners. Keep delivery moving and identify where additional support is needed.

Augustus collapses this stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.

The Role

You’re a Fellow at Augustus, deployed to special projects across engineering, product, and the wider company. You own a project end to end: understand the problem, decide how to approach it, build the solution, and get it into use.

The work depends on where you can have the most impact. You could build background coding agents, create a frontend component library, or solve an operational problem with agents. The common thread is a meaningful problem, a clear outcome, and ownership of getting it done.

You’ll work closely with the team your project sits in. They provide context, technical guidance, and direct feedback. You bring the drive to turn an open-ended problem into something that works. As you deliver, the scope and difficulty of your projects grow.

  • Month 1: Join a team, understand the problem, and take ownership of your first project. Talk to the people who will use what you build, agree on what success looks like, and ship an initial version.

  • Months 2–3: Drive the project through to adoption. Work through technical decisions, collect feedback, and improve the solution. You’re becoming more independent and developing better judgment about where to spend your time.

  • Months 4–6: Take on a larger project or a harder problem, potentially in another team. You can turn an ambiguous brief into a plan, make sound tradeoffs, and deliver with less guidance.

Who Will Thrive At Augustus

  • Steep trajectory. You’re getting better fast. The problems you can solve today are meaningfully harder than those you could solve six months ago. You seek feedback and put it to work.

  • Curiosity. You want to understand how things work and why. You dig into unfamiliar systems, ask precise questions, and look beyond the first plausible answer.

  • Ownership. You care about the outcome. You involve the right people, raise blockers early, and check that what you shipped actually solves the problem.

  • Low ego. You can defend an idea, change your mind, and commit to a team decision. You care more about getting it right than getting credit.

  • You want direct feedback and responsibility that grows with your ability.

You’ll struggle here if:

  • You need a complete specification before you can start.

  • You’re more interested in starting projects than finishing them.

  • You wait for someone else to notice that you’re blocked.

  • You only want to work within a narrow, predefined remit.

Hard Requirements

  • Available for 3–6 months.

What We Offer

title: Customer Journey Manager Automotive (m/w/d)
description:
Über die Bovensiepen Group

Was 1965 in Kaufbeuren als Vision von Burkard Bovensiepen begann, ist heute ein international anerkanntes Familienunternehmen mit unverwechselbarer DNA. Seit Jahren wird das Familienunternehmen von seinen Söhnen Andreas und Florian geführt und steht für automobile Meisterwerke, handwerkliche Exzellenz und Perfektion in jedem Detail. Was hier entsteht, entsteht mit Hingabe, Präzision und höchstem Qualitätsanspruch.

Mit dem Übergang der ALPINA Markenrechte an BMW beginnt jetzt für die Gruppe ein neues Kapitel. Die automobile Leidenschaft wird unter der eigenständigen Marke Bovensiepen mit neuer Ausrichtung weitergeführt. Sechs Sparten bilden dabei das Rückgrat der Unternehmensgruppe, die Transformation als Chance versteht.

Für den Ausbau unseres Gebrauchtwagengeschäfts suchen wir eine unternehmerisch denkende und handelnde Führungspersönlichkeit.

Ihre Rolle – Kundenerlebnis, Auftrag und Weiterentwicklung in einer Hand

Sie verantworten das Kundenerlebnis für zwei Fahrzeugwelten: unsere Bovensiepen-Neufahrzeuge, die in unserer Manufaktur in Buchloe nach Kundenwunsch entstehen, und unsere Certified Cars, geprüfte und aufbereitete Premium-Gebrauchtfahrzeuge.

Ab der ersten Anfrage begleiten Sie den Kunden Hand in Hand mit unseren Verkaufsberatern und Handelspartnern: Der Vertrieb führt das Verkaufsgespräch, Sie machen den gesamten Weg bis zur Übergabe und die Zeit danach zu einem Erlebnis. Ihre Kunden erwarten, dass jedes Detail sitzt und schätzen jede Idee, die ihr Fahrzeug noch persönlicher macht.

Diese Rolle gibt es bei uns in dieser Form zum ersten Mal. Sie übernehmen keinen fertigen Prozess, Sie gestalten ihn: Welche Momente begeistern unsere Kunden? Wie sieht eine Übergabe aus, von der sie noch Jahre später erzählen? Wann ist der richtige Zeitpunkt für die passende Sonderausstattung? Ihre Antworten setzen Sie selbst um. 50 Meter neben Ihrem Schreibtisch entstehen die Fahrzeuge, die Sie betreuen.

Unsere Arbeitszeit: 40 Wochenstunden in Vollzeit, verteilt auf Montag bis Donnerstag und Freitag bis mittags. Teilzeit ist ab 30 Stunden möglich, die Verteilung besprechen wir gemeinsam.

Aufgaben

  • Konfiguration und Individualisierung: Sie beraten Kunden gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb zu Ausstattung, Materialien, Lackfarben und Interieur und übersetzen ihre Wünsche in verbindliche Fertigungs- und Aufbereitungsaufträge.

  • Zusatzgeschäft mit Fingerspitzengefühl: Sie bieten zum richtigen Zeitpunkt Sonderausstattung und Zusatzleistungen rund um Pflege und Service an, stets beratend, niemals drängend.

  • Auftragssteuerung: Sie verfolgen Termine, klären Detailfragen direkt mit Manufaktur, Werkstatt, Einkauf und Logistik und informieren den Kunden proaktiv über jeden Meilenstein. Damit sind Sie die zentrale Schnittstelle zu unseren Kunden.

  • Übergabe als Höhepunkt: Sie planen und gestalten die Fahrzeugübergabe in Buchloe, beim Handelspartner oder beim Kunden, nicht als Ende des Prozesses, sondern als den ersten Höhepunkt einer langfristigen Kundenbeziehung.

  • Nachbetreuung: Sie orchestrieren nach der Übergabe in Abstimmung mit Vertrieb und Handelspartnern den laufenden Kontakt, holen Feedback ein, lösen Anliegen schnell und erkennen Anlässe für Zubehör, Service oder das nächste Fahrzeug.

  • Customer Journey weiterentwickeln: Sie werten Kundenfeedback und Zufriedenheitswerte aus, verbessern die Kontaktpunkte laufend und bringen Ideen für Kundenevents, Manufakturbesuche und Übergabeformate ein.

  • Daten, die tragen: Sie pflegen Kunden- und Auftragsdaten in CRM und ERP so, dass Vertrieb und Geschäftsleitung darauf Entscheidungen bauen.

Diese Rolle ist nicht die Sachbearbeitung hinter dem Vertrieb. Sie ist das Gesicht von Bovensiepen zwischen erster Anfrage und Schlüsselübergabe, und auch weit darüber hinaus.

Was Sie in den ersten zwölf Monaten bewegen

  • Sie lernen Kunden, Handelspartner, Manufaktur und Fahrzeuge kennen und führen die ersten Aufträge eigenverantwortlich zur Übergabe.

  • Sie zeichnen die heutige Customer Journey auf und benennen die Momente, die begeistern – und die, die wir verbessern.

  • Sie entwickeln ein Übergabe- und Nachbetreuungskonzept, das unsere Kunden so noch nicht erlebt haben und das nachhaltig in Erinnerung bleibt.

  • Sie bauen ein Angebot aus Sonderausstattung, Zusatzleistungen und Erlebnis auf, das zum Kunden passt und machen seinen Erfolg messbar.

Qualifikation

Ihr Profil – Gastfreundschaft und Kaufmannsverstand

Sie haben ein echtes Gespür für Menschen und Freude daran, sie zu begeistern. Sie begegnen anspruchsvollen Kunden auf Augenhöhe, sprechen mit dem Sattler über Nahtbilder und behalten zehn Aufträge parallel im Blick, ohne dass einer aus dem Raster fällt. Sie verkaufen gern, weil Sie wissen, dass das richtige Angebot zur richtigen Zeit für den Kunden ein Gewinn ist.

Was Sie mitbringen

  • Kaufmännische Ausbildung (z. B. Automobilkaufleute) oder Studium

  • Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Kundenbetreuung, Order Management oder Vertrieb – im Premium-Automobilumfeld oder mit ähnlich anspruchsvoller Klientel, etwa bei Luxusmarken, in der Premium-Hotellerie oder im Private Banking

  • Freude am Verkaufen und nachweisbare Erfolge im Zusatz- oder Folgegeschäft

  • Begeisterung für hochwertige Fahrzeuge und den Willen, sich tief in deren Ausstattungswelt einzuarbeiten

  • Sicherer Umgang mit CRM- (Creatio) und ERP-Systemen (z. B. Microsoft Business Central) und MS Office

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, gutes Englisch, Führerschein Klasse B und Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Reisen für Übergaben

Was uns zusätzlich überzeugt

  • Erfahrung mit BMW oder anderen Premium-Marken

  • Erfahrung mit Individualisierungsprogrammen, Fahrzeugkonfiguration oder Kleinserien

  • Erfahrung mit Kundenevents, Clienteling oder Kennzahlen zur Kundenzufriedenheit (z. B. NPS)

  • Weitere Fremdsprache (Englisch, Französisch, Italienisch, Japanisch) für die Betreuung internationaler Kunden

Was uns wichtiger ist als jedes Zertifikat: der Instinkt für Menschen, der Wille, jeden Auftrag zu Ende zu denken, und die Freude daran, für einen Kunden mehr möglich zu machen, als er erwartet hat.

Benefits

Familienunternehmen seit mehr als 60 Jahren: Kurze Wege zwischen Kunde, Manufaktur und Geschäftsleitung. Ihre Ideen landen nicht in einer Abstimmungsschleife, sondern bei den Menschen, die entscheiden.

  • Erfolgsbeteiligung: Fixgehalt zwischen 52.000 und 60.000 € brutto im Jahr (in Teilzeit anteilig) je nach Erfahrung plus Bonus, gekoppelt an die Zusatzverkäufe und die Zufriedenheit Ihrer Kunden, damit Ihr Beitrag direkt sichtbar wird

  • Direkte Berichtslinie an die Vertriebsleitung und enge Zusammenarbeit mit Manufaktur und Geschäftsleitung

  • Produktnähe: Fahrzeuge, die in Buchloe von Hand entstehen und leidenschaftliche Käufer, die Sie persönlich kennen und stets im Fokus halten

Dein Profil: Erfahrung, Haltung, Führung.

  • Du willst langfristig gestalten und bringst Dich vor Ort voll in die Klinik ein

Umsetzung statt Beratung.
Du trägst Verantwortung und setzt selbst um. Keine Folienschlachten, sondern Ergebnisse im Haus.

Von Kliniken für Kliniken.
Ein Netzwerk aus Praktikern für Prozess, Personal, Controlling und IT, das den Krankenhausalltag kennt.

Perspektive.
Eine langfristige Aufgabe beim Kunden, kurze Entscheidungswege und Raum, Actura mit aufzubauen.

Lust auf IT-Leitung mit Wirkung?

Dann bring Deine Erfahrung dort ein, wo sie gebraucht wird und dauerhaft wirkt. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung.

  • An understanding of the betting and gaming industry is strongly preferred.

  • Self-motivated with the desire to find and solve business problems. 
  • Ability to learn in a fast-changing work environment.
  • Ability to communicate confidently and coherently, including verbal and written presentation skills. 
  • Ability to build good working relationships with stakeholders and other teams within the business. 
  • An understand of marketing metrics (such as acquisition costs, customer retention or promotional campaigns) preferred but not required. 
  • A highly collaborative mindset and a firm believer in teamwork & collaboration.
