title: Director of Cloud infrastructure and security
description:
Vestiaire Collective is the leading global online marketplace for desirable pre-loved fashion. Our mission is to transform the fashion industry for a more sustainable future by empowering our community to promote the circular fashion movement. Vestiaire was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Paris with offices in London, Berlin, New York, Singapore, Ho Chi Minh, and warehouses in Tourcoing (France), Crawley (UK), Hong Kong and New York.

We currently have a diverse global team of 600 employees representing more than 50 nationalities. Our values are Activism, Transparency, Dedication and Greatness and Collective.

About the Role:

Vestiaire Collective runs a global marketplace on AWS and GCP — Kubernetes, Kafka, Terraform, Vault, Cloudflare, Datadog, a large PHP application under active modernisation, a series of microservices in different tech stacks (Goland, PHP, Node) and a fast-growing surface of AI-powered services. 

 

As Director of Cloud Infrastructure and Security, you will lead a small team of six senior individual contributors across Cloud Infrastructure (DevOps/SRE) and Security. This is a hands-on Director role: alongside setting the strategy and roadmap, you will work directly with the team on architecture, technical decisions, incidents and delivery. You will be accountable, alongside Product Development teams, for the reliability, cost-efficiency and security posture of everything we run in production.

What you will do:

Leadership across two teams

  • Directly lead, develop and retain a small team of six (6) experienced engineers across Cloud Infrastructure and Security. This is a player-coach role without multiple management layers, so you will remain close to the team’s technical work and day-to-day priorities.

  • Define a joint roadmap for both teams, aligned to business priorities and risk appetite, and make explicit calls on what we will not do.

  • Establish clear KPIs, SLOs and risk metrics, and report regularly to leadership on reliability, cost and security posture.

  • Set the operating model: what product teams self-serve behind guardrails versus what your teams own centrally. 

  • Foster a culture where reliability and security are shared accountabilities, not tickets thrown over a wall, including establishing a Security Champions model across engineering.

Cloud infrastructure, reliability and platform

  • Own our AWS and GCP footprint end to end: EKS, networking, secrets (Vault), data stores (RDS/Aurora, MSK, ElastiCache, MongoDB Atlas, OpenSearch) and the edge (Cloudflare).

  • Establish real reliability engineering practice: SLOs and error budgets, capacity planning, and a business continuity plan.

  • Drive infrastructure-as-code maturity: Automating Terraform change application, advancing our move to GitOps (ArgoCD), and enforcing guardrails at creation time with policy-as-code (Kyverno/OPA) so provisioning is safe, self-serve and reviewable.

  • Consolidate observability into a single source of truth for metrics, logs and traces.

  • Improve developer experience and delivery throughput: CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions), paved roads, test environments on demand, and delivery metrics that hold up.

  • Own FinOps: infrastructure cost per unit of business value, cost accountability pushed back to each team, and continued run-rate reduction. Cost discipline is a first-class objective.

  • Support the modernisation of our core platform: Tech migrations, runtime and framework upgrades, and continuous database and Kubernetes upgrades.

  • Attack toil systematically: automate the recurring requests, and hand safe self-service back to product teams rather than absorbing the work.

  • Grow the foundations for AI-augmented engineering and operations

Security

  • Own security strategy and posture across cloud, application, identity, detection and response, building and improving the governance: risk register, published roadmap, remediation SLAs, and a recurring reporting cadence for leadership.

  • Strengthen cloud security posture management (CNAPP) and secure-by-default configurations across all environments.

  • Improve Embedding security into the SDLC and CI/CD: establish full static-analysis and dependency-scanning coverage with clear criteria for when critical findings block a release.

  • Mature vulnerability management, penetration testing and our bug bounty program into one prioritised program with SLAs and aging reports that measurably reduce risk.

  • Advance identity and access management toward least privilege and zero trust: automated provisioning from groups, and periodic access reviews.

  • Mature logging, detection and incident response, closing SIEM coverage gaps

  • Set guardrails for safe AI adoption (shadow AI outside approved paths, data and prompt leakage, prompt injection, model abuse) and defend against AI-enabled fraud and phishing.

  • Ensure compliance with GDPR, PCI DSS v4, NIS2, and CIS v8, including a maintained, reusable evidence library rather than evidence gathered on request.

  • Collaboration with legal and finance teams on compliance and forensic investigation topics

  • Manage third-party and supply-chain risk with vendor tiering and a recurring review cadence.

  • Own the security-built services your team already runs (back-office authentication and ACL, banning/fraud tooling, phone verification) and decide what to keep, hand over or retire.

  • Own endpoint security and partner closely with Corporate IT on device and identity coverage.

  • Keep security awareness and training relevant to a threat landscape that now includes AI-enabled social engineering.

Who you are:

  • 8+ years with a Significant experience in Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, DevOps, SRE or Cloud Security, including experience leading engineers.

  • You may currently be an Engineering Manager, Senior Engineering Manager or Head of who is ready to broaden your scope and step into a first Director role.

  • Strong practical experience with public cloud, ideally AWS, Kubernetes and Infrastructure-as-Code, with the willingness to remain close to architecture, incidents and technical delivery.

  • Track record establishing reliability practice at scale — SLOs, incident management, on-call, capacity planning, disaster recovery.

  • Demonstrable cloud cost optimisation / FinOps results at meaningful scale.

  • Strong grounding in cloud and application security fundamentals — IAM, network security, secrets management, CSPM, OWASP Top 10 — and the judgement to know when to hire the depth you don't have.

  • Working knowledge of compliance frameworks (GDPR, DORA, PCI DSS, NIS2) and how to turn requirements into practical controls.

  • Experience leading through incidents and security events under pressure.

  • Excellent communication skills: able to make a technical trade-off legible to a CFO and a risk decision legible to an engineer.

  • Comfortable operating with a lean team — ruthless prioritisation, automation over headcount, pragmatism over perfection.

 

Our Tech Stack includes: 

  • AWS cloud (primary), GCP, Kubernetes, Vault, Cloudflare, Datadog, ArgoCD, Okta. Applications are built on top of PHP 8, Golang and Node.js, using MariaDB, MongoDB and Kafka.

What we offer 🎁

The opportunity to do career-defining work in a fast-growing French-born scale up
The possibility to work as part of a globally diverse team with more than 50 nationalities

title: Standortentwickler (m/w/d)
description:
„Jeden Tag einen Menschen in eine sinnstiftende Tätigkeit bringen.“

Eine Stadt. Ein leeres Blatt. Dein Name drunter.

Berlin hat rund 3,9 Millionen Menschen, zwölf Bezirke, zwölf Jobcenter, eine Agentur für Arbeit mit mehreren Standorten – und einen Arbeitsmarkt, der dringend Menschen braucht, die qualifiziert, gecoacht und vermittelt werden. Wir sind in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein und Hamburg gewachsen. Jetzt wollen wir in Berlin Fuß fassen. Richtig.

Dafür suchen wir keinen Verwalter und keinen Vertriebler, der nach Feierabend abschaltet. Wir suchen jemanden, der Berlin kennt, in Berlin vernetzt ist und Lust hat, aus dem Nichts einen Standort aufzubauen, der in drei Jahren ein Name im Berliner Bildungsmarkt ist. Wer wir sind

Die EuBiA (Europäische Bildungsakademie) ist als operative Tochtergesellschaft der IWQ Holding ein Bildungsträger mit Standorten in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein und Hamburg sowie in Marokko. Seit über 15 Jahren konzipieren und realisieren wir geförderte Bildungsmaßnahmen, Coachings, Sprach- und Integrationskurse und Weiterbildungen – AZAV-zertifiziert, für Kostenträger, Firmenkunden und Selbstzahler, national und international.

Was uns ausmacht: Herzlichkeit, Kompetenz und Engagement. Wir entscheiden schnell, arbeiten nah am Markt und nah an den Menschen. Bei uns arbeiten Kolleginnen und Kollegen unterschiedlichster Herkunft zusammen, wir beraten und unterrichten in mehreren Sprachen. Diversity is für uns kein Schlagwort, sondern gelebter Alltag.

Deine Mission

Du baust das gesamte Geschäft der EuBiA in Berlin auf – vom ersten Gespräch mit einem Kostenträger bis zum laufenden Standort mit Team, Teilnehmenden und schwarzen Zahlen. In dieser Reihenfolge, ungefähr:

  • Markt und Netzwerk – Du gehst von Tag eins auf die Agentur für Arbeit, die Berliner Jobcenter, das BAMF, die Senatsverwaltungen, Kammern, Verbände und Unternehmen zu. Du findest heraus, welche Bedarfe in welchem Bezirk offen sind – und wo wir mit unserem Angebot sofort einen Unterschied machen.
  • Standort – Du suchst und bewertest Räume, verhandelst, richtest ein und sorgst dafür, dass der Standort die Anforderungen der Kostenträger und der Zertifizierung erfüllt.
  • Angebot – Du entscheidest mit, welche Maßnahmen Berlin zuerst braucht – Coaching und Vermittlung (AVGS, § 45 SGB III), Weiterbildung (FBW), Sprach- und Integrationskurse, Firmenschulungen, Ausschreibungen – und bringst sie mit unserem QM-Team durch die Zulassung.
  • Vertrieb – Du gewinnst Kostenträger, Firmenkunden und Kooperationspartner, bearbeitest Ausschreibungen und füllst die Maßnahmen mit Teilnehmenden. Du verkaufst nicht nur – du hältst, was du verkaufst.
  • Team – Du stellst Coaches, Dozentinnen und Dozenten und Verwaltung ein, baust die Mannschaft auf, führst sie und machst sie stark.
  • Betrieb und Zahlen – Du verantwortest Budget, Auslastung, Ergebnis. Du kennst deine Kennzahlen jede Woche – Teilnehmende, Verbleib, Deckungsbeitrag – und steuerst danach.
  • Hands-on – Am Anfang bist du alles gleichzeitig: Vertrieb, Coach, Verwaltung, Hausmeister. Das schreckt dich nicht, das reizt dich.

Was du mitbringst

  • Berlin – Du lebst in Berlin, kennst die Stadt, die Bezirke, die Akteure – und hast bereits ein belastbares Netzwerk zu Kostenträgern, Verwaltungen, Unternehmen oder Trägern. Du weißt, wer in Berlin was entscheidet.
  • Arbeitsmarktdienstleistungen – Du kennst das Geschäft aus eigener Praxis: SGB II und SGB III, AZAV, AVGS, FBW, § 45, Ausschreibungen der Kostenträger, Integrations- und Berufssprachkurse. Du weißt, wie Maßnahmen zugelassen, gefüllt, abgerechnet und geprüft werden.
  • Geschäftstüchtigkeit – Du denkst wie eine Unternehmerin oder ein Unternehmer: Du erkennst Chancen, rechnest sie durch, entscheidest schnell und bringst sie auf die Straße. Du hast schon einmal etwas aufgebaut – einen Standort, ein Geschäftsfeld, ein Team oder ein Unternehmen.
  • Vertriebsstärke – Du gehst auf Menschen zu, kommst ins Gespräch, überzeugst und schließt ab – bei Kostenträgern wie bei Geschäftsführungen.
  • Führung – Du hast Teams aufgebaut und geführt und weißt, wie man aus Einzelpersonen eine Mannschaft macht.
  • Zahlenverständnis – Budget, Deckungsbeitrag, Auslastung – du steuerst mit Kennzahlen und nicht nach Gefühl.
  • Qualifikation – Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung – betriebswirtschaftlich, pädagogisch, sozial oder etwas ganz anderes. Entscheidend ist, was du bewegt hast.
  • Persönlichkeit – Gründergeist, Ausdauer, Verbindlichkeit. Du hältst Unsicherheit aus, bleibst dran, wenn es zäh wird, und feierst, wenn der erste Teilnehmende einen Arbeitsvertrag unterschreibt.

Was wir dir geben

  • Gewinnbeteiligung – Du baust den Standort auf – und du bist am Gewinn beteiligt, den er erwirtschaftet. Die Details klären wir im Gespräch, offen und transparent.
  • Freiheit – Du entscheidest vor Ort. Wir geben dir Ziele, keine Mikro-Anweisungen. Entscheidungen fallen bei uns schnell – 70 Prozent Informationslage reichen.
  • Rückendeckung – Du startest nicht bei null: Zertifizierung und Qualitätsmanagement, erprobte Maßnahmenkonzepte, Verwaltung, Buchhaltung, Marketing und 15 Jahre Erfahrung im Ausschreibungsgeschäft stehen hinter dir.
  • Direkter Draht – Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung der Gruppe zusammen – kurze Wege, schnelle Antworten.
  • Perspektive – Wer Berlin aufbaut, leitet Berlin. Die Standortleitung ist der logische nächste Schritt.
  • Sinn – Jeder Mensch, den dein Standort in Arbeit bringt, ist dein Ergebnis. Das sieht man – jeden Tag.
  • Corporate Benefits und betriebliche Altersvorsorge – Weil wir auch an deine Zukunft denken.

Bewerbung & rechtlicher Hinweis

Klingt nach dir? Dann erzähl uns in deiner Bewerbung vor allem eins: Was hast du schon aufgebaut – und wie würdest du in Berlin anfangen? Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

title: Software Engineer, Applied AI
description:
About CircuitHub

CircuitHub is reshaping electronics manufacturing with The Grid, a factory-scale robotics platform that makes small-batch, high-mix electronics assembly radically more efficient. Think semiconductor-fab precision applied to the chaotic world of prototyping and low-volume production: a 10x throughput improvement in one of the world's most foundational industries.

We've raised $45M from top-tier investors including Plural, Y Combinator and Google Ventures, and we're already profitable. Our customers include a major EV maker, a top AI lab and many of the worlds largest companies.

The Grid isn't a prototype. It's live, scaling fast and delivering real revenue, and we're building the team that will scale it further.

The Role

CircuitHub makes electronics on demand. Engineers upload a circuit board design; we buy the parts, build the board in our own robotic factory and ship it. More and more of that business is now run by AI agents, and we want you to help build them.

These aren't chatbots. Our agents have real jobs:

  • They inspect boards. An agent checks camera images of every panel we build for wrong, rotated or missing parts.

  • They program robots. Agents read datasheets so our pick-and-place machines know how to handle each new part.

  • They watch the factory. They spot stray parts in robot storage, diagnose printer faults and clear stuck machines.

  • They run the back office. They book supplier invoices, chase late orders, explain quotes and triage bugs.

  • They write our code. Most of what our team ships starts in an agent session.

What you'll do

Find a process people still do by hand and automate it end to end: decide what needs judgement and what needs plain code, build the tools, and prove it works before it runs alone. Then make it cheaper, faster and right more often. You'll also improve the platform every agent runs on, and work closely with the people your work serves, from factory operators to finance.

How we build

  • Evals first. An agent earns the right to work alone: blind tests against people's verdicts, shadow runs beside the humans, replays of past decisions. We track accuracy and cost per run, and re-test whenever we change a model, a prompt or the effort level.

  • Agents judge, code writes. Agents return structured answers. Plain code checks them against a second source and makes every change.

  • Classical first, model second. Cheap vision and maths narrow the problem so the model only looks where it matters.

  • Safe by construction. Agents work in sandboxed cloud machines that never hold real credentials, and tool calls are built so a business action can't run twice.

Recent work

  • Image alignment ranks the parts on each board photo. The worst 20% of parts hold about 90% of real defects, so the agent only inspects those. In a blind re-run it caught all 13 defects operators had marked.

  • A photo check for stray parts in robot storage scored 10 out of 10 blind, at about 8¢ a photo. The model it replaced caught about half.

  • Agent tool calls leave durable receipts, so a session killed mid-deploy resumes without sending the same email or order twice.

  • Invoices extracted from supplier emails matched what a person had entered 66 times out of 66.

  • A constraint solver replans the whole factory every two minutes, across robots, ovens and people.

What we look for

  • You've put LLM agents into production and can tell us what broke and how you knew it was working.

  • You're a strong software engineer first. Most of this job is real engineering, not prompting: concurrency, idempotency, data modelling, security.

  • You build the eval before you trust the result.

  • You like the physical world: cameras, robots, parts rotated by 90°.

  • Bonus: computer vision, optimisation or electronics.

Stack

  • Agents: Claude Code, Codex, Claude and OpenAI APIs, MCP, skills in plain Markdown

  • Code: TypeScript (Bun, React), Python (FastAPI, Dagster, OpenCV, OR-Tools), PostgreSQL

  • Infra: Nix and NixOS, Nomad, Terraform, Vault, AWS, Modal sandboxes, OpenTelemetry

description:
About Us

Backed by significant investment, Luzern is an international, technology-led eCommerce business with anambitious growth strategy. Our AI-enabled Channel Optimizer platform, combined with our eCommerce expertise, helps brands manage and grow their presence across increasingly complex digital channels.
As we continue to grow and evolve, we are looking for talented people who enjoy working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and want to play an active role in the next stage of Luzern's development.

The Senior eCommerce Content Strategist owns content strategy and execution across Amazon and the wider commerce ecosystem for Luzern's enterprise brand clients. Amazon is the primary focus — listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store and related content — but the role is deliberately platform-agnostic in outlook, extending strategy and content guidance to other marketplaces, retailer sites (e.g. Tesco, Zalando,Otto) and D2C.

The role is audit-led: content strategy is built from a structured read of customer and platform signals — reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries, and the queries customers put to AI assistants and platform agents — combined with a quality assessment of current content (using a framework such as IDQ or equivalent) against Best-in-Class competitors and audience requirements. Strategy, messaging and content requirements follow from that evidence base, rather than from assumption.

A defining part of the role is thinking beyond traditional platform search: strategies must consider how content needs to be structured and prepared to be discovered and surfaced by generative AI assistants (e.g ChatGPT) and in-platform shopping agents (e.g. Amazon's Rufus), alongside conventional marketplace and retailer search algorithms.

The role sits as the senior content specialist within a small delivery pod, working alongside an SEO Executive and Designers. It carries direct client-facing responsibility: estimating, briefing, managing feedback and contributing to proposals and is responsible for reviewing the pod's output before it reaches the client. It does not carry resourcing, project management or formal line management responsibility.

Tasks

What You’ll Be Doing

Content Audits & Quality Assessment
● Signal analysis: analyse customer reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries, and the queries customers and AI agents put to platforms (e.g. Rufus prompts), to understand what content needs to do and where current content falls short.
● Quality benchmarking — review current platform content and score it against a content quality framework (e.g. IDQ or equivalent), benchmarking against Best-in-Class competitors and audience requirements.
● Findings to action — translate audit findings into a clear, prioritised view of content requirements that feeds directly into strategy.

Content Strategy Development
● Amazon content ownership- develop and own content strategy and execution for listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store and related Amazon content, as the role's primary focus.
● Cross-platform extension — extend strategy and content recommendations to other marketplaces,retailer sites (e.g. Tesco, Zalando, Otto) and D2C storefronts, adapting to each platform's content rules, algorithm and customer behaviour.
● Strategic framework - from audit findings, develop comms objectives, key messages and a messaging hierarchy for each client or category.
● Content requirements - define the content requirements, imagery and copy needed to deliverthe strategy, and the frameworks/guidelines the team and client can act on.
● Wireframes & mock-ups - develop A+ and Brand Store wireframes and mock-ups in collaborationwith the Designer, turning strategy into an executable creative direction.

AI & Agentic Discoverability
● AI-ready content — build content strategies that account for how product and brand content is read, ranked and surfaced by generative AI assistants (e.g. ChatGPT) and in-platform shopping agents (e.g Rufus), alongside traditional search.
● Point of view — keep Luzern's thinking on AI/agentic discoverability current, and translate emerging platform and LLM behaviour into practical, sellable content recommendations.
● Alignment with SEO — partner with the SEO Executive so keyword and search strategy and content structure are aligned across traditional and AI-mediated discovery.

Testing & Performance Monitoring
● A/B testing — recommend and run A/B tests (e.g. on A+ Content, Brand Store, imagery and messaging) to determine the most effective executional approach, rather than relying on opinion or precedent.
● Monitoring set-up - set up monitoring using Compass (or equivalent) to measure content effectiveness and implementation.
● Reporting on impact — track and report on content performance against strategy objectives, feeding learnings back into future audits and strategy.

Creative Briefing & Review
● Strategic foundation - develop the strategy and messaging that underpins paid social, display and
marketplace advertising content.
● Creative briefs - write and own briefs for Designers producing static and video ad assets, translating strategy into clear creative direction.
● Creative review - review creative output against the brief, brand guidelines and platform requirements before client delivery.

Client Management
● Client-facing delivery - present content strategy, recommendations and audit findings directly to client stakeholders.
● Estimates & scoping - prepare estimates and scopes of work for content workstreams.
● Briefs — shape and write content and creative briefs in response to client requirements.
● Feedback management — manage client feedback through to resolution, balancing client expectations against strategy and platform best practice.
● Proposals — contribute to and help prepare proposals and pitch content for new and existing client business.

Quality & Output Review
● Senior review — review the SEO Executive's and Designers' work before it is sent to the client, checking it against strategy, brand guidelines and platform requirements.
● Direction — give feedback and direction to keep output consistent and on-strategy.

AI-Enabled Working
● AI as a working method — use AI tools proficiently for content and competitive audits, for generating recommendations, and for producing or accelerating creative and written content — not only as a subject of strategy.
● Continuous improvement — identify and recommend where AI tools can improve the speed or quality of content production and audit work across the team.

Requirements

What You Bring to the Role

● Proven experience in Amazon content strategy and execution (listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store, Amazon Posts), ideally within an agency or managed services environment.

● Working knowledge of content requirements across at least one other marketplace or major retailer platform (e.g. Tesco, Zalando, Otto) and D2C.

● Experience running content audits — analysing reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries and customer/AI-agent queries — and scoring content quality (e.g. IDQ or equivalent) against best-in-Class standards.

● Experience translating audit findings into content strategy: comms objectives, key messaging, messaging hierarchy, and content requirements for imagery and copy.

● Experience developing or briefing A+ and Brand Store wireframes and mock-ups, working closely with designers.

● Experience designing and running A/B tests to determine the most effective executional approach, and setting up performance monitoring (e.g. Amazon Compass or equivalent) to track results.

● Strong understanding of how AI assistants and platform shopping agents (e.g. ChatGPT, Rufus)surface and rank product content, and how content should be structured to support this.

● Confident, credible client-facing communicator — comfortable presenting strategy, leading feedback conversations, and owning estimates and proposals.

● Strong copywriting and content editing skills, with a close eye for brand and platform compliance.

● Comfortable reviewing and giving constructive feedback on the work of SEO and design peers.

Desirable

● Familiarity with SEO fundamentals, to collaborate effectively with the SEO Executive.

● Experience contributing to new business pitches or proposals.

● Category experience relevant to Luzern's enterprise brand client base.

description:
ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :

École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.

Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.

IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.

Les activités du centre RAPSODEE sont structurées en deux groupes de recherche dans les domaines de l’énergie, de l’environnement et du génie particulaire avec un accent particulier sur des procédés durables : plus intenses, plus économes en énergie, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus sûrs.

Le poste est ouvert dans le fond propre d’IMT Mines Albi. Une collaboration avec le laboratoire de chimie de coordination (LCC) à Toulouse est prévue.

 

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :

A ce jour, les carburants fossiles sont encore largement utilisés dans les différents secteurs industriels et notamment pour le secteur de transport, qui sont une source importante d’émission de gaz à effet de serre. Pour réduire l’impact environnemental du secteur de transport, les carburants de synthèse jouent un rôle important, en particulier pour le transport aérien de demain. Parmi les voies de R&D étudiées à ce jour pour la production de ces carburants de synthèse, le captage du CO2 et l’hydrogénation directe de ce CO2 par de l’hydrogène obtenu par l’électrolyse de l’eau avec de l’électricité renouvelable est une voie stratégique. L'un de leurs atouts majeurs réside dans l’optimisation de la production pour minimiser le coût du produit final, et la compatibilité des carburants de synthèse avec les infrastructures et les flottes existantes.

Ce projet, qui réunit deux laboratoires (RAPSODEE à Albi, et LCC à Toulouse), vise à produire des carburants alternatifs par hydrogénation directe du CO2 via une synthèse de Fischer-Tropsch à partir de CO2 (CO2-FTS). Ce processus se décompose en deux étapes successives : (i) l'hydrogénation du CO2 en CO (réaction inverse du gaz à l'eau, ou RWGS), suivie (ii) de l'hydrogénation du CO en hydrocarbures (synthèse de Fischer-Tropsch, ou FTS). Ce projet continue la recherche récente entre les deux laboratoires sur le même sujet, en développant des systèmes catalytiques multifonctionnels assurant la conversion, en une seule étape, dans un seul réacteur et à une seule condition de température et de pression, du CO2 et H2 en carburants liquides. Une attention particulière sera accordée à l’ingénierie de la composition, de la structure et de l’environnement des sites actifs, afin d’établir des relations structure-activité et de comprendre le rôle de chaque composant métallique dans les différentes étapes réactionnelles. Cette stratégie vise à dépasser les limitations des catalyseurs conventionnels en améliorant leur activité, sélectivité, stabilité et résistance à la désactivation. Le projet contribuera ainsi au développement d’une nouvelle génération de catalyseurs multifonctionnels pour la valorisation directe et durable du CO2 en carburants et produits chimiques à valeur ajoutée.

Les missions sont les suivantes :

  •        Etat de l’art : Une étude bibliographique est prévue sur les derniers travaux publiés sur ce sujet, pour compléter le travail réalisé en début de 2026.

  •        Synthèse et caractérisation des catalyseurs multifonctionnels : des catalyseurs bimétalliques et multifonctionnels à base de fer et/ou de cobalt pour la conversion directe du CO2 en hydrocarbures par voie Fischer-Tropsch seront développés. L’objectif sera d’obtenir des matériaux présentant une synergie contrôlée entre différentes fonctions catalytiques, permettant de favoriser simultanément l’activation/hydrogénation du CO2, la formation des intermédiaires carbonés et leur transformation sélective en chaînes hydrocarbonées. Les paramètres à étudier sont : la modification des supports catalytiques par des promoteurs efficaces ; le contrôle de la taille, la forme et la composition de la phase active, le contrôle de l’équilibre entre les fonctions pour l’activation du CO2 et de l’hydrogène. Ces matériaux seront caractérisés par différentes méthodes de caractérisation conventionnelles ou avancées.

  •        Evaluation des systèmes catalytiques en CO2-FTS : Les catalyseurs synthétisés seront évalués à l’échelle laboratoire. La performance des meilleurs catalyseurs pourra être évaluée à l’échelle pilote.

  •        Valorisation des résultats : Les résultats obtenus feront l’objet de la valorisation sous forme de brevet et ensuite communiqués dans les congrès et les journaux scientifiques.

 

CAPACITE ET ATTITUDES :

Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables :

Des compétences solides en catalyse hétérogène, en particulier pour la conversion du CO2 sont recherchées.

Capacités et aptitudes :

Des qualités de synthèse, d’organisation et de communication sont également nécessaires pour mener à bien les missions de ce poste.

Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat obtenu il y a moins de 3 ans.

Home page
Customer Stories

Tu veux travailler sur une Data Platform qui irrigue toute une scale-up fintech — du Marketing au Produit, en passant par la Finance, le Customer Success et les sales — et qui est aujourd'hui au cœur de notre transition AI-first ? Tu as le recul pour maintenir des systèmes en prod ET l'énergie pour aller construire la couche sémantique qui va connecter nos données à l'IA ?

Tu intègres une équipe de 3 Data Engineers qui collabore au quotidien avec 4 Data Analysts et Pauline (Head of Data). Tu seras en lien direct avec Kévin (Team Lead Data Engineering) et Pauline au quotidien. L'équipe Data est rattachée au département Revenue & Operations.

Tu alternes entre run exigeant et chantiers structurants :

  • Maintenir et fiabiliser la plateforme : Composer (Airflow), Airbyte self-hosted sur GKE, BigQuery, dbt, Terraform.   • Industrialiser l'ingestion de données : collecter les sources via Airbyte (API ou CDC selon les cas), gérer l'évolution des schémas et les tables externes BigQuery.
  • Alimenter les outils métier : reverse-ETL et synchronisations entre outils (HubSpot, Gainsight, Intercom…) ou vers notre base temps réel PostgreSQL via notre architecture streaming (webhooks → Pub/Sub → Cloud Run).
  • Étendre la couche d'accès IA : prolonger le MCP Analytics vers BigQuery, construire la couche sémantique qui conditionne la qualité des réponses de l'IA. La qualité de la modélisation fait la qualité des réponses.
  • Maîtriser coûts et sécurité : réservations de slots BigQuery en autoscaling, routage dynamique du build dbt, revue FinOps mensuelle, least privilege, gestion des données personnelles et sensibles, sécurisation des accès data par l'IA.

title: Edge & Machine Integration Engineer (PLC to Cloud), Freelance, m/f/d
description:
FALU AG in Rüti (ZH) builds and sells swab production machines that run in plants around the world. With FALU PMAS, our cloud based production monitoring and assistance system, every machine reports its state every five seconds. Customers get live dashboards, shift KPIs, downtime analytics and automatic alerts in the browser. The first customer went live in September 2026 with eight machines, and more plants are lined up.

The cloud side of PMAS is built and running in production: broker, ingestion service, databases, web app. The path from the PLC inside the machine to the MQTT broker is covered by one engineer who designed and built it. With more machines and more plants coming, that one person is no longer enough. We are looking for a freelancer who adds capacity on exactly this path: PLC software, Raspberry Pi edge devices, site gateway, broker connection.

This is a permanent role that we staff on a freelance basis: no project end date, a long term engagement with about 1 week of work per month, with more when a rollout is on. You will work directly with our existing integration engineer, our inhouse engineering team and the CEO.

Tasks

You work on everything between the machine PLC and the MQTT broker, alongside the engineer who built the current setup. Which parts you take over completely and which you share depends on your strengths. Concretely:

PLC and machine side

  • Bring the PMAS message format into the CB1 machine software (Siemens S7, TIA Portal V18 with HMI) and keep it in sync with the payload contract: cumulative counters, machine status, error codes, timestamps from the PLC clock.
  • Decide and implement how data leaves the PLC: MQTT publishing from the PLC itself, or a read on the edge device (S7 protocol or OPC UA) that publishes on its behalf. Pick one, justify it, standardise it.
  • Manage PLC software versions across the fleet, including safe update and rollback procedures for machines already running at customers.
  • Ensure clock discipline on the PLCs (NTP, local time zone per plant), since every duration KPI is computed from PLC timestamps.

Edge devices and site gateway

  • Develop and maintain the software on the Raspberry Pi based edge devices next to each machine: MQTT client, buffering and store and forward during uplink outages, unique client IDs, credential handling, health reporting.
  • Develop and maintain the site gateway: isolated machine network, routing and firewall, outbound only TLS and NTP, remote maintenance access, watchdogs, recovery from a spare device.
  • Help turn the current setup into a provisioning process: golden image, per machine configuration, fleet wide updates without a site visit. A new machine goes from unboxing to "visible in the dashboard" in under an hour.
  • Monitor the edge layer so that we know about a degraded device before the customer does.

Broker and data contract

  • Administer the HiveMQ Cloud clusters per customer: credentials, topic ACLs, client ID scheme, certificates.
  • Maintain the payload contract together with the existing integration engineer. Changes are versioned and documented.

Commissioning and support

  • Onboard new customers and new machines end to end, remotely where possible and on site where needed (primarily Europe and the United States).
  • Act as second line when "the dashboard shows nothing" or "the numbers look wrong" and the cause sits between PLC and broker.
  • Write the documentation you would have wanted on day one: onboarding sheets, runbooks, wiring notes.

Requirements

Must have

  • Siemens PLC programming in TIA Portal (SCL and LAD, S7-1200/1500 family). You can open an existing machine project, understand it and change it without breaking the machine.
  • Industrial networking: PROFINET, VLANs, static and DHCP setups, firewalls, TLS basics. You have connected a machine to a network that was not built for it.
  • Linux on Raspberry Pi or comparable single board computers: systemd, networking, images, headless operation, remote administration.
  • Solid programming skills in Python or Node.js for edge software, and Git as a daily tool.
  • MQTT in depth: versions 3.1.1 and 5.0, QoS levels, retained messages, last will, TLS, broker ACLs.
  • Proficiency with AI coding tools is a hard requirement. You use Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or comparable tools every day, you write and maintain project instructions for them, you review their output critically, and you are measurably faster with them than without. Our code and documentation are written with and for these tools. If you see AI tools as optional, this role is not for you.
  • Working proficiency in English (all code, commits and documentation are in English). German is a plus for the machine side.
  • Willingness to travel to customer plants, typically a few days per quarter.
  • Availability of at least two days per week on a permanent basis, with the option to scale up during rollouts.
  • You work as a freelancer (own company or registered self employed) and can invoice FALU AG.

Nice to have

  • OPC UA, Snap7 or the Siemens open communication libraries.
  • Node-RED, Docker on ARM, Ansible or similar fleet tooling.
  • Machine building or commissioning experience: reading electrical schematics, 24 V control cabinet basics, HMI (WinCC).
  • Administration of HiveMQ, Mosquitto or EMQX.
  • A basic understanding of what happens after the broker (Node.js services, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse), so that you can talk to the cloud side at eye level.

Benefits

  • A clearly bounded, business critical scope with a colleague who knows the system and hands over properly. No cold start.
  • A running production system with a real customer, not a greenfield slide deck.
  • AI assisted development is how we work, not an experiment. You get the tools and the budget for them.
  • Machines you can touch: a test bench at FALU in Rüti with real PLCs and edge hardware.
  • Remote by default, on site in Rüti when hardware is involved. Travel to customer plants is paid on top of the rate.
  • A permanent role, not a project with an end date: growing volume as more plants go live, on a freelance basis for as long as it works for both sides.
  • Fast, uncomplicated invoicing and decisions from a small team.

If you have ever made a stubborn PLC talk to the cloud and have capacity to do it again with us, we would like to hear from you.

Please send us your CV or LinkedIn profile, your daily rate and availability, one paragraph about a PLC to cloud integration you built or fixed and what went wrong on the way, and one concrete example of how you use AI tools in your daily engineering work.

What to expect: a short call with Marc Wyss (CEO) within a week of your application, then a small practical task with a simulated PLC data source, a Raspberry Pi image and a broker endpoint. We look at how you work, not just at the result. After that, one conversation with our integration engineer and the team, then a decision and a contract.

At Xelon, we deliver secure, scalable, and automated Swiss cloud infrastructure for the next generation of digital services. From IaaS to SaaS, our platform powers workloads in regulated industries like technology, finance, insurance, and public services. Our solutions - Xelon Cloud, Xelon Secure+ and Xelon HQ combine reliability, automation, sovereignty, and simplicity in one ecosystem.

We are on a mission to become the #1 Swiss Cloud Enabler, and we are growing a team of people who want to shape the future of cloud infrastructure and software operations.

Tasks

Your Mission

As Cloud Operations Lead you own the daily operation of our cloud platform: availability, incident response, monitoring, backup and recovery, and the infrastructure underneath. The service desk is part of your team, so you also own what customers experience every time they contact us. You lead a team of four to six people, and you are the person the business relies on when something has to keep running.

Xelon is building a new platform over the coming years. VMware carries the production estate through that transition and stays in place for at least the next two years, alongside other hypervisors. You run that environment, you keep it stable and auditable, and you make sure the transition never happens at the expense of the customers on it.

Platform strategy, target architecture and the technology roadmap sit with the Head of Platform & Technology. You are a close partner in those decisions and you own their operational reality.

What You Own in the First 12 Months

  • Availability and customer satisfaction. You hit the agreed availability targets and hold them, and customers experience both the platform and the service desk as dependable, with incidents resolved quickly and communicated clearly.
  • ISO 27001 and audit readiness. Operational evidence, documentation and patch compliance stay audit-ready throughout the year instead of being assembled in the weeks before each audit.
  • Team depth. No critical part of the platform depends on one person, and every engineer in the team has a development path they can name.

Responsibilities

  • Operations and multi-hypervisor environment: Operate and optimise the production estate across a multi-hypervisor environment, with VMware as the primary platform. Keep availability, performance and capacity ahead of demand as the customer base grows. Own hardware lifecycle, capacity planning and datacenter operations together with our partners.
  • Networking, storage and datacenter: Own the operational side of network and storage: segmentation, routing, firewalling, DNS, load balancing, and the storage layer underneath the platform. Raise the level of networking knowledge and practice across the team.
  • Monitoring, incident response and recovery: Run and improve monitoring, alerting and logging so that problems surface before customers report them. Own backup and disaster recovery, including proving that restores actually work.
  • Service desk and customer support: Lead the service desk: intake, triage, ticket quality and response times against agreed service levels. Own what customers experience when they contact us, from the first response through to clear communication during an incident. Act as escalation point for 1st and 2nd level support incidents. Turn recurring tickets into fixes together with the engineering side of the team, rather than absorbing them as routine.
  • Team leadership: Lead, coach and develop a team of four to six people across cloud operations and the service desk. Build development plans and remove single points of knowledge. Set on-call, shift and service desk coverage the team can sustain.
  • Automation and process: Move recurring manual operations into Infrastructure as Code and scripting. Improve the operational toolchain and the handover points with DevOps, Support and Product. Apply service management practice where it reduces friction, not as an end in itself.
  • Compliance and audit readiness: Keep operations aligned with ISO 27001, ISAE and Swiss data sovereignty requirements. Work with Dev- and SecOps on hardening, patch compliance and audit evidence. Maintain operational documentation that holds up in an audit.
  • Budget, vendors and procurement: Co-own the operational CAPEX and OPEX budget with the Head of Platform & Technology. Manage vendor relationships, licenses and procurement for the operations estate.

Requirements

Who You Are

We are looking for an operations leader, not an architect. Technical depth matters, and so does the ability to run a team through a platform transition without dropping the service underneath it.

  • You keep the service running while the ground moves. A platform transition does not become the customer's problem.
  • You lead through presence and clarity, not authority. Your team knows what good looks like.
  • You are calm in an incident and precise afterwards. The postmortem produces a fix, not a narrative.
  • You treat the service desk as part of the product, not as a queue to be absorbed.
  • You tell your manager what is broken and what you need to fix it.

Must Haves

  • Leadership: 5+ years leading IT operations, in a cloud, hosting or service provider environment.
  • VMware: hands-on experience in production. You have operated it yourself, not only overseen it.
  • Infrastructure: practical working knowledge of networking, storage and datacenter operations.
  • German and English: you communicate confidently in both, spoken and written.
  • Work authorisation: Swiss or EU/EFTA citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit.

Nice to Haves

  • Networking at provider scale — a strong plus: segmentation, routing, firewalling, load balancing and DNS.
  • Experience with other hypervisors alongside VMware, and with hypervisor migrations.
  • Hands-on Infrastructure as Code, e.g. Terraform or Ansible.
  • Monitoring and logging at scale, e.g. Prometheus, Grafana or a similar stack.
  • Operating experience in a regulated environment: ISO 27001, ISAE or SOC 2.
  • Running operations through a platform migration or a consolidation.

Benefits

What Xelon Offers

  • A leadership role with real ownership in a Swiss cloud provider, not a coordination layer.
  • A platform in transition, which means your operational decisions change something visible.
  • Office in Zug with a hybrid working model, 80 to 100 percent.

  • Competitive salary, modern tooling and a product-driven environment with clarity and ownership.

description:
People who build lose nearly a quarter of their working time to things that have nothing to do with building. Ferdinand, an electrician and engineer who had founded companies before, started Benetics AI in 2022 to give that time back. Our first product is a voice assistant for the construction site. More than 400 companies in 10+ countries use Benetics AI: electricians, HVAC installers, timber builders, roofers and solar installers. We are bootstrapped, cash-flow positive and growing in triple digits.

We are now hiring someone to run finance and legal while we expand across Europe and into the US.

Tasks

You report to the CEO and take over finance and legal. Today this work is split between the founders, our fiduciary and outside counsel. You bring it into one place and build it out.

Finance

You own the numbers we run the company on. We are bootstrapped, so no investor money covers a bad month.

  • Monthly close on a fixed date, with our fiduciary and auditors
  • Operating model, cash forecast and runway in CHF, EUR and USD
  • SaaS metrics and billing: ARR, retention, CAC, payback
  • Cohort analysis, quote-to-cash and revenue recognition
  • Payroll, insurance and tax

Legal

Sales closes a standard deal without you. When a deal is not standard, they hear back from you within a day.

  • Contract templates, fallback positions and redlines for order forms, MSAs, partner and supplier agreements and NDAs
  • GDPR and revDSG, DPAs, subprocessors, TOMs, and the security questionnaires that come with every enterprise deal
  • Insurance, employment law in CH, DE, FR and the US, and the decision on ISO 27001 or SOC 2

Building the group

We are setting up the US subsidiary right now, and you will own it.

  • Incorporation, intercompany agreement and transfer pricing between the Swiss parent and the international entity
  • Registered agent, state registrations, payroll and sales tax nexus
  • A consolidation that stays clean as we add entities
  • Choosing the finance and legal tools, and deciding what to automate, what to outsource and what to keep in-house

Requirements

  • 5+ years in finance and in either legal or commercial contracting
  • Hands-on experience with accounting, payroll and tax
  • You redline a SaaS contract yourself and know when to call counsel
  • SaaS finance: subscription revenue, retention cohorts, unit economics, quote-to-cash
  • Fluent German and English at work. Our customers, our fiduciary and our contracts use both.
  • You are happy to be the first hire in the function. You build the model and chase the invoices yourself, with no team under you at the start.

Nice to have

  • You have set up a foreign subsidiary before, including intercompany pricing
  • Experience with SMB customers and with getting them to pay on time
  • Views on finance tools and a habit of automating routine work

The role is hands-on for a while and covers both finance and legal. The title will grow with the company.

Benefits

  • You report to the CEO from day one, and your analysis feeds straight into decisions on pricing, hiring and new markets
  • A profitable, bootstrapped company with no investor setting the plan. You set the spending rules.
  • Finance and legal in one role, with the international entities and the group structure as your own build project
  • Freedom to pick your tools and to automate or outsource anything that does not need you
  • Office in Zürich, on site Monday to Thursday, flexible hours and holiday planning
  • A salary band stated upfront, plus participation

How we hire

  1. Introduction, 15-minute video call
  2. Conversation with one of the founders, 30 minutes, about the company, the numbers and the role
  3. A practical case with the team, remote or in Zürich. We work through our real model and one open question together. There is no homework to hand in.
  4. Final conversation and decision. We decide quickly and tell you why.

Don't you meet every requirement? Apply anyway. Tell us in two paragraphs about the messiest finance or legal situation you have sorted out. You don't need a cover letter.

Het team Product Engineering, onderdeel van de Semitest Group, wordt steeds belangrijker binnen Salland Engineering. Binnen deze omgeving ben je verantwoordelijk voor het vrijgeven van testoplossingen voor kwalificatie, karakterisatie en productie test. Je werkt continu aan verbeteringen en streeft samen met je team naar efficiëntere processen en tooling. Storingen zie je niet als obstakel, maar als uitdaging. Je schakelt snel, denkt analytisch én praktisch en zorgt ervoor dat we optimaal blijven presteren.   • Je begeleidt nieuwe productintroducties (NPI) in productieomgevingen;

  • Je beheert en evalueert kwalificatie- en betrouwbaarheidstesten, zoals HTOL, HAST en Temp Cycle;

  • Je analyseert testdata om prestaties, yield en betrouwbaarheid te beoordelen;

  • Je troubleshoot op device-, hardware- en softwareniveau en voert root cause analyses uit bij testafwijkingen, yield drops en product failures;

  • Je verleent technische ondersteuning aan productie- en testteams bij productissues en analyseert en lost device-, test- en procesafwijkingen op;

Al meer dan 30 jaar ontwikkelen wij oplossingen en leveren wij diensten voor het testen van chips. Onze technologie vind je terug in alledaagse producten zoals smartphones, tablets en auto's. title: Software Engineer
description:
Do you want to work in a high tech environment where innovation is not a promise, but daily practice? At Salland Engineering, you work on technology for testing the chips of tomorrow. You will have access to state of the art tooling, modern test facilities and an environment where your own ideas, creativity and initiative are valued.

Salland Engineering is growing fast. This year, we are doubling our effective workspace, further expanding our testers and investing heavily in new technologies, including innovation in the field of photonics. As part of a global player in the semiconductor test market, we combine international strength with the freedom and short lines of communication of Salland in Zwolle.

As a Software Engineer, you develop C++ software, software calibration protocols and user interfaces for high tech electrical measuring instruments. These systems are used to test the most advanced chips behind the innovations of the future. This role is specifically focused on software development on the PC side.

Technical challenges do not put you off. On the contrary, you enjoy solving them and working closely together with your software, hardware and firmware colleagues to create smart and reliable solutions. Do you have a completed Bachelor’s degree in ICT, Software Engineering, Computer Science or Electrical Engineering and already have several years of work experience? Are you familiar with C++ software development and do you feel at home in PC side software development? Then it is good to know that this position is not focused on embedded software development. Does it suit you to show initiative and work together with other technical colleagues on highly innovative projects? Then we are looking for you.

What you will be doing in your role

  • Designing, implementing and verifying drivers (PC-based) for high-tech instruments in test solutions for ATE (Automatic Test Equipment);

  • Designing, implementing and verifying calibration protocols to ensure the accuracy of the instruments;

  • Writing automated tests for hardware validation and developing user interfaces;

  • Keeping information up to date;

  • You are responsible for your own planning and report to your project leader / scrum master.

Were will you work

Nice to meet you, we are Salland Engineering from Zwolle!

For more than 30 years, we have been developing solutions and providing services for testing chips. Our technology can be found in everyday products such as smartphones, tablets and cars. Together with around 95 colleagues, we work on innovative projects every day and serve the world’s largest manufacturers of chips and measuring instruments.

What will you get from us

A challenging job in a high-tech environment. We value taking initiative and taking responsibility, but there is more!

We offer:

  • An attractive salary, depending on your education and experience, between €3,866.22 and €5,523.18 gross per month (job scale: Engineer Expert B) based on a 40-hour workweek;

  • An environment where development is central. For us, it is essential to remain an interesting player in the market. That is why, as an employee at Salland Engineering, you are given all the space, opportunities and freedom to develop yourself, so we grow together;

  • Excellent secondary employment conditions, such as a 13th month, 24 vacation days, 5 roster-free days and a discount on your supplementary insurance;

  • A good work-life balance. We apply flexible working hours, giving you the room to arrange personal matters before or after working hours, meet with friends/family or go exercising.

  • Speaking of sports, you also receive a discount on your sports/fitness membership with us;

  • A collegial and informal company. We enjoy doing fun activities together and hope that you would like to be part of that.


What do we ask of you

  • A completed Bachelor’s degree in ICT, Software Engineering, Computer Science or Electrical Engineering;

  • At least 5 years of experience in programming C++ applications;

  • Affinity with hardware electronics and the ability to read and interpret electrical schematics;

  • Experience in working with oscilloscopes and other measuring equipment for testing and validating software functionality is a plus;

  • You have a good command of both Dutch and English;

  • You live in the Netherlands and within a maximum travel time of one hour from our office in Zwolle;

  • If you are not a Dutch or EU citizen, you already have a valid Dutch work visa.

title: UX Designer
description:
Of je jezelf nu UX Designer, Interaction Designer of Product Designer noemt: jij zorgt ervoor dat digitale producten en services logisch werken voor de mensen die ze gebruiken. Je beweegt makkelijk tussen strategie, gebruikersbehoeften, interactie en technologie. Van eerste inzicht en concept tot een uitgewerkt ontwerp dat daadwerkelijk gebouwd en gebruikt wordt.

Wat ga je doen als UX Designer bij Norday?

Bij Norday werken we aan complexe vraagstukken waarvoor niet altijd meteen duidelijk is wat de juiste oplossing is. Nieuwe technologie, veranderende verwachtingen en maatschappelijke ontwikkelingen vragen organisaties om richting te kiezen én die richting concreet te maken.

Als UX Designer help jij daarbij. Je vergroot de verbeeldingskracht van opdrachtgevers met scherpe inzichten en snelle prototypes. Je onderzoekt wat mensen nodig hebben, maakt complexe informatie begrijpelijk en vertaalt strategische keuzes naar digitale producten en services die in de praktijk werken. Je werkt daarbij nauw samen met strategen, service designers, visual designers, developers en projectmanagers.

Je werkt aan nieuwe digitale platforms, slimme tools, gepersonaliseerde ervaringen en nieuwe diensten. Soms ligt er al een duidelijke strategie, soms help je die samen met het team verder vormgeven. Je bent gedurende het hele proces betrokken: van het eerste vraagstuk en onderzoek tot concept, ontwerp, validatie en realisatie.

Wat je gaat doen:

  • Je duikt in de context van een vraagstuk en brengt gebruikers, behoeften, doelen en knelpunten in kaart;

  • Je vertaalt inzichten en strategie naar een concept, user flows, journeys en prototypes;

  • Je maakt complexe vraagstukken begrijpelijk en helpt klanten en teams om keuzes te maken;

  • Je faciliteert workshops en co-creatiesessies met klanten, gebruikers en collega’s;

  • Je bedenkt en test verschillende oplossingsrichtingen en gebruikt inzichten uit onderzoek om je ontwerp steeds verder aan te scherpen;

  • Je onderzoekt hoe AI kan bijdragen aan nieuwe diensten, betere ervaringen en waarde voor organisaties en de mensen die ze gebruiken;

  • Je zorgt dat interacties, flows en details helder zijn voor visual designers, developers én agents;

  • Je bewaakt de gebruikerservaring tot het product of de service daadwerkelijk werkt;

  • Je werkt samen met strategen en andere disciplines aan oplossingen die niet alleen prettig werken, maar bijdragen aan de richting en waarde van de organisatie.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig naar hoe mensen dingen gebruiken en waarom ze bepaalde keuzes maken. Je kunt goed luisteren, doorvragen en verbanden leggen. Tegelijkertijd ben je niet iemand die eindeloos blijft onderzoeken: je krijgt energie van het concreet maken van inzichten en het samenbrengen van verschillende perspectieven in een heldere oplossing.

  • Je kunt schakelen tussen het grotere verhaal en het detail. Je begrijpt wat een strategische keuze betekent voor een gebruikerservaring en weet wat er nodig is om een idee technisch en organisatorisch haalbaar te maken.

  • Je bent zelfstandig in je werk, zoekt actief de samenwerking op en kunt je ontwerpkeuzes goed uitleggen aan zowel klanten als collega’s. Je hoeft niet overal het antwoord op te hebben. Wel wil je begrijpen wat er speelt en samen tot een oplossing komen die klopt.

Onze ideale UX Designer …

  • heeft een aantal jaar ervaring als UX Designer, Interaction Designer of Product Designer;

  • heeft ervaring met complexe digitale vraagstukken en het ontwerpen van digitale producten of services;

  • kan zelfstandig onderzoek, conceptontwikkeling, interaction design en prototyping oppakken;

  • heeft ruime ervaring met Figma en bijvoorbeeld Miro of vergelijkbare tools;

  • vindt het leuk om workshops en co-creatiesessies te begeleiden;

  • kan goed samenwerken met strategen, service designers, visual designers en developers;

  • beheerst de Nederlandse taal goed, vanwege de grote mate van klantcontact, interviews, workshops en samenwerking;

  • heeft een HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld vanuit CMD, Design for Interaction of een vergelijkbare opleiding;

  • is nieuwsgierig naar de mogelijkheden van AI en experimenteert ermee in eigen processen. Je ziet AI als een nieuwe manier om onderzoek te doen, samen te werken, te ontwerpen en ideeën sneller te verkennen en toetsen.

Wat bieden we jou?

  • Een salaris van €3.600 tot €4.700 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring;

  • Hybride werken vanuit Rotterdam en thuis;

  • Een persoonlijk budget van €750 voor je thuiswerkplek;

  • 25 vakantiedagen;

  • Een goede pensioenregeling en leasefietsregeling;

  • Een NS Business Card;

  • Een persoonlijk leer- en ontwikkelplan en veel ruimte om te leren van collega’s en vakexperts;

  • Afwisselende projecten waarin strategie, design, technologie en domeinkennis samenkomen;

  • Een team van nieuwsgierige en betrokken collega’s die kwaliteit belangrijk vinden;

  • De mogelijkheid om mee te bouwen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van Norday.

Norday stimuleert een diverse werkomgeving en is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. We moedigen sollicitanten van alle achtergronden en identiteiten aan om te solliciteren. Daarnaast nemen we sociale en ecologische impact mee in onze besluitvorming en in jouw performance reviews.

Vragen? Neem dan contact met ons op via 010 221 46 00 of

Norday: Ready to Lead

Norday helpt organisaties richting te geven aan verandering en hun veranderkracht te vergroten. We combineren strategie, design, technologie en domeinkennis om complexe vraagstukken concreet te maken en oplossingen te ontwikkelen die in de praktijk werken. Van transformatiestrategie, digitale en datastrategie tot nieuwe producten, diensten en AI-toepassingen: we gidsen organisaties bij waar ze naartoe willen en helpen ze om daar te komen.

We werken in multidisciplinaire teams samen met opdrachtgevers in cultuur, zorg en welzijn, educatie, overheden, NGO’s en climate tech aan de grote vraagstukken van deze tijd. Daarbij verbinden we de mogelijkheden van technologie met de context van organisaties en de mensen die ermee werken. Norday is onderdeel van Handpicked en een B Corp.

title: Afstudeerstage IT
description:
Bij BAS, Europa’s grootste dealer in commerciële voertuigen én officieel Volvo en Renault Trucks dealer, krijg jij de kans om je te ontwikkelen binnen IT in de automotive branche. Ben jij op zoek naar een afstudeerstage vanaf januari/ februari 2027? Dan is dit iets voor jou!

BAS World groeit hard, en IT speelt daarin een sleutelrol. Binnen ons IT-team liggen verschillende afstudeeropdrachten klaar die elk een echt vraagstuk uit ons IT-landschap aanpakken. Elke opdracht heeft een eigen team dat je dagelijks begeleidt. Zo breng je je kennis in de praktijk en kickstart je samen met ons jouw carrière.

Mogelijke afstudeeropdrachten

1. Continuous performance & load testing (Engineering)
BAS World wil het aantal voertuigadvertenties online ongeveer 20 keer zo groot maken. In deze opdracht zorg je dat onze websites en systemen die groei aankunnen. Je onderzoekt welke (AI-gedreven) testtools passen bij onze stack. Daarna bouw je samen met het IDP-team een testsuite die dagelijks automatisch draait in de pipeline. Het resultaat is een productieklare testopzet en een advies over knelpunten en capaciteit.
Past bij: Software Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure.

2. Kleine AI-agents voor de business (Data / AI engineering)
In deze opdracht werk je als interne consultant binnen één afdeling, bijvoorbeeld Logistiek. Je spreekt gebruikers, brengt hun processen en knelpunten in kaart en bepaalt waar AI het meeste oplevert. Daarna bouw je één of meer kleine AI-agents op basis van de services en data die we al hebben. Je test ze en verbetert ze tot ze echt gebruikt worden in het dagelijkse werk.
Past bij: AI, Data Science, Business IT, Software Engineering, als je graag dicht op eindgebruikers werkt.

3. Realtime monitoring & bottleneck-analyse voor Thinkwise-applicaties (Engineering)
Verschillende kernapplicaties draaien op het low-code platform Thinkwise. Als gebruikers traagheid melden, kost het nu weken om de oorzaak te vinden. In deze opdracht bouw je monitoring die de performance over de hele stack realtime inzichtelijk maakt: van UI en applicatielaag tot database en netwerk. Die performance komt live op een scherm op de werkvloer van onze developers. Daarnaast ontwikkel je rapportage- en analysetooling waarmee developers bottlenecks precies kunnen aanwijzen en oplossen waar ze ontstaan. Zo vinden we problemen in uren in plaats van weken.
Past bij: Software Engineering, Infrastructure, DevOps, met interesse in performance en observability.

4. Problem management & ITSM-procesoptimalisatie (System & Application Management)
Onze Servicedesk en het S&AM-team krijgen veel meldingen binnen in Jira. Terugkerende problemen worden nog te weinig bij de bron opgelost. In deze opdracht breng je de ITSM-processen in kaart en leg je ze vast: processtromen, werkinstructies en rollen. Je toetst ze aan good practices zoals ITIL. Daarna ontwerp en implementeer je problem management als een vast proces, zodat terugkerende issues structureel verdwijnen.
Past bij: Business IT & Management, IT Service Management of verwant.

5. Datagedreven leadgeneratie met FleetCareXL & BAS World (Product)

Wij verbinden chips met computernetwerken die enorme hoeveelheden data verwerken, met minimale vertraging. Samen veranderen we de manier waarop de wereld met elkaar verbonden is.

In Zoetermeer werkt ons grafeenteam aan de toekomst van de halfgeleiderindustrie, van onderzoek en ontwikkeling tot industrialisatie. Op het snijvlak van materiaalkunde en halfgeleidertechnologie ontwikkelt het team de processen om grafeen te produceren, te karakteriseren en te integreren. Die processen vormen de basis van onze geïntegreerde grafeenfotonica. Het team pioniert met nieuwe procestechnologie en schaalt die op tot productierijpe oplossingen. Zo wordt baanbrekend onderzoek omgezet in de bouwstenen van de chips van morgen.

Black Semiconductor is op zoek naar een gemotiveerde Technicus (m/v/x) om ons team op locatie in Zoetermeer, Nederland, te versterken.

Je speelt een cruciale rol bij het waarborgen van de betrouwbare werking van alle technische systemen die onze cleanroomomgeving ondersteunen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor onderhouds-, storingsanalyse- en reparatiewerkzaamheden aan voorzieningen zoals luchtbehandeling, gas-, water- en elektrische systemen. Deze functie is ideaal voor een praktisch ingestelde professional met technisch inzicht die graag zelfstandig werkt, technische uitdagingen oplost en nieuwe vaardigheden ontwikkelt in een sterk gecontroleerde en innovatieve omgeving.

  • Uitvoeren van preventief onderhoud, storingsanalyse en reparaties aan productie en test apparatuur in de cleanroom en cleanroom systemen en inkomende nutsvoorzieningen.

  • Technische problemen diagnosticeren en oplossen om stilstand tot een minimum te beperken en de operationele continuïteit te waarborgen.

  • Onderhoudswerkzaamheden coördineren en uitvoeren, met inachtneming van normen en veiligheidsvoorschriften.

  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden in het Engels, bij voorkeur ook in het Nederlands om te kunnen communiceren met externe partijen, management en operators.

Hoe succes eruitziet

  • Volledige verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor de cleanroominfrastructuur, en zorgen voor een betrouwbare werking van luchtbehandeling, gas-, water-, afzuig- en elektrische systemen met minimale stilstand.

Mensen boven processen. Bij Black Semiconductor is flexibiliteit essentieel — wij zorgen ervoor dat werk zich aanpast aan het leven, en niet andersom. Wij leven openheid. Samenwerking en inclusiviteit vormen de hoekstenen van onze cultuur. Wij geloven in openheid en bouwen aan vertrouwen en respect. Individualiteit is onze gezamenlijke kracht, die innovatie stimuleert en ons vooruit helpt.

What you'll be doing:

  • Ship growth experiments, fast: Take ideas from our growth backlog and get them live: landing pages, tools, ads and content. Run plenty of them, keep what works and kill what doesn't.

How we'll measure success:

  • Experiments shipped each month, and what we learned from them

  • Demo requests from organic and other non-paid channels

  • How often Tebi appears in AI answers for our category, by market

  • Demos from free tools, the reservation widget and programmatic pages

What you’ll bring:

  • Think like a growth marketer but move like a hacker. You know what drives results and how to build just enough to prove it

  • Ship rather than spec. A working prototype today beats a polished plan next week

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Operations Foundations
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Wolt is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Front-end-leaning) to join our Operations Foundations team. The team sits within the DoorDash Client and AI Development group and is responsible for the foundation that hundreds of engineers across Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo rely on to build internal operations tools. Our platform hosts 250+ micro-frontends (MFEs) used to operate every part of the business.

Our team is focused on building a scalable, reliable, and high-quality internal tooling platform that supports Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo's operations and business.

The team plays an important role in improving how engineers build, test, and ship software across the organization, with a strong emphasis on reusable libraries, micro-frontend architecture, and agentic development: building the platform where AI agents can take changes from task to merged PR safely and reliably without lowering the quality bar.

Currently, we are focused on unifying our frontend platforms, evolving shared components and library development, improving developer productivity, and enabling teams to deliver more independently through better architecture and tooling.

It's an exciting time to join because the team has strong ownership and a broad technical impact.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who can take ownership of complex technical initiatives across both frontend and sometimes backend and infra domains. In this role, you'll work primarily with TypeScript, React, Node.js, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Buildkite), and MFE architecture to build scalable, maintainable solutions that support multiple product teams and business areas.

Success in this role means becoming a trusted technical owner who consistently delivers reliable solutions and helps the team execute more effectively. Six months into the role, we'd expect you to be independently leading technical initiatives and contributing meaningfully to architecture and delivery planning.

This role offers the opportunity to solve challenging engineering problems with visible impact across the business. It's especially exciting for someone who enjoys combining product engineering with platform thinking, improving developer workflows, and building systems that scale across teams and domains.

What you'll be doing

  • Owning the Foundation: the runtime, build, deployment, and developer experience that 250+ MFEs and hundreds of engineers depend on every day.
  • Evolving Our Micro-Frontend Architecture: improve composition, isolation, and shared dependency strategies so feature teams can move fast.
  • Product and Planning: Independently drive projects from idea to production: breaking down ambiguous problems into clear technical plans, estimating delivery, identifying risks early, and delivering high-quality solutions in a timely manner.
  • Supporting Engineering Excellence: Champion best practices, raise the bar for code quality, and turn lessons learned into platform improvements.
  • Long-Term Thinking: Balance short-term feature unblockers with the long-term health, security, and maintainability of the platform.
  • Agentic Development: Build the foundations that let AI agents work autonomously on our platform, including agent instructions, reusable skills, tool integrations, guardrails, and the automated checks that make agent-authored changes safe to ship.
  • AI Fluency: Work agent-first in your own day-to-day: delegate implementation to agents, and focus your judgment on direction, architecture, and verifying outcomes.

📍This role can be based in our Berlin tech hub. Read more about our hybrid setup here.

Feel free to check out the Wolt Tech Blog for more insight into our culture and technology.

Our humble expectations

  • Proven expertise in building production frontend applications using TypeScript and React.
  • Solid backend knowledge, comfortable owning and operating Node.js services that support frontend infrastructure.
  • Strong knowledge of frontend build tools, bundlers, and module systems, and the ability to evolve them as the platform grows.
  • Track record of diagnosing and resolving complex performance, reliability, or DX issues in large frontend codebases.
  • Experience driving technical initiatives across multiple engineering teams and stakeholders.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills: aligning priorities, managing expectations, and communicating trade-offs clearly with partner teams and leadership.
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative, platform-mindset approach to working with feature teams.
  • Strong documentation skills, including experience writing RFCs or ADRs.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with micro-frontend architecture.
  • Frontend platform engineering experience.
  • Experience building shared component libraries used by many product teams.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, deployment processes, and cloud infrastructure for frontend workloads.
  • Experience or interest in observability and reliability (SRE).
  • Experience building tooling or workflows for autonomous AI coding agents (e.g., agent instructions, skills, MCP servers, or evaluating agent-generated code).

What's in it for you

  • Impact: Build and shape the platform that thousands of people depend on.
  • Scale: Work on real platform problems behind 250+ MFEs with hundreds of monthly contributors.
  • Collaboration: Partner with talented engineers, designers, and operators across companies to make their daily work faster and better.
  • Growth: Take on deep technical challenges across frontend architecture, agentic development, DX, and improving engineering efficiency.
  • Culture: Be part of a diverse, open-minded team that values creativity, autonomy, and continuous learning.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

OIXIO gehört zu den führenden IT-Anbietern Estlands – einem Land, das wie kaum ein anderes in Europa für gelebte Digitalisierung und einen hohen Stellenwert von Cybersecurity steht.

Was dort über viele Jahre gewachsen ist, bringen wir jetzt verstärkt nach Deutschland: technologische Kompetenz, pragmatische Lösungen, direkte Zusammenarbeit und die Überzeugung, dass gute Digitalisierung vor allem eines tun muss – funktionieren.

In Deutschland stehen wir mit unserer gemeinsamen Geschichte noch am Anfang – und kaum jemand kennt hier bisher unseren Namen. Genau deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der das ändern will und lieber etwas aufbaut, als eine fertige Rolle zu übernehmen.

Die Aufgabe

Als Marketing & Communications Manager Deutschland machst Du OIXIO bei mittelständischen Industrieunternehmen bekannt und vertrauenswürdig – vor allem in Norddeutschland und Nordrhein-Westfalen – und schaffst die Gespräche, auf denen unser Vertrieb aufbaut.

Du pflegst Kontakte zu Fach- und Regionalmedien und platzierst Artikel, Fachbeiträge und Kundengeschichten.

Du organisierst eigene Veranstaltungen – vom Kundenfrühstück im Werk über Webinare bis zu Roundtables – und wählst die Messen und Netzwerkveranstaltungen aus, auf denen wir präsent sind.

Du erstellst Inhalte, die überzeugen: Case Studies, One-Pager, Präsentationen, Videos und Webinhalte – gemeinsam mit unseren Fachleuten in Deutschland, Estland und Litauen.

Du misst, was wirkt – Website-Besuche, Anfragen, Veranstaltungsteilnahmen, aktivierte Zielunternehmen und Vertriebstermine – und steuerst Deine Aktivitäten in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM.

Unsere Themen: Cybersecurity, Informationssicherheit, Managed IT Services, Microsoft Business Central/NAV-Modernisierung, Prozessdigitalisierung, Industrial IoT, Cloud, Daten und KI.

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Marketing oder in der Unternehmenskommunikation, idealerweise mit IT-Services, Managed Services, Industrieautomation, Beratung oder Business-Anwendungen.

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge darin, Sichtbarkeit aufzubauen und Nachfrage zu erzeugen – gerne auch als erste oder einzige Marketingverantwortliche in einem Unternehmen oder Markt.

  • Starke Schreibkompetenz, sicherer Umgang mit LinkedIn, CRM und Web-Analytics, sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und sehr gutes Englisch.

  • Du kennst die wichtigsten Werkzeuge des modernen B2B-Marketings und weißt, wie Du ihre Wirkung misst. Ob Dynamics 365, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Analytics, SEO-Tools oder KI: Entscheidend ist für uns nicht, dass Du jedes Tool bereits beherrschst, sondern dass Du weißt, was Du erreichen willst, und Dich schnell in neue Werkzeuge einarbeiten kannst.
