Was gut zu uns passt

  • Du hast Freude daran, Dinge aufzubauen. Ein komplett bestelltes Feld brauchst Du nicht – im Gegenteil: Du erkennst Möglichkeiten, entwickelst Ideen und übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, daraus etwas zu machen.

  • Du kannst die Stärke und Erfahrung einer etablierten internationalen IT-Gruppe nutzen und gleichzeitig mit uns herausfinden, was davon für den deutschen Mittelstand wirklich relevant ist.

  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, aber nicht als Einzelkämpfer. Bei uns ist Marketing Teamsport: Gute Ergebnisse entstehen gemeinsam mit Vertrieb, Consultants, Technik und Geschäftsführung.

  • Du misst Deinen Erfolg at Gesprächen und Kunden – nicht an Likes – und versprichst nichts, was unser Team nicht halten kann.

  • Und Du hast Lust, ein Stück des OIXIO Spirits aus Estland nach Deutschland zu bringen – und ihm hier gemeinsam mit uns eine eigene Handschrift zu geben.

Was wir bieten

  • Eine konkrete Rolle beim Aufbau von OIXIO in Deutschland – mit Gestaltungsspielraum und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.

  • Ein echtes Budget für Veranstaltungen, Inhalte und Medienarbeit sowie Unterstützung durch Spezialisten, wo es nötig ist.

  • Erfahrene Fachleute in Deutschland, Estland und Litauen, die Inhalte, Demos und Vorträge beisteuern.

  • Wir erwarten viel und geben auch viel zurück: Vertrauen, Freiraum, faire Bedingungen und Menschen, auf die Du Dich verlassen kannst.

Warum diese Rolle interessant ist

Deutschland ist für OIXIO ein wichtiger Wachstumsmarkt. Mit unserer lokalen Basis in Oldenburg, einem erfahrenen Team und einem relevanten Angebot passen wir gut zu den Herausforderungen vieler mittelständischer Industrieunternehmen – jetzt muss es der Markt nur noch erfahren.

Wenn Du Erfahrung im B2B-Marketing mitbringst, Lust hast, eine Marke von Grund auf bekannt zu machen, und lieber mit einem guten Team als mit großen Schlagworten arbeitest, freuen wir uns auf das Gespräch mit Dir.

About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

EggAI Labs

The problem: EvalOps

How do we prove an AI system acts as expected under various conditions?

We will explore EvalOps: the methods and tools used to check whether domain-specific AI systems meet their behavioral requirements. Among the key challenges for operating AI systems are nondeterminism, ground-truth curation, evaluation metric-design, latency and costs. EvalOps need to overcome all of them in a disciplined way.

These questions will guide the initial work:

  • Regression suites: How can domain experts turn traces, code, and prompts into useful evals in a way that scales?

  • Coverage estimation: How can we quantify the gaps between an eval suite and the range of expected agent behaviors?

  • Live monitoring: Is it possible to detect anomalous behaviour in production with a similar precision to regression evals?

  • Eval analysis: How much evidence is enough to act (e.g., deploy, debug, roll back a feature, choose a different model)? You will help refine them, test approaches, create assets, and pose new questions.

The role

As an AI Builder, you will take an open EvalOps problem from investigation to a working prototype, ready to be tested. Whatever your focus, you will be expected to take a problem through to a useful result. Here is what that means in practice:

  • Research emerging AI and evaluation capabilities and distinguish substance from hype.

  • Understand the user, workflow, domain, and organisational problem around the work.

  • Evaluate usefulness, quality, safety, and reliability with appropriate evidence.

  • Communicate decisions and learning clearly.

  • Create assets that other people can understand, use, and improve.

  • Code and build end to end.

This shared foundation leaves room for different strengths and interests. Each AI Builder will then develop greater depth in one of three pillars.

Three pillars, different passions

Pillar

Driving question

Possible EvalOps focus

Product

What should we build?

Workflows and interfaces that help domain experts create evals, inspect traces, understand results, and make decisions.

Engineering

How should we build it?

Dependable and scalable evaluation infrastructure, trace processing, monitoring, and governance tooling.

Data Science

How do we know it works?

Coverage measures, sampling strategies, scoring methods, statistical tests, anomaly detection, and reasoning under uncertainty.

We expect every AI Builder to develop a practical foundation across all three pillars and to pursue greater depth in the one that most strongly matches their passion.

What we value

  • Problem obsession. A difficult question captures your curiosity. You keep returning to it, pursue ideas without waiting for instructions, and care deeply about finding an answer that works.

  • Initiative and follow-through. You turn uncertainty into something you can investigate, test, and improve—and stay resourceful when the first approach fails.

  • Evidence of making things work. Show us something you created, the decisions you made, and what you learned along the way.

  • Independent judgment. You test new capabilities yourself, distinguish evidence from enthusiasm, and change your mind when the findings warrant it.

  • Generosity in collaboration. You explain your thinking, seek candid feedback, act on it, and help others make progress. 

What is required

  • You are pursuing a Master’s degree.

  • You can write code and turn an idea into working, tested software.

  • You can work from Tübingen and communicate fluently in English, our company language.

Relevant fields include Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Physics, Bioinformatics, Computational Neuroscience, Medical Informatics, Quantitative Data Science, Cognitive Science. We also welcome candidates from other disciplines who can demonstrate strong problem-solving and practical technical ability.

What you will gain

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Our Company

"Buying Labs is the leading global partner for sourcing and distributing premium consumer goods!"

We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer (m/f/d) to join our Tech team at our Hamburg headquarters. Our goal is to supercharge how our business works with AI and technology, wherever it makes a real difference. You'll build the systems our teams rely on every day, from internal applications to the data and AI capabilities behind them, and see the impact of your work directly in the business.

This is a role for an experienced engineer who takes real ownership: someone who designs solid systems, builds AI into them where it adds value, and drives their work through to production and real users.

Your Mission

  • Own systems end to end: Design, build and run features across frontend and backend, from technical approach through deployment and support in production.
  • Build AI into our products: Design and integrate AI-powered features such as structured extraction, classification, automation and agentic workflows. Make them reliable through validation, evaluation and human review where it matters.
  • Data modelling and architecture: Build solid data models in PostgreSQL that serve as the foundation for our applications and AI features. Make architecture decisions that keep our systems maintainable as they grow.
  • Modern and established codebases: Build new applications on our modern stack, and maintain and modernise our established JavaScript platform, which our teams rely on every day.
  • Quality you can stand behind: Write tested, reviewed code and verify your own work before it reaches users. Monitor and troubleshoot production issues.
  • Work closely with the business: Understand the processes behind what you build, work directly with our commercial and operational teams, and help shape what gets built and why.
  • Raise the bar: Share knowledge,

Your Profile

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of building and running production applications end to end.
  • Proven experience building AI into production systems or applications, for example LLM-based extraction or classification, RAG, or agentic and tool-use workflows. You know how to make AI output reliable through validation, evaluation and fallbacks. Using AI coding assistants alone does not meet this requirement.
  • You use AI tools in your daily development work and have solid habits for checking and reviewing what they produce.
  • Strong TypeScript and JavaScript, and modern React, including hooks and state management.
  • Strong backend experience with Node.js and Express or a comparable framework, REST APIs, and integrating external systems.
  • Deep PostgreSQL and SQL skills, with solid data modelling and experience with an ORM or query builder such as Knex, Sequelize or Prisma.
  • Comfortable working across both modern TypeScript applications and an established JavaScript codebase.
  • Strong quality mindset: automated testing, code reviews, and taking responsibility for what you ship.
  • High ownership and drive: you push your work through to done, raise problems early, and don't wait to be told what to do next.
  • Clear communication with both technical and non-technical colleagues.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Fluent English required; German is a plus.
  • Based in Hamburg or willing to relocate.

Nice to Have

  • Depth in LLM tooling: provider APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini), agent and tool-use patterns (MCP), and evaluating output quality.
  • Vector search (pgvector or similar).
  • Product or process awareness: experience understanding how a business works and turning messy processes into structured systems.
  • Experience integrating ERPs or operational systems (orders, inventory, master data).
  • Our wider stack: Bun, Vite, Redis, RabbitMQ, Docker, GitHub Actions, AWS.
  • Observability and product analytics tools (e.g. Sentry, Datadog, PostHog).
  • Python for data tooling.
  • Background in eCommerce, wholesale or B2B environments.

Why Us?

  • An awesome team & great vibes: Work with motivated colleagues in an agile, ambitious, and friendly atmosphere where collaboration and fun go hand in hand with high speed.
  • Flat hierarchies & real growth opportunities: Take ownership of your role and develop personally alongside the company. We promote from within and value every voice, regardless of seniority or title.
  • Modern workplace & cutting-edge equipment: State-of-the-art office setup including adjustable desks, mobile treadmills, air conditioning, and everything you need to excel in your role.
  • Company pension program (bAV): Smart pension plan with a 30% Buying Labs grant on your contribution, investing in your financial future together.
  • Corporate Benefits membership: Access exclusive discounts from a wide range of partner brands and retailers.
  • Full "Deutschlandticket" coverage: We cover the complete cost (ca. €60/month) so you can travel sustainably and conveniently throughout Germany.
  • Free bike options: Choose between a complimentary "Swapfiets" bike (original or deluxe 7) or opt for JobRad bike-leasing with an additional €26/month grant from Buying Labs.
  • Complimentary food & beverages: Free Friday lunch in the office, plus organic fruit & vegetables, drinks, snacks, coffee/tea, healthy shots and seasonal treats (e.g. ice cream, soups) throughout the week.
  • Personalized workspace setup: €100 welcome voucher to customize and optimize your workspace from day one.
  • Refer-A-Friend (employee referral program): You love being part of Buying Labs? Fantastic! Then recommend people from your personal network and receive attractive rewards.

Sounds like a perfect fit? We can't wait to meet you. Apply now and be part of our journey!

title: Junior Marketing Manager
description:
Welcome to MVST

We're a full product delivery studio based in Munich and Barcelona, on a mission to help companies build products and services that truly make a difference in the world.

At MVST, we take ideas from 0 to 1, whether it's through strategy, UX/UI design, product management, or software development. We empower and collaborate with businesses at every pivotal stage to craft tailor-made digital experiences that stand out.

What makes us unique? A few things:

We're completely independent.

We're known for innovative design, progressive ways of working, and cutting-edge technology.

And most importantly… we don't take ourselves too seriously. We believe in enjoying the journey, celebrating wins (big or small), and creating things that matter.

Our services are:

Full Product Delivery

Product Management & Strategy

UI/UX Design

Software Development

⚙ DevOps / MLOps / AI

Role Overview:

Marketing & Content

  • Plan and run multi-channel campaigns across various channels (LinkedIn, newsletter, website, etc.) that grow MVST's brand, bring in qualified leads and acquire new customers, from the first brief to the final report.
  • Turn our work into stories. Collaborate with our designers, developers and product managers to create project showcases, articles and short-form video that show what we build and how we build it.
  • Own our social media presence, with a focus on LinkedIn, and keep our followers hooked, well-informed and craving more!
  • Keep our brand visible wherever people search: classic SEO for our website, plus making sure we show up in AI-powered search and answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI Overviews.
  • Get hands-on with performance marketing (Google Ads, Social Media Ads, etc.) to squeeze the most out of every campaign.
  • Use AI tools smartly across your workflow, from research and first drafts to repurposing content and analysing results, while keeping our voice human and our quality high.
  • Help us throw killer events that not only rock but also give our brand some serious street cred!
  • Ensure consistent messaging and branding across every channel and touchpoint.


Business Development & Growth

  • Conduct comprehensive market and competitor research to identify trends, opportunities, and threats.
  • Use data-driven insights to inform decisions, optimize campaigns, and measure ROI, with simple dashboards to track what works.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities and partnerships to boost revenue and market share.
  • Set up and execute lead generation strategies (e.g. email marketing, marketing automation and CRM).
  • Maintain customer relationships and help develop sustainable business development and sales strategies.
  • Support our founders and sales team with pitch materials and case studies.


Ideal Qualifications:

  • 1–2 years of solid experience in marketing and/or business development, ideally in B2B, SaaS, tech or an agency environment.
  • Genuine curiosity about tech products, design and digitalization. You enjoy explaining complex things in a simple way.
  • A track record that screams success in hitting sales targets
  • A strong writer who can switch tone from a snappy LinkedIn post to a detailed case study.
  • Nailing it with marketing analytics and tools like LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, Google Analytics 4, a CRM (Storyblok), and Canva or Figma basics.
  • Comfortable working with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) and excited to experiment with new ones.
  • Data-minded: numbers don't scare you, and you know which KPIs actually matter.
  • Got a knack for strategic thinking and problem-solving.
  • Organised and proactive. You juggle multiple projects without dropping the ball and take ownership without waiting to be asked.
  • Top-notch communicator, negotiator and presenter.
  • Creative and innovative thinker, no dull moments here!
  • Bonus points for video editing skills, event organisation experience, or B2B lead generation.
  • Fluent English skills complete your profile. German and/or Spanish is a plus.


Perks & Benefits at MVST

At MVST, we support our team inside and outside the office with a range of perks:

  • Fully stocked offices with great coffee, granola, cereals, and more
  • Flexible hours and remote work options
  • 25 annual vacation days + 2 extra days off over the holidays (24.12 & 31.12)
  • €500 travel budget to work from our Munich or Barcelona offices
  • Company-sponsored retreats (Mallorca, Italy), hackathons, and monthly events like breakfasts, lunches, and after-works
  • €1,500 annual learning budget + access to Udemy courses
  • Home office setup support if you live over 60 min from the office
  • €50 monthly top-up for lifestyle perks: choose from Wellhub or Alan Health Insurance


Our Recruitment Process

While the process might slightly vary depending on the role, here's what you can typically expect:

  1. Intro Call: A quick 15–20 minute chat with someone from our people team
  2. Take-home Assignment: You'll have one week to complete a task relevant to the role
  3. Technical Interview: A 1-hour deep dive with the Hiring Manager
  4. Team Meet-up: If you're based near one of our offices, we might invite you to visit and meet the team in person


Equal Opportunities at MVST

At MVST, we know that our strength lies in our people, and in the diversity of perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds they bring. We're committed to building inclusive, supportive, and diverse teams that reflect the world we design for.

We warmly welcome applications from people of all cultures, identities, genders, sexual orientations, abilities, and age groups. Everyone deserves to feel valued and respected at work, and we work hard to foster an environment where that's the standard, free from discrimination, bias, or harassment.

Please note:

As English is our official working language at MVST, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted in English.

If you are applying from outside the EU, please clearly state this in your application.

We are looking forward to hearing from you

title: Webdesigner (w/m/d)
description:
Einleitung

Wir sind auf der Suche nach neuen Kollegen! Migrando ist ein Legal-Tech-Unternehmen aus Cottbus. Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, den komplizierten und langwierigen Prozess der Einbürgerung effizienter und kundenfreundlicher zu gestalten. Mit unserer Expertise im Ausländerrecht, unserer juristischen Kompetenz und einem starken Team von zahlreichen Mitarbeitern begleiten wir tausende Mandanten erfolgreich auf dem Weg zur deutschen Staatsbürgerschaft. Am besten verschaffst du dir gleich einen Einblick unter migrando(.)de/karriere, unserer Karriere-Page. Denn wir können hier schreiben was wir wollen, im Endeffekt bleibt es eine langweilige Einleitung.

Uns ist egal, welche Zertifikate du hast oder wo du studiert hast. Was uns interessiert: Was kannst du wirklich? Wer jahrelang in der Praxis gearbeitet und Hands-on-Erfahrungen gesammelt hat, bringt mehr mit als jeder Kursabschluss. Wir suchen nach Kollegen, die im besten Fall mehrjährige Erfahrung mitbringen und bereit sind, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

Wir bieten Dir

Bei uns erwartet dich ein Mix aus gestalterischer Freiheit und echtem Impact. Du arbeitest nicht an abstrakten Konzepten, die irgendwann vielleicht live gehen – sondern an Produkten, die täglich tausende Menschen sehen und nutzen. Dein Output ist sichtbar, messbar und macht einen Unterschied.

  • Abwechslungsreiche Kreativprojekte
    Bei uns gestaltest du echte Produkte: von Landingpages für Rechtsberatung über Infoportale bis zu interaktiven Online-Assistenten.
  • Zugang zu Premium-Tools
    Du arbeitest mit modernen Plugins und Tools wie Figma, Lovable, Bricks und Hubspot.
  • Firmen-Zugänge für Adobe und Co.
    Selbstverständlich erhältst du bei dieser Stelle Zugriff auf die Adobe Creative Cloud und alle anderen Tools, die du brauchst.
  • KI-Design
    Du darfst direkt Hand anlegen, wenn es darum geht, neue KI-Tools für deine Designs auszuprobieren. Vielleicht ergibt sich ein neuer Workflow für dich? Wir ermutigen unsere Mitarbeiter in vielen Bereichen, KI zu nutzen, um die Arbeit schneller und leichter zu machen. Dazu stellen wir dir Claude, ChatGPT und Gemini in der jeweiligen Pro-Version zur Verfügung.
  • Große Inspirations- und Asset-Bibliotheken
    Dir stehen zahlreiche Icons, Illustrationen und hochwertige Design-Assets zur Verfügung. Wir haben außerdem Pro-Zugänge für Tools wie Mobbin, damit du direkt von den großen Playern lernen kannst.
  • High-End Hardware nach Wahl
    Egal ob MacBook Pro M3 oder Dell XPS mit Linux. Du bekommst die Maschine, auf der du am besten performst, inkl. 4K-Monitoren.
  • Große Reichweite
    Über die Jahre konnten wir mit unserer Plattform bereits viele Menschen erreichen. Diese große Menge an Traffic ermöglicht es uns, schnell Ergebnisse zu sehen und führt zu einem sinnesstiftenden Arbeitsgefühl.
  • Echte Eigenverantwortung
    Du bist nicht Umsetzer fremder Ideen. Du bringst eigene Perspektiven ein, triffst gestalterische Entscheidungen und hast einen direkten Draht zu allen Teams und der Geschäftsführung – ohne lange Freigabe-Schleifen.
  • Kleine Teams statt Großraumbüro
    Du arbeitest in überschaubaren Teams, in denen man sich kennt und schnell ins Gespräch kommt.
  • Musik bei der Arbeit
    Bei uns wird nicht mit der Stirn gerunzelt, wenn du dir Kopfhörer aufsetzt. Wenn es dir hilft (und keinen anderen stört), kannst du auch gerne Heavy Metal über eine Soundanlage an deinem Schreibtisch pumpen.
  • Modernes Altbau-Büro im Herzen von Cottbus
    Hohe Decken, viel Tageslicht, Pflanzen in den Räumen und ein Innenhof für die Pause zwischendurch. Einen Einblick in unsere Räumlichkeiten kannst du dir auf unserer Website anschauen.
  • Ergonomischer Arbeitsplatz mit moderner Ausstattung
    Rückenfreundlicher Stuhl, höhenverstellbarer Tisch, zwei große Monitore, ein hochwertiges Headset, ein leistungsstarker Laptop und eine ruhige Umgebung.
  • Homeoffice-Möglichkeit
    Grundsätzlich arbeiten wir im Büro, weil Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort für uns wichtig sind. Gleichzeitig ist Home Office jederzeit möglich. Auch spontan und ohne lange Abstimmung.
  • Vertrauensarbeitszeit ohne Kernzeiten
    Bei uns gibt es keine vorgeschriebenen Zeitfenster, in denen du anwesend sein musst.
  • Flexible Teilzeitmodelle
    Ob 4-Tage-Woche, 30 Stunden oder ein individuelles Modell. Dein Job soll zu deinem Leben passen, nicht andersherum.
  • Spontan Urlaub nehmen
    Manchmal braucht man einfach eine Auszeit. Wir planen unsere Teams so, dass auch spontane freie Tage möglich sind, ganz ohne Stress oder schlechtes Gewissen.
  • Familienfreundliche Kultur
    Kranke Kinder, Elternabend oder kurzfristiger Arzttermin – wir wissen, dass solche Situationen zum Alltag gehören. Familie und Gesundheit haben bei uns Vorrang.
  • Kurze Wege
    Bei uns musst du dich nicht durch die Hierarchien hangeln oder lange Mails schreiben, um gehört zu werden. Du kannst jederzeit direkt mit Kolleg:innen, Teamleads oder der Geschäftsführung sprechen. Entscheidungen fallen schnell, Austausch ist direkt und niemand sitzt „im Elfenbeinturm“.
  • Mitgestalten statt nur abarbeiten
    Wir suchen Kolleg:innen, die mitdenken. Wenn du eine Idee hast, wie ein Prozess besser laufen kann, ein Tool sinnvoll wäre oder ein Workflow smarter funktionieren könnte, dann wirst du gehört.
  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit
    Deine Tätigkeit hat direkten Einfluss auf das Leben von Menschen. Du unterstützt sie dabei, in Deutschland anzukommen, Sicherheit zu finden und ein neues Kapitel aufzuschlagen. Das ist keine trockene Büroarbeit – es ist Arbeit mit echter Bedeutung und spürbarer Wirkung.
  • Feel-Good-Angebote im Haus
    Unsere Feel-Good-Managerin sorgt regelmäßig für kleine Auszeiten – von Nacken- und Schultermassagen über kurze Entspannungs- und Beauty-Sessions bis hin zu Momenten zum Durchatmen.
  • Regelmäßige Team-Events
    Wir feiern gern. Sommerfest am See, gemütliche Weihnachtsfeier, Halloween-Sause, gemeinsame Lunches oder Afterwork-Dinner mit der Abteilung. Unsere Events sorgen dafür, dass wir als Team zusammenwachsen und den Arbeitsalltag auch mal beiseiteschieben können. Aber keine Sorge: Erscheinen ist keine Pflicht und eher Gehen auch kein Problem.
  • Fitnessraum im Haus
    Unser eigener Fitnessraum steht dir direkt im Haus zur Verfügung – kostenlos, gut ausgestattet und jederzeit zugänglich.

Mögliche Aufgabenbereiche

Bei uns erwartet dich ein Mix aus Design- und Implementationsarbeit. Je nach deinen Stärken und Interessen übernimmst du Aufgaben, die dich als festes Standbein des Design-Teams etablieren oder das Entwickler-Team frontend-seitig unterstützen. Wir suchen nach Kollegen, die im besten Fall mehrjährige Erfahrung mitbringen und bereit sind, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

  • Landingpages entwickeln
    Du baust klare und überzeugende Landingpages – etwa zu Einbürgerung, Aufenthaltstiteln oder neuen Tools – und schaffst Strukturen, die sowohl Nutzer abholen als auch gute Conversions bringen.
  • Visuelle Konzepte entwickeln
    Du entwirfst moderne und gut strukturierte Layouts für Landingpages, Websites und interne Projekte und Tools. In Figma baust du komplette Design-Konzepte und setzt diese ggf. auch um.
  • Infobeiträge entwickeln
    Du gestaltest Blog- und Newsbeiträge und hilfst dabei, Inhalte verständlich aufzubereiten, einzupflegen und live zu schalten.
  • Mobile Optimierung
    Du passt Designs gezielt für mobile Geräte an und bist dir bewusst, dass unsere Website zum größten Teil auf dem Handy genutzt wird.
  • Seiten mit WordPress + Elementor aufbauen
    Du setzt deine Figma-Designs in WordPress um – mit Elementor Pro, Custom HTML/SCSS und Liebe zum Detail. Hier und da wirst du auch mit anderen Tools in Kontakt kommen: Bricks, Hubspot oder bspw. E-Mail-Designer-Tools.
  • Modulare Templates entwickeln
    Du erstellst wiederverwendbare Elementor-Templates, globale Styles und komponentenbasierte Layout-Bausteine, damit unsere Projekte nicht nur schön, sondern auch effizient und konsistent bleiben.
  • Laufende Pflege
    Du machst HTML/CSS-Anpassungen, pflegst Menüs, Custom Post Types und globale Styles und kümmerst dich um Performance-Themen wie Bildoptimierung, Lazy Load oder Caching.
  • Zusammenarbeit mit SEO, Content & Performance
    Du arbeitest eng mit anderen Teams zusammen, um Conversion zu verbessern und Elemente suchmaschinenfreundlich aufzubereiten.
  • Bildbearbeitung & Auswahl
    Du wählst passende Bilder oder erstellt diese selbst. Denk an: Beitragsbilder für Blog- oder Newsbeiträge.
  • A/B-Testing
    Du entwickelst Designvarianten für Tests und stimmst dich mit dem Team ab, um herauszufinden, was bei unseren Nutzer:innen wirklich funktioniert.

Dein Profil

Uns ist egal, welche Zertifikate du hast oder wo du studiert hast. Was uns interessiert: Was kannst du wirklich? Wer jahrelang Hands-on-Erfahrungen in der Praxis gesammelt, Seiten gebaut, Layouts optimiert und Designs für echte Nutzer:innen umgesetzt hat, bringt mehr mit als jeder Kursabschluss. Wir suchen nach Kollegen die im besten Fall mehrjährige Erfahrung mitbringen und bereit sind, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

  • WordPress & Elementor
    Du hast mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung mit WordPress und Elementor und kennst die typischen Stolpersteine aus eigener Arbeit.
  • Grundlagen im Webdesign-Stack
    HTML5 und CSS3 beherrschst du gut, gern auch mit SASS/LESS.
  • Gespür für Design
    Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Ästhetik, Typografie, Abstände und Struktur und gleichzeitig ein Verständnis dafür, wie Nutzer:innen online denken und navigieren.
  • Sicher im Umgang mit Design-Tools
    Du nutzt Figma (oder vergleichbare Tools wie Sketch oder Adobe XD), um Wireframes, Prototypen und finalen UI-Designs umzusetzen. Du arbeitest visuell klar, strukturiert und gerne kollaborativ.
  • Detailverliebt mit Blick fürs Ganze
    Du achtest auf jedes Pixel, auf Abstände und Micro-Details, behältst aber trotzdem die größere User Journey und das strategische Ziel der Seite im Blick.
  • Routine im Responsive Design
    Desktop, Tablet, Mobile – für dich sind das keine Extras, sondern ein selbstverständlicher Teil jedes Projekts. Du kannst Layouts für verschiedene Breakpoints sauber aufeinander abstimmen.
  • Erfahrung im Webdesign
    Du hast bereits mit WordPress, Elementor, Figma oder HTML/CSS gearbeitet und fühlst dich in dieser Welt wohl.
  • Keine formellen Voraussetzungen
    Du musst kein Studium oder 30 Weiterbildungen haben. Wir wollen Talente und fähige neue Kollegen finden. Selbst wenn du nicht alle Punkte hier erfüllst - wir sind auf der Suche nach erfahrenen und verantwortungsbewussten Kollegen, idealerweise bist du schon viele Jahre in dem Bereich aktiv und konntest viele Learnings mitnehmen. Denn genau daran sind wir interessiert: saubere, langfristig robuste Problemlösungen. Und die hat man meist erst, nachdem man es einige Zeit auf die harte Tour lernen musste.
  • Einfache Kommunikation
    Du bist kommunikativ und offen. Eigentlich wollen wir hier keine generischen Sachen schreiben, aber dieser Punkt ist wichtig. Gute Zusammenarbeit schlägt oft reines Know-how. Ein Kollege, mit dem die Zusammenarbeit angenehm und reibungslos ist, kann im Alltag wertvoller sein als jemand mit mehr Know-how, mit dem die Kommunikation aber eher schleppend ist.
  • Deutsch oder Englisch
    Du sprichst Deutsch oder Englisch oder am besten beides (ca. B2-Level). Keine Angst, wir wollen keinen Sprachnachweis sehen.

title: Signal Processing & Data Engineer
description:
Who We Are

Limatica measures what batteries whisper. We turn the tiny voltage noise of battery cells into a quality verdict, far faster than conventional tests, and help cell manufacturers cut scrap.

We are a team of twelve in Chemnitz and Munich, spanning data, ML, HPC, hardware and industrialization. Early adopters across Europe and Asia already use our technology. In 2026 we move from pilots to production lines, and our data grows faster than our team.

Our measurement stations produce several hundred GB of high-resolution voltage data per hour. You own the step from raw signal to reliable answer.

  • Build for streaming: Design feature computations that work in streaming mode, at a throughput of up to 10,000 measurements per hour.

  • Physical intuition: You can explain why a feature makes sense, and you prefer a simple, well-understood method over a model nobody can explain.
  • Data at scale: You think in throughput: data formats, intermediate results, distributed and cached processing.
  • Clean engineering: Python, Git, tests and CI/CD as a matter of course. No Rust expertise needed, but the will to learn it.
  • Customer confidence: Fluent German and English, written and spoken. You explain results clearly to engineers and managers alike.

Why Limatica

  • Real ownership: Your own part of the pipeline and your first customer project within months. As we grow, this role can grow into technical lead.
  • Learn what few get to learn: Electrochemistry, Rust in production and data engineering at scale, with real cells and international manufacturers.
  • Share the upside: Salary package including virtual stock options.
  • Invest in yourself: Additional holiday for personal learning
  • Flexibility & wellbeing: Flexible hours, hybrid work, further benefits via Guud Card and free beverages

What it's like here: You get a lot of trust and a lot of room to shape things. We look for people who stay with a problem until it's solved and who enjoy the moments when a customer launch needs the whole team. Those are the moments where people here grow fastest. This role is intentionally a towards-senior position. You will take on increasing responsibility for pipeline modules and customer projects. Those who help shape the architecture and lead projects independently grow into a senior role with us.

description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

Robot Software builds the on-vehicle software platform that Wayve’s AI Driver runs on. Within it, the Experiment Platform team owns the systems that let our researchers develop driving models on the road: deploying models to vehicles, running experiments, and collecting the data that trains the next model.

The team builds a portable development platform that connects to partner vehicles and brings Wayve’s model development capabilities to them, including data collection, experiment control, telemetry and over-the-air updates. It is used across our own fleet and on pre-production vehicles with OEM partners in Europe and Japan, and is central to how Wayve adapts its AI Driver to new vehicles. You will lead a team of engineers based in London, working alongside the Runtime Platform, OS, Sensors and Platform Integration teams in Robot Software.

🧠 Your day-to-day

You will lead the team’s people, plans and partnerships. Most of your time goes to your engineers: regular 1:1s, clear expectations, feedback, performance and promotion cycles, and helping technical leads take on more scope. You will work with your tech leads on technical decisions, own the outcomes, and make sure the team responds well when issues come up in the field. You will maintain the team’s mission, charter and twelve-month roadmap, turn them into quarterly and six-week plans, and keep delivery on track.

You will be the team’s main point of contact for partner engineering teams, programme managers, operations and OEM customers, and you will make it clear what the team owns.

You will stay technically capable and aware of the team’s work across the codebase. You will monitor the architecture, guide the team through technical blockers when needed, and engage with technical leaders in other teams at a technical level.

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

Growing the platform: Take the development platform from its first stable release to a product used across many vehicle types, with predictable releases and validation in CI and on HIL benches.

Experiment control and fleet orchestration: Own model and controller download, the robot state machine, and over-the-air deployment of software, configuration and calibration.

Self-serve experimentation: Make the platform self-serve, so research teams can run their own experiments on vehicles without waiting for platform changes.

Scaling data collection: Onboard and event-based logging, data quality, and data offload over

New vehicles and OEM integrations: Deploy the full platform on Wayve’s next-generation vehicles, and support new OEM integrations through configuration rather than new releases.

Building the operating model around the platform: Releases, support rota, on-call, metrics and observability.

Building the team: Own hiring and onboarding, and grow the team as adoption of the platform expands.

🙌 You should apply if:

You have managed software engineering teams, including hiring, coaching and performance management.

You have owned a platform or product that other teams or customers relied on, and shipped it to devices in the field.

You are technically capable, with hands-on experience in embedded Linux systems software (C++ or Python), and stay close enough to the code to review your team’s work, guide architecture and help resolve technical blockers.

You understand connected device fleets, such as vehicles, robots or IoT, including data logging and offload, over-the-air updates and observability.

You are comfortable leading delivery across many stakeholders, including external partners, and can engage with other technical leaders as a technical peer.

You care about operational reliability and release quality.

Experience with autonomous vehicles or robotics, automotive ECUs (for example NVIDIA Jetson or DRIVE, QNX), Yocto, IPC middleware such as ROS 2 or DDS, or containerised workloads on embedded systems is desirable.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. title: Founding lead Product Designer
description:
Raison is on a mission to provide humans with better skills so they can feel confident and have more opportunities in the AI era. We help companies make sure 100% their teams master AI, directly in the flow of work (Teams, Slack) so that AI knowledge spreads across the organization instead of pooling in a handful of champions.

We are passionate entrepreneurs believing that the ongoing AI revolution should be shared by all employees; and that the future of corporate interactions should not be restricted to private human-machine chats. Raison is capturing what champions create with AI, turning it into shared, governed skills, and propagating them so everyone feels capable and empowered; acting as a powerful lever to accelerate the AI transformation of corporates.

We recently raised €2m from a top French VC + BPI and a selection of high-profile business angels who believe AI mastery is the highest-leverage application of AI inside companies.

Tasks

User Research & Discovery

  • Own field research: contextual inquiry, user interviews, and observation of how teams actually work with AI and where it breaks.
  • Build and maintain a deep understanding of our core users — individual contributors, champions, managers, and corporate buyers — and the context they operate in.
  • Synthesize messy field data into sharp, actionable insight: jobs-to-be-done, adoption blockers, and the conditions under which a skill transfers between people.
  • Establish a continuous discovery habit so research is a foundational reflex, and champion the user's perspective in every product decision.

 

Product & Experience Design

  • What our experts do by hand today is the spec for what the product must automate tomorrow. Your job is to watch that closely enough to design it.
  • Design the surfaces: the client dashboard execs present to their board, the internal console our experts use to run a dozen live communities at once, and the conversations themselves.
  • Most of our product lives inside someone else's client. You are designing in Teams and Slack, not screens we control — no onboarding, no landing page, no second chance. A four-minute message to an accountant who has never opened Copilot is the hardest design problem we have.
  • Work mostly on enterprise, and partly on higher education, where we also have live deployments. Two audiences, two vocabularies, one product: part of your job is deciding what stays shared and what has to differ, so we build one coherent system rather than two half-products.
  • Work hand-in-hand with our AI product engineers so your field learnings ship as features, then get re-tested at the next pilot.
  • Own the design system: components, tokens, patterns, and the copy that goes with them.

Requirements

  • 4–8 years in product design, UX design, or a hybrid design-research role, ideally on complex, multi-user B2B products.
  • A strong portfolio that shows both craft and thinking: we want to see how you operated, not just what shipped.
  • A skilled researcher who can design a study, run it in the wild, and turn qualitative chaos into clear direction.
  • Experience designing inside environments you don't control - a messaging client, an extension, an embedded product - or a clear appetite for it.
  • Comfortable designing for AI-driven and adaptive experiences, where the interface has to handle uncertainty, personalization, and non-linear workflows.
  • Excellent visual and interaction design skills: typography, spacing, motion, and the small details that build trust.
  • Autonomous and opinionated, but you hold your opinions loosely when the evidence says otherwise.
  • Genuine curiosity about AI and how people actually learn at work.
  • Fluent in French and English, spoken and written. Spanish is a plus.
  • You want the ownership, equity, and career-defining challenge that only comes from being early.
  • Bonus: deeply passionate about something outside of work.

Benefits

  • A founding role with equity and direct influence on company strategy.

  • Competitive salary, benchmarked to the Paris startup ecosystem.

  • Flexibility: remote-friendly with regular in-person collaboration in Paris and an office in Montmartre with a beautiful Sacré-Coeur view.

  • A front-row seat to one of the most important shifts in how humans learn.

  • A small, sharp team that ships fast and trusts each other to figure things out.

  • If you care deeply about making powerful tools feel human and want to shape a product from the very beginning, this is your role. Apply now and help us build the future of learning.

  • Raison is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team.

title: Graduate Program Dirigeant [H/F]
description:
Graduate Program Dirigeant — Alfeor

Promotion mars 2027

Le poste que vous visez : dirigeant d’une PME industrielle.

Alfeor réunit des PME industrielles de la filière nucléaire et des filières souveraines (défense et aéronautique) : traitement de surface, usinage de précision, mécanosoudure, essais métallurgiques, éléments de fixation et instruments de mesure et de contrôle des fluides. Créé en 2023. Aujourd’hui 5 sites, 250 salariés, 40 M€ de chiffre d’affaires. Cible 2030 : 250 M€.

Il n’existe pas d’école pour diriger une PME industrielle. Nous en avons construit une, sur le terrain.

Le parcours — 18 à 24 mois, 4 phases

Premier site

1. Opérateur d’atelier, 1 mois. Usinage, fraisage, chaudronnerie. Vous apprenez le geste avant de parler du reste.

2. Chef d’équipe ou de secteur production, 4 à 5 mois. Une équipe de 3 à 10 personnes, la performance de cette équipe est votre responsabilité.

3. Chargé d’affaires, 4 à 6 mois. Vous suivez une commande de la réception matière à la livraison client. Délais, marge, exigences de la filière nucléaire.

Changement de site, au bout d’environ 12 mois

Vous avez vu un atelier, un collectif, une affaire de bout en bout. Votre second site est choisi avec vous, en fonction de vos appétences et des besoins du groupe.

4. Responsable de la transformation, 9 à 12 mois, au CODIR. Vous êtes le relais du directeur général : chantiers d’amélioration continue, plans capex, stratégie achats, développement commercial. Vous portez un à deux projets en autonomie complète.

Entre les phases, des semaines de formation : fondamentaux de la filière nucléaire, excellence opérationnelle, pilotage financier, management et RH. Revue de performance hebdomadaire avec votre DG, puis trimestrielle avec le groupe.

À la sortie

Un poste de direction dans une de nos filiales : production, achats, commerce, RH, pôle nucléaire, avec l’objectif d’évoluer vers la direction générale à terme.

Ce poste n’est pas garanti. Le programme est sélectif et évalué à chaque rotation. Nous prenons l’engagement de vous former et de vous exposer ; vous prenez celui de faire vos preuves.

Une première promotion

Alfeor est un groupe industriel de dirigeants et d’équipes qui partagent une conviction : l’industrie de demain ne se décrète pas, elle se construit maintenant, sur le terrain, atelier par atelier.

C’est la première promotion de ce programme. Nous l’avons conçu autour de deux principes : le terrain d’abord, et des responsabilités réelles dès les premiers mois. Une équipe à diriger, une commande à tenir, des chantiers dont vous répondez.

Votre profil

– Bac+5, Grande école d'ingénieur ou de commerce (Arts et Métiers, Centrale, HEC, ESSEC, ESCP), 0 à 2 ans d'expérience

– Deux parcours mènent au même poste : un profil technique qui apprend le pilotage, un profil gestion qui apprend l'atelier. Nous recrutons les deux.

– Vous voulez faire plutôt qu'analyser. Vous acceptez de commencer là où l'IA ne prend pas encore sa place : l'atelier.

– Vous êtes mobile en France. Vos deux sites d'affectation dépendront aussi des acquisitions d'Alfeor en 2027. Nos sites sont souvent éloignés des grandes villes : vous y passerez plusieurs mois loin de votre réseau habituel.

– Vous visez un poste de direction en PME industrielle, sans avoir encore l'expérience du terrain qui le permet..

title: Responsable Accompagnement Clients - Transition énergétique des bâtiments
description:
Chez Lowit, nous avons une ambition : accélérer et massifier la transition énergétique des bâtiments tertiaires.

Face à la hausse des coûts de l'énergie, aux enjeux climatiques et aux évolutions réglementaires, les gestionnaires de patrimoine ont besoin d'outils fiables, mais aussi d'un accompagnement de qualité pour passer à l'action.

C'est pourquoi nous avons développé une plateforme SaaS qui permet de créer le jumeau numérique des bâtiments, de piloter les consommations énergétiques et de construire des trajectoires d'investissement réalistes, chiffrées et adaptées aux enjeux de chaque organisation.

Aujourd'hui, nous accompagnons plusieurs centaines de collectivités et d'entreprises partout en France dans leurs projets de transition énergétique.

PME lyonnaise en forte croissance, nous recherchons des collaborateurs qui souhaitent avoir un impact concret, prendre des responsabilités et contribuer à une aventure collective porteuse de sens.

Vos missions

Chez Lowit, nous accompagnons chaque jour des collectivités, des entreprises et des établissements publics dans la gestion et la transition énergétique de leur patrimoine immobilier.

Notre plateforme leur permet de mieux connaître leurs bâtiments, de piloter leurs consommations, d'anticiper les obligations réglementaires et de construire des trajectoires d'investissement cohérentes.

Parce qu'une plateforme ne crée de valeur que lorsqu'elle est pleinement appropriée par ses utilisateurs, nous accordons une place essentielle à l'accompagnement de nos clients. C'est précisément la mission de notre équipe Accompagnement Clients.

Pour accompagner notre croissance, nous recherchons aujourd'hui un(e) Responsable Accompagnement Clients.

Vous deviendrez l'interlocuteur privilégié d'un portefeuille de collectivités, d'entreprises et d'établissements publics. Votre mission sera de construire une relation de confiance durable avec vos clients, de comprendre leurs enjeux et de les accompagner dans l'utilisation de nos solutions afin qu'ils en tirent le meilleur parti.

Concrètement, vous serez amené à :

  • Accompagner vos clients tout au long de leur parcours chez Lowit au travers d'échanges réguliers (téléphone, visioconférences, réunions et e-mails).
  • Développer une compréhension approfondie de leurs enjeux afin de leur apporter un accompagnement pertinent et personnalisé.
  • Les conseiller sur les sujets liés à la transition énergétique des bâtiments : réglementation, stratégie patrimoniale, performance énergétique, dispositifs d'aides, mécanismes de financement... en vous appuyant sur les experts internes lorsque cela est nécessaire.
  • Réaliser ponctuellement des missions de conseil directement chez les clients afin de fiabiliser leur patrimoine, mettre à jour leurs données, construire des scénarios personnalisés et restituer des plans d'action auprès de leurs équipes de direction ou de leurs élus.
  • Identifier les besoins émergents, détecter les opportunités d'accompagnement complémentaires et remonter les signaux business aux équipes concernées.
  • Animer des webinaires, partager les bonnes pratiques et contribuer au développement de la communauté d'utilisateurs Lowit.
  • Faire remonter les retours clients et les besoins fonctionnels afin de contribuer à l'amélioration continue de notre plateforme et de nos services.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Projets, Produit, Commerce et nos experts techniques afin de garantir un accompagnement de grande qualité.

Ce poste est avant tout un métier de relation client, de conseil et d'accompagnement. Vous ne serez pas seul face aux problématiques techniques : vous pourrez vous appuyer sur les expertises présentes chez Lowit. En revanche, votre capacité à écouter, comprendre les enjeux de vos clients et construire avec eux une relation de confiance sera déterminante dans leur réussite… et dans la nôtre.

Vos compétences

Nous recherchons avant tout une personne qui aime construire des relations de confiance dans la durée.

Ingénieur(e) de formation ou diplômé(e) d'un Bac+5 dans les domaines de l'énergie, du bâtiment, de la thermique ou de l'immobilier, vous souhaitez mettre votre expertise au service de l'accompagnement client.

Vous aimez comprendre les problématiques de vos interlocuteurs, les accompagner dans leurs projets et leur apporter des conseils concrets. Curieux(se), à l'écoute et pédagogue, vous appréciez autant les échanges humains que les sujets techniques.

Une première expérience dans le conseil, la gestion de projet, le Customer Success ou l'accompagnement client constitue un véritable atout.

Au-delà de votre parcours, nous serons particulièrement attentifs à votre capacité à :

  • Créer une relation de confiance avec vos clients et communiquer avec aisance, aussi bien à l'oral qu'à l'écrit.
  • Comprendre les enjeux techniques, réglementaires et patrimoniaux liés à la transition énergétique des bâtiments, ou avoir l'envie de développer rapidement cette expertise.
  • Faire preuve de curiosité et d'une réelle envie d'apprendre dans un secteur en constante évolution.
  • Organiser votre activité et prioriser efficacement les sollicitations d'un portefeuille clients.
  • Travailler en équipe et mobiliser les bonnes expertises internes lorsque la situation l'exige.
  • Être à l'aise avec les outils numériques et les environnements SaaS.

Une connaissance des secteurs de l'énergie, du bâtiment, de l'immobilier ou des collectivités territoriales sera appréciée.

Enfin, si vous aimez décrocher votre téléphone pour échanger avec vos clients, créer une relation durable et les accompagner bien au-delà de la simple utilisation d'un logiciel, vous vous sentirez probablement à votre place chez Lowit.

title: Transmission Belt Reinforcement Business Development Director
description:
Aritec New Materials Group AG is a Swiss-based company specialized in fiber composite solutions for demanding industrial applications.

We are experts in synthetic fibers, treatments & fiber sizing formulations and polymer matrices. We take pride in engineering and optimizing superior solutions to the most complex industrial challenges.

At Aritec, we drive tomorrow’s industrial frontiers by innovating cost-effective and robust solutions.

Tasks

We are seeking an accomplished Transmission Belt Reinforcement Business Development Director to lead commercial growth for advanced reinforcement solutions used in industrial transmission belts (timing, power transmission, etc..). This is a senior, customer-facing role for a commercially driven technical professional who understands belt construction, reinforcement architecture, manufacturing processes, end-user performance requirements, and the evolving challenges facing belt manufacturers and end-users worldwide.

The successful candidate will bring a strong track record and industry network from a leading belt manufacturer or closely related high-performance belting business. They will use their industry credibility, technical depth, and commercial judgment to build strategic customer relationships, identify new growth opportunities, and position our reinforcement portfolio as a performance-enabling solution for next-generation belt designs.

As Business Development Director, you will work at the intersection of materials engineering, belt design, manufacturing, and commercial strategy. You will engage with global belt manufacturers, technical centers, R&D teams, purchasing organizations, and senior business leaders to advance qualification projects and convert them into durable commercial programs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and execute the global sales strategy for Aritec reinforcement portfolio in Transmission belts.
  • Build and manage senior-level relationships with major transmission-belt manufacturers, including engineering, R&D, purchasing, operations, quality, and executive leadership.
  • Manage and Expand existing customers account portfolio by identifying and prioritizing opportunities where Aritec Synthetic reinforcement technology can improve belt strength, fatigue performance, dimensional stability, heat resistance, flex life, adhesion, noise behavior, efficiency, or durability.
  • Translate customer performance requirements into clear technical and commercial value propositions.
  • Lead customer-development programs from initial technical discussion through sampling, testing, qualification, industrialization, and serial-production launch.
  • Coordinate closely with internal R&D, application engineering, operations, quality, product management, and supply-chain teams to ensure customer requirements are understood and delivered.
  • Provide informed market intelligence on belt technologies, competitive reinforcement materials, regional market dynamics, pricing trends, supply-chain risks, and emerging end-use requirements.
  • Support the development of account plans, commercial agreements, pricing strategies, forecasts, and long-term supply arrangements.
  • Represent the company at customer technical reviews, industry events, trade fairs, and relevant technical associations.
  • Establish disciplined sales reporting, opportunity qualification, forecasting, and business-review processes.
  • Mentor and develop regional sales or application-engineering colleagues as the business grows.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Polymer Science, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable technical discipline.
  • At least 10 years of relevant commercial, technical-sales, business-development, product-management, application-engineering, or R&D experience in transmission belts, reinforced elastomer products, industrial belting, tire cord, technical textiles, fibers, or closely related applications.
  • Experience gained at a recognized transmission-belt manufacturer is strongly preferred. Candidates from leading global manufacturers of automotive and industrial transmission belts will be particularly well suited.
  • Demonstrated understanding of transmission-belt construction, including reinforcement cords or fabrics, rubber compounds, bonding systems, cover materials, belt geometry, and manufacturing processes.
  • Practical familiarity with belt types such as timing belts, synchronous belts, V-belts, multi-rib belts, variable-speed belts, flat belts, and industrial power-transmission belts.
  • Strong understanding of key reinforcement performance factors, including tensile properties, modulus, elongation, creep, fatigue, flex resistance, adhesion, thermal stability, moisture behavior, dimensional stability, and processability.
  • Established relationships within the global transmission-belt industry are highly desirable.
  • Proven ability to manage technically complex sales cycles involving testing, qualification, supply approval, and multi-site customer coordination.
  • Experience negotiating pricing, supply agreements, development agreements, technical specifications, and long-term customer programs.
  • Strong commercial acumen, including margin management, value-based selling, forecasting, market analysis, and strategic account planning.
  • Professional fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage.
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally.

Preferred Technical Background

The ideal candidate will have direct familiarity with one or more of the following:

  • Aramid, polyester, glass, carbon, hybrid, or other high-performance reinforcement materials.
  • Cord construction, twisting, cabling, dipping, coating, or adhesion-promotion systems.
  • Rubber-to-cord and polymer-to-cord adhesion technologies.
  • Belt fatigue testing, tensile testing, dynamic testing, flex testing, endurance testing, and field-performance validation.
  • Belt-manufacturing processes, including calendering, building, molding, curing, grinding, machining, and quality-control systems.
  • Customer qualification practices and industrial quality-assurance processes.

Personal Attributes

  • Credible technical expert who can communicate effectively with both R&D engineers and senior commercial leaders.
  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and comfortable building business in technically demanding markets.
  • Structured and disciplined in account management, forecasting, and opportunity prioritization.
  • Skilled listener who can uncover the underlying technical and commercial drivers behind customer needs.
  • Collaborative leader who works effectively across sales, operations, R&D, quality, and supply chain.
  • Resilient and patient in managing long qualification cycles while maintaining urgency and commercial focus.
  • High integrity, sound judgment, and a strong commitment to confidentiality and ethical business conduct.

Benefits

This role offers the opportunity to shape the commercial direction of a high-value reinforcement business serving a critical industrial market. You will have the autonomy to influence strategy, engage directly with leading belt manufacturers, and help develop materials that enable more efficient, durable, lightweight, and sustainable power-transmission systems.

If you combine deep transmission-belt expertise with strategic sales leadership and a passion for solving difficult customer challenges, we invite you to apply.

title: Events & Community Manager
description:
About us:

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

About the role:

Restaurant owners trust other restaurant owners. They listen to the chef down the street, their wine supplier and their accountant long before they listen to an ad. That's why our events work. When we launched in Berlin, we hosted a four-hands dinner with two local merchants and a well-known food creator. We believe that’s what builds credibility, trust, and ultimately a warm prospect list.

We’re hiring an Events & Community Manager to turn that into a program that runs in several markets at the same time. You’ll plan and run our partner and owned events, and find new ways to grow Tebi through the hospitality community in each city, neighbourhood and market. You’ll work closely with our local sales teams so every event and partnership turns into real conversations.

This is a hands-on role. One week you'll be hosting a merchant dinner in Milan, the next you'll be setting up a distributor breakfast in Amsterdam. You'll report to the Head of Marketing and work closely with our Marketing team to extend these programs to our channel ecosystem, plus align closely with the General Managers and Account Managers in each market.

What you'll be doing:

  • Run events across markets: Plan and deliver partner and owned events in 2–3 markets at a time, from intimate merchant dinners and industry breakfasts to city launches. You own the calendar, budget, venues, suppliers, guest lists and the plan for the night.

  • Build the playbook as you go: Turn each event into templates, checklists and supplier lists, so we can launch a city campaign in weeks, not months. Improve them after every event.

  • Build local partner networks: Find the people operators already trust: drinks distributors, wholesalers, food creators, hospitality associations, accountants and the advisers who help new venues open. Build partnerships that bring us introductions and referrals, not just logos.

  • Put our merchants front and center: Work with our best merchants as hosts and anchors, so prospects hear about Tebi from the people they respect.

  • Turn connections into pipeline: Agree with local Sales and Account Management who to involve, how to follow up and who owns what conversations. Track every event in HubSpot from invite to demo to signed merchant.

  • Grow Tebi through the community: Find new ways to reach operators through the people and places they already trust, in each city, neighborhood and across borders. Keep guests and partners engaged after events, so one introduction leads to the next.

  • Open new community channels: Test new ways to grow through our close-knit industry, such as an affiliate or referral program for partners, sharing useful insights from our merchants, and showing up in the forums and groups where operators talk shop.

  • Capture the stories: Work with our creative team and relevant freelancers to turn events and partner moments into social content, case studies and sales material.

How we'll measure success:

  • Events delivered each quarter across markets, on time and on budget

  • Demos, pipeline and new merchants from each event and partnership

  • Introductions, referrals and leads from partners, affiliates and community channels

  • Cost per demo compared with our other channels

What you’ll bring:

  • Have built something people show up for: an event series, a supper club, a community, a program. You can point to what it led to, not just how many people came

  • Feel at home in hospitality. You've worked in or around restaurants, bars or food and drink brands, and you're comfortable leading a room full of operators

  • Are high agency. You own your calendar, your relationships and your results, and you don't wait to be told what to do

  • Build your own playbook when there isn't one, and you enjoy doing the work as much as planning it

  • Know the difference between a real community and a guest list

  • See growth opportunities beyond events, and are curious enough to test them

  • Can run several markets at once without dropping details, and are happy to travel regularly

  • Track what you do: comfortable with a CRM (HubSpot a plus), UTMs and simple reporting

  • Speak fluent English. Dutch, German, Italian, Spanish or a Nordic language is a plus

Typically this means 3–5 years in events, community, field marketing or partnerships, but we care more about what you've built than how long you've been doing it.

This role isn't for you if:

  • You'd rather plan the program than run it

  • You need a fixed playbook and a clear org chart to get going

  • You're not willing to roll up your sleeves on the night

Benefits:

  • Start-up Equity

  • Competitive Salary

  • Lunch Provided in Office

  • Team building events

  • Unlimited time off

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

title: Signal Processing & Data Engineer
description:
Who We Are

Limatica measures what batteries whisper. We turn the tiny voltage noise of battery cells into a quality verdict, far faster than conventional tests, and help cell manufacturers cut scrap.

We are a team of twelve in Chemnitz and Munich, spanning data, ML, HPC, hardware and industrialization. Early adopters across Europe and Asia already use our technology. In 2026 we move from pilots to production lines, and our data grows faster than our team.

What You'll Do

Our measurement stations produce several hundred GB of high-resolution voltage data per hour. You own the step from raw signal to reliable answer.

  • Work with novel cell noise data: Derive features from raw time series that make physical sense that hold up in production
  • Build for streaming: Design feature computations that work in streaming mode, at a throughput of up to 10,000 measurements per hour.
  • Make throughput a design decision: Build modular, parameterizable nodes for our distributed processing pipeline and help bring them into our Rust-based production environment.
  • Ship modules, not scripts: Automate evaluations end to end, from raw data to reports for our engineering team and our customers.
  • Own customer projects technically: Assess requirements, communicate interim results and findings, and turn feedback into improvements.

What You Bring

  • Measurement experience: A degree in electrical engineering (or comparable) and 3+ years with real-world measurement data. Sampling, noise, filtering and artifacts you know from practice, not just lectures.
  • Physical intuition: You can explain why a feature makes sense, and you prefer a simple, well-understood method over a model nobody can explain.
  • Data at scale: You think in throughput: data formats, intermediate results, distributed and cached processing.
  • Clean engineering: Python, Git, tests and CI/CD as a matter of course. No Rust expertise needed, but the will to learn it.
  • Customer confidence: Fluent German and English, written and spoken. You explain results clearly to engineers and managers alike.

Why Limatica

  • Real ownership: Your own part of the pipeline and your first customer project within months. As we grow, this role can grow into technical lead.
  • Learn what few get to learn: Electrochemistry, Rust in production and data engineering at scale, with real cells and international manufacturers.
  • Share the upside: Salary package including virtual stock options.
  • Invest in yourself: Additional holiday for personal learning
  • Flexibility & wellbeing: Flexible hours, hybrid work, further benefits via Guud Card and free beverages

What it's like here: You get a lot of trust and a lot of room to shape things. We look for people who stay with a problem until it's solved and who enjoy the moments when a customer launch needs the whole team. Those are the moments where people here grow fastest. This role is intentionally a towards-senior position. You will take on increasing responsibility for pipeline modules and customer projects. Those who help shape the architecture and lead projects independently grow into a senior role with us.

Wir setzen auf ein beispielloses Engagement unserer Nutzer:innen, das durch eine menschliche 1:1-Interaktion mit einem Coach und eine digitale Lernreise angetrieben wird, die das persönliche Wachstum transparent, messbar und angenehm macht.🚀

Zusammen mit unserem CEO spielst du eine wichtige Rolle beim Wachstum von Sharpist und bist vor allem dafür verantwortlich, durch strategische Partnerschaften mit unseren Kunden Umsatz zu generieren. Du entwickelst verschiedene Strategien für neue Chancen, betreust eigenständig den gesamten Sales-Prozess und arbeitest mit den wichtigsten Führungskräften der spannendsten Unternehmen in ihrem Bereich zusammen. Wir arbeiten bereits mit einigen der coolsten Marken in der DACH-Region und darüber hinaus – darunter Unternehmen wie IKEA, LVMH oder GetYourGuide – und mit deiner Hilfe wollen wir unser Portfolio noch weiter ausbauen!

  • Neues Business abschließen

  • Erreiche (und übertreffe) deine Ziele



Wir glauben, du bist erfolgreich, wenn du so ein Typ Mensch bist:

  • Hunter-Mentalität: Du blühst in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld richtig auf.

  • Unermüdlicher Macher: „Ausrede“ gibt’s bei dir nicht. Du hast bewiesen, dass du Dinge erledigst. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für jede Idee, setzt dir Ziele, holst andere ins Boot und ziehst alles bis ins Detail durch – egal was es braucht, um das Ziel zu erreichen.

  • Kundenversteher: Du fühlst dich in einer Kultur wohl, in der Kundenerfolg immer an erster Stelle steht, und gibst alles, um das Erlebnis und Leben unserer Kunden zu verbessern.

  • Datenbasierter Entscheider: Du triffst Entscheidungen nicht nur aus dem Bauch heraus. Du sammelst Daten, analysierst sie und entscheidest mit klaren Argumenten.

  • Ausgewogener Risikogeher: Du suchst aktiv nach Chancen, deine Komfortzone zu verlassen, und gehst kalkulierte Risiken ein, um richtig was zu bewegen.

  • Inspirierende Führungskraft: Egal auf welchem Level – du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und hilfst deinem Team, Ziele zu erreichen und zu übertreffen. Dabei sorgst du für eine offene und wertschätzende Atmosphäre, in der sich alle sicher fühlen.

  • Lebenslanger Lerner: Du weißt, dass man immer besser werden kann. Du nimmst konstruktives Feedback gerne an und gibst es auch weiter. Du willst morgen besser sein als heute und lernst aus Fehlern.

  • Kreativer Problemlöser: Du findest immer einen Weg, mit Kreativität neue Ideen und Lösungen zu entwickeln. Für dich gibt’s keine Probleme ohne Lösung – du zauberst, wo andere aufgeben.

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Vertrieb (mit eigenem Umsatz-Ziel) in einem wettbewerbsintensiven Markt, idealerweise im Bereich SaaS und mit Fokus auf Neukundengeschäft.

  • Du möchtest in Berlin arbeiten (wir sind hybrid unterwegs).

  • Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch fließend.

Was uns zusätzlich freut:

  • Erfahrung im Verkauf an L&D-Abteilungen, HR, Learning oder ähnliche Bereiche.

  • Vorherige Trainings in Sales-Methoden, z.B. MEDDIC, Force Management, SPIN, Challenger Sales etc.


Was wir anbieten: 

  • Wettbewerbsfähige Verkaufsprovision: Lass Dich für Deine harte Arbeit belohnen – mit einem Provisionsmodell, das Deinen Erfolg honoriert.

  • Unbegrenzte Coaching-Sessions: Greife jederzeit auf zertifizierte Coaches zu, um Dein persönliches und berufliches Wachstum zu fördern.

  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Genieße die Flexibilität, sowohl remote als auch vor Ort zu arbeiten.

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV): Plane Deine Zukunft mit unserem attraktiven Altersvorsorgeprogramm.

  • Jährliches Trainingsbudget: Investiere in Deine Entwicklung mit einem dedizierten Budget für Kurse, Workshops und Zertifizierungen.

  • Kostenlose Getränke, Snacks und Obst: Bleibe den ganzen Tag über energiegeladen und versorgt mit kostenlosen Erfrischungen.

  • Vierteljährliche Magnetic Week: Verbinde Dich mit Deinen Kolleg:innen bei spannenden Events, die inspirieren und begeistern.

💙 Wir sind ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert, und ermutigen Menschen jeden ethnischen Hintergrunds, Geschlechts, jeder Fähigkeit und sexuellen Orientierung, sich zu bewerben. 🙂

Bewirb dich jetzt, wenn dich das anspricht und du Teil der Personalisierung des Lernens für Mitarbeiter:innen weltweit werden möchtest. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!
