description:
Consequential Work. Dedicated People.


About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

About the Role

We are hiring a Site Reliability Engineer to support Onebrief deployments across on-premises hardware, virtualized systems, and cloud environments.

This is a hands-on infrastructure role focused on Linux administration, hardware maintenance, and application reliability. You will manage Linux servers, NVIDIA DGX Spark or similar AI computing systems, rack-mounted equipment, and the applications running on them. You will also support workloads deployed on virtual machines, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure.

Your primary responsibility is keeping these environments operational and maintaining a 99.5% application availability target. You will troubleshoot production issues, perform routine maintenance, and work with engineering teams to improve system reliability.

You will work primarily on-site with military customers in Wiesbaden, Germany, alongside Onebrief Outcome Engineers, Mission Success, GRC, and Infrastructure teams. Some environments have limited connectivity or operate on air-gapped networks, requiring practical troubleshooting skills and careful planning for maintenance and deployments.

Security Clearance, Location, and Onsite Requirements

This role requires regular on-site work at customer locations in and around Wiesbaden, Germany. Relocation assistance is available.

An active Top Secret clearance is required, with the ability to obtain SCI eligibility. Active Security+ (or another DoD 8570.01-approved credential) is required, or the ability to obtain one within 30 days of hire.

About You

You have a strong background in Linux systems administration and experience supporting production applications. You are comfortable working directly with server hardware, troubleshooting operating system issues, and diagnosing application failures. You understand how infrastructure problems affect the software running on it and know how to narrow down the cause of an outage.

You take responsibility for the systems you maintain and communicate clearly when problems arise. You can work independently at a customer site while collaborating with remote engineering teams. You value good documentation, practical automation, and fixing recurring problems.

What You'll Do

  • Maintain Linux systems and hardware: Install, configure, patch, and troubleshoot Linux servers, NVIDIA DGX Spark or similar GPU systems, rack-mounted equipment, and virtual machines. Handle hardware diagnostics, firmware updates, and routine maintenance.

  • Operate production applications: Deploy, monitor, upgrade, and troubleshoot applications running on Linux, virtual machines, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure. Work with software engineers to resolve application issues and improve deployment processes.

  • Maintain application availability: Work toward a 99.5% uptime target across assigned environments. Monitor application and system health, respond to alerts, investigate performance issues, and address problems before they cause extended outages.

  • Respond to incidents: Diagnose hardware, operating system, network, and application failures. Restore service, coordinate escalations, and document root causes and corrective actions through After Action Reviews (AARs).

  • Improve operations through automation: Use scripting and configuration management tools to simplify deployments, patching, monitoring, and recovery. Support secure operations in cloud, on-premises, and air-gapped environments.

What We Look For

  • Active Top Secret clearance, with the ability to obtain SCI eligibility.

  • 5+ years of experience in Linux systems administration, SRE, infrastructure engineering, or a related role.

  • Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills, including networking, storage, system performance, and security configuration.

  • Hands-on experience maintaining physical servers and troubleshooting hardware failures.

  • Experience supporting production applications on Linux servers, virtual machines, or containers.

  • Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes, including application deployments and basic troubleshooting.

  • Understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, and firewalls.

  • Experience with monitoring, incident response, and root cause analysis.

  • Ability to automate routine administration tasks using Bash or Python.

Nice to have qualifications

  • Working knowledge of at least one cloud platform, preferably AWS or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).

  • Experience with NVIDIA DGX Spark, GPU servers, or similar AI computing hardware.

  • Experience with virtualization platforms such as VMware, Proxmox, or Nutanix.

  • Familiarity with infrastructure automation tools such as Terraform or Ansible.

  • Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, or similar monitoring tools.

  • Experience supporting systems in DoD, classified, or air-gapped environments.

  • Familiarity with DoD security requirements, including STIGs and RMF.

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, GitOps, or Kubernetes administration.

  • Relevant certifications such as RHCSA, RHCE, CKA, or AWS certifications.

description:
Wir suchen Senior Developer, die in unserem vollständig remoten Team an unseren Agenten arbeiten. Wenn du Komplexität magst und willst, dass deine Arbeit wirklich etwas bewegt, passt du zu uns.

Über uns
Hausverwalter.ai ist eine All-in-One-Plattform für Hausverwaltungen, mit Funktionen wie Inbox, CRM, Dokumenten, Telefonie, Video Calls, Team Chat und KI-Agenten. Unsere Mission ist es, alles zu automatisieren, was ein Hausverwalter tut.

Über die Rolle
Unsere Plattform ist von Tag eins an agentisch gedacht. Bevor wir überhaupt die UI geplant haben, haben wir geplant, wie Agenten mit der Software arbeiten. Denk dran – unser Ziel ist, die ganze Branche zu automatisieren, und das meinen wir ernst.
Heute gibt es für fast alles, was der Nutzer in der UI machen kann, ein Agenten-Tool, und der Co-Pilot (der tägliche Assistent des Nutzers) kann alles für ihn übernehmen, sogar den Dark Mode an- und ausschalten.
Aber der Co-Pilot ist erst der Anfang. Die eigentliche Herausforderung sind die autonomen Agenten. Dazu unten mehr.

Woran du arbeiten wirst

  • Inbox-Agents: Autonome Agenten, die anspringen, sobald in einem Ticket etwas Neues passiert. Kunden trainieren sie selbst ODER nehmen einfach eine der Vorlagen, die du für sie baust. Diese Agenten können heute schon komplette komplexe Abläufe allein übernehmen und sind einer der Hauptgründe, warum sich Kunden für unsere Software interessieren. Aber wann sollte ein Agent an einen Menschen abgeben, statt selbst zu Ende zu machen? Wie stellen wir sicher, dass er sich an den Prozess hält? Das sind deine Fragen.

  • Harness Engineering: Der Agent hat über 100 Tools. Aber er muss eine Anfrage so verstehen, wie ein Hausverwalter sie versteht, und nicht so, wie die Begriffe außerhalb der Branche klingen. Was gehört in den System Prompt, was in Skills?

  • Knowledge Base: Unsere Plattform hat eine eigene Knowledge Base, ähnlich wie Notion. Komplett selbst gebaut und gedacht als kollektives Gehirn des Unternehmens. Aber sollte die KI auch von selbst „lernen"? Und wenn ja, wann? Und wie machen wir die Suche in der Knowledge Base besser — über bessere Tools, System Prompts oder Skills?

  • Voice-Agents: Dieselben Agenten, nur am Telefon — auf LiveKit gebaut, die Anrufe genauso abwickeln wie unsere Text-Agenten Tickets.

  • LLM Infrastructure. Das richtige Modell für die jeweilige Aufgabe wählen, per Caching und Streaming die Latenz drücken, bei Provider-Ausfällen sauber neu versuchen, Context kompakt halten, die RAG-Suche optimieren, Usage über alle Provider tracken, Kosten senken und mit Evals prüfen, was wirklich besser ist.

Unser minimalistischer Tech Stack
Alles ist TypeScript. Vom Datenbankschema bis ins Frontend.
Backend: Convex (Datenbank & Serverless Functions)
Frontend: Next.js, React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui

Die Dr. Sasse Gruppe ist ein familiengeführtes, international tätiges Unternehmen und zählt zu den führenden Anbietern integrierter Facility Management Dienstleistungen. Rund 9.500 Mitarbeitende betreuen anspruchsvolle Kunden aus Industrie, Immobilienwirtschaft, Freizeitwirtschaft sowie Transport und Infrastruktur.

Zur Unterstützung unseres stark wachsenden Robotik-Bereichs suchen wir ab sofort einen Werkstudenten (m/w/d) Robotik-Projektmanagement & Implementierung.

Das erwartet Dich

Du unterstützt die Projektleitung Robotik bei der Planung, Implementierung und dem Betrieb innovativer Robotiklösungen bei namhaften Industriekunden. Dabei erhältst Du einen praxisnahen Einblick in die Einführung autonomer Systeme und arbeitest aktiv an realen Kundenprojekten mit.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Installation, Einrichtung und Kartierung von Reinigungsrobotern bei unseren Kunden, insbesondere im Umfeld von Infineon Campeon

  • Unterstützung bei der Inbetriebnahme neuer Robotiklösungen und Begleitung der Projekte vom Proof of Concept bis zum Regelbetrieb

  • Digitales Monitoring und Betreuung bestehender Robotersysteme

  • Analyse von Betriebsdaten sowie Ableitung und Umsetzung von Prozessoptimierungen

  • Unterstützung bei der Übergabe erfolgreicher Robotik-Projekte an das operative Tagesgeschäft

  • Kommunikation mit internen und externen Stakeholdern, Kunden und Technologiepartnern

  • Administrative Unterstützung beim Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung unseres Robotikbereichs

  • Unterstützung bei Projekteinsätzen außerhalb der klassischen Bürozeiten, insbesondere in den Abendstunden zwischen 17:00 und 22:00 Uhr

Dein Profil

  • Laufendes Studium, idealerweise im Bereich Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Informatik, Robotik oder vergleichbarer Studiengänge

  • Begeisterung für Robotik, Automatisierung und innovative Technologien

  • Hohe Eigeninitiative und Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen

  • Strukturierte, selbstständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

  • Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office

  • Führerschein Klasse B von Vorteil

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Deine Vorteile

  • Direkter Praxiseinstieg in eines der spannendsten Zukunftsfelder der Facility-Management-Branche

  • Mitarbeit an realen Robotik-Projekten mit namhaften Kunden und internationalen Technologiepartnern

  • Einblicke hinter die Kulissen großer Industrie- und Dienstleistungsunternehmen

  • Erfahrungen mit verschiedensten Robotiklösungen, von Reinigungsrobotik über Service-, Sicherheits- und Inspektionsrobotik bis hin zu humanoiden Systemen

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Projektleitung und eigenverantwortliche Übernahme von Aufgabenpaketen

  • Dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten passend zum Studium

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege, offene Unternehmenskultur und ein motiviertes Team

  • Perspektive auf eine langfristige Entwicklung innerhalb eines schnell wachsenden Innovationsbereichs

Warum diese Stelle besonders ist

Bei uns arbeitest Du nicht nur an theoretischen Konzepten. Du begleitest Robotiklösungen direkt beim Kunden, siehst die Auswirkungen Deiner Arbeit im täglichen Betrieb und sammelst Erfahrungen, die weit über klassische Werkstudententätigkeiten hinausgehen. Dabei erhältst Du früh Einblicke in die Zukunft der Service-, Sicherheits-, Inspektions- und Reinigungsrobotik.

Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft autonomer Dienstleistungen.

    • Data modelling and analytics engineering (dbt, dimensional modelling, semantic layers, self-service)

    • Experimentation and causal inference (A/B test design, quasi-experiments, statistical rigour)

    • Machine learning and applied data science (forecasting, prediction, segmentation, evaluation)

    • Product analytics and metric design (funnels, cohorts, adoption frameworks, North Star metrics)

This role covers the cell side of our protein characterisation work. You would keep the cell lines healthy and run the assays that show how a designed protein behaves on a living cell, week after week, to the same standard.

About us

AI for biology has a data problem. The data that matters most doesn't exist yet, so we're building the infrastructure to produce it, with quality and traceability built in from day one.

We're in stealth and heads-down on execution. We'll share more about what we're building once you've spoken with the team.

The role

You will run cell culture and the cell-based assays for our protein characterisation work. That means the mammalian lines the assays depend on, from thaw through routine passage to a banked and documented stock, and the weekly rhythm of seeding, treating, reading and reporting plates.

Most of it runs in 384-well plates with imaging-based or flow cytometry readouts. You will run those assays as designed, with the controls and replicates that make a curve defensible, and you will be the person who notices when a plate, a line or a reagent lot has started to drift.

Assay design and the shape of the cascade sit with the scientist who leads this work today, so you are not being asked to invent the panel. You are being asked to make it run the same way every week, to record what you did in a form the rest of the system can read, and to tighten the protocols as they settle, including moving them towards the plate formats our automation will take on.

Your first 90 days

FIRST 30 DAYS

◆ Take over routine culture and banking for the protein cell lines, working to the protocols we already run.

◆ Learn the panel end to end by running each assay alongside the scientist who owns it.

DAYS 30 TO 60

◆ Run at least one assay in the panel independently, including its controls and acceptance criteria.

◆ Revise one culture or assay protocol so that someone else could follow it without asking you.

DAYS 60 TO 90

◆ Hold the weekly assay schedule on your own and return results on the agreed turnaround.

◆ Bring one protocol to a tighter precision bar, or into a plate format ready for automation.

Who you are

You are a hands-on cell biologist who takes assay variability personally. You have run the same assay often enough to tell a real effect from a bad plate, and you would rather find the cause than repeat the run.

The week has a rhythm in this job: cells to feed, plates to seed, runs to finish, numbers to return. You are happy with that, you keep records someone else can pick up, and you say early when something looks wrong rather than at the end of the week.

We do not hire people into boxes. The team is small, and early hires here end up owning work beyond the job they joined for. Nobody arrives with every part of this role. If you are strong in most of it and quick to learn the rest, we want to hear from you.

MUST HAVE

◆ Strong hands-on mammalian cell culture: adherent and suspension lines, aseptic technique, and thawing, passaging and banking to a high and consistent standard.

◆ Experience running cell-based assays end to end, including relevant controls, replicates and dose-response curves behind a reported number.

◆ Comfort with plate-based work and the arithmetic that goes with it, such as dilution series, plate maps and normalisation.

◆ Careful, traceable record-keeping that someone else can follow without asking you.

◆ A PhD in cell biology, pharmacology, immunology or a related field, or an MSc and two to three years of relevant lab experience.

NICE TO HAVE

◆ Reporter cell line bioassays for binding or blockade.

◆ Receptor internalisation, lysosomal trafficking or cytotoxicity assays.

◆ High-content or fluorescence imaging, and the image analysis behind it.

◆ 384-well formats, liquid handlers or other plate-based automation.

◆ Flow cytometry, for example for surface receptor quantification.

Why this is unusual

Most cell-based assay roles sit inside a discovery project. You build an assay, you answer a question with it, and the assay goes quiet. This one is closer to running an instrument. The same assays run every week against a stream of new molecules, and the number that comes out is the product.

That changes what good looks like. Precision matters more than novelty, a protocol is only finished when someone else can run it and get your answer, and every passage, plate and reagent lot is captured as structured data, because a result is only as trustworthy as the cells behind it.

Some people find that energising; some find it outside their lane. Worth knowing in advance which one you are.

How we work

This is a lab-based role at our site in King's Cross, London. The cells are in the lab, so most of your week will be too, with room for writing and analysis away from the bench. The wider team is distributed and travels, so you will work with people who are not always in the building.

We work in the open. Decisions are written down, work happens centrally rather than scattered across tools, and the week opens with a session the whole company attends. There is a quarterly offsite. Each person owns their area and makes the call inside it, and we will expect that of you early rather than late.

UK benefits are 30 days of annual leave plus public holidays, a pension with a 10% employer contribution, and top-tier Bupa private health cover. More is added as the team grows.

The team you will join

You will join the protein characterisation team and report to its lead. Day to day you will work with the scientist who designs the assay cascade, with the protein production and molecular characterisation scientists upstream of you, with the functional genomics team who share the cell culture suite, and with the engineers building the software and automation the lab runs on.

We are a small, elite team, and this is the first seat given entirely to the cell-based side of the work.

Our process

Our process has four stages. A short screening call about the role and the practicalities. A behavioural interview about how you work, run from the same template for every candidate, before anything technical. A technical stage with the protein characterisation team, built around real work rather than a puzzle, including time with us in person at the lab. Then references, aimed at whatever we still want to understand.

If you are not sure whether you match every line above, apply anyway. We would rather read it and decide.

Vos missions

Mission principale

À 12 mois, construire et piloter un système de brand et de contenu qui :

- positionne Make Sense comme la référence des agences d'acquisition payante pour e-commerçants ambitieux,

- installe les dirigeants comme figures d'autorité sur le sujet,

- génère une demande inbound qualifiée et récurrente,

- crée de la préférence de marque et de la confiance avant même le premier call.

Reporte à Maxence CEO / Founder.

Collabore étroitement avec : Senior Strategist, Sales, équipe externe (montage, graphisme).

Make Sense est une agence pilotée par son fondateur : Maxence reste le décisionnaire final sur les grands choix de marque et de positionnement. Le rôle du Head of Brand est de nourrir sa réflexion, de la challenger avec des arguments solides, et de transformer ses convictions en système de marque et de contenu qui tourne. Autonomie totale attendu sur l'exécution et la mise en place.

Objectifs & livrables

À 15 jours :

- Connaître sur le bout des doigts les offres de l'agence.

- Être capable de positionner Make Sense au sein de son environnement concurrentiel et de son marché.

- Une routine de contenus mise en place et qui commence à se roder.

- Une première capacité d'analyse des impacts (vues, engagement, retours) pour ajuster la stratégie.

À 3 mois :

- Une proposition structurée, construite pour atteindre les objectifs à 12 mois, avec une feuille de route priorisée et des premiers arbitrages.

- Un calendrier éditorial structuré à 90 jours, mis à jour en rolling.

À 12 mois :

- Une machine de contenu corporate + founder-led qui tourne et une cadence tenue sur l'année avec la capacité à scaler la production sans brûler les founders.

- Des process de production et de distribution documentés, et une équipe média externe qui exécute sans friction avec un Minimum Viable Squad brand/media structuré (pool de freelances ou éventuels internes) dont les rôles sont clairs.

- Une croissance claire des indicateurs brand : vues, reach qualifié, abonnés sur les bons canaux, trafic direct / branded search.

- Une croissance du volume de leads inbound qualifiés issus des contenus.

- Des feedbacks marché tangibles sur les calls de vente (« je vous suis depuis X mois », « j'ai vu telle étude de cas »).

Activités clés au quotidien

- Traduire les objectifs business en roadmap brand & contenu.

- Réaliser et faire valider les créas et contenus (idées, scripts, tournages, montages, posts).

- Travailler main dans la main avec les founders pour extraire les idées, les frameworks, les prises de position.

- Prioriser les sujets et campagnes qui créent le plus de levier business et brand.

- Suivre les chiffres brand & inbound, ajuster les stratégies et formats.

- Garantir la cohérence : chaque output doit ressembler à « Make Sense », pas à n'importe quelle agence.

Vos compétences

Profil recherché

Expérience

- 5 à 8 ans d'expérience en brand / content / media, idéalement en agence (RP, social, growth, création) plutôt qu'en grand groupe pour être à l'aise dans une structure où tout va vite et où les rôles ne sont pas cloisonnés.

- Expérience significative en BtoB, ou en environnement mixte BtoB/BtoC avec une vraie culture business.

- Idéalement, une expérience de personal branding ou d'accompagnement de dirigeants sur leur prise de parole (LinkedIn, contenu, storytelling).

- A déjà construit ou contribué à un programme de contenu structuré (pas seulement géré des réseaux sociaux au fil de l'eau).

- A déjà structuré et managé une petite équipe interne ou de freelances

Mindset

- Stratégique et tactique : voit la brand comme un levier business.

- À l'aise avec des dirigeants très visibles, capable de les challenger sans jamais lisser ou aseptiser leur discours.

- Orienté résultats.

Compétences « hard »

- Excellente compréhension du branding B2B / agence / service premium.

- Solide culture contenu (YouTube, LinkedIn, podcasts, storytelling, formats qui convertissent en confiance).

- Capacité à bâtir et piloter un système de production de contenus.

- Bon niveau en copywriting.

- Capacité à briefer et diriger des créatifs (vidéo, design, etc.).

title: Robotics Software Engineer
description:
Build the next generation of autonomous construction robotics

At MESH, we develop autonomous robotic systems that automate end-to-end rebar construction. Bridging digital design and physical automation, our multidisciplinary team transforms advanced robotics research into robust, production-ready industrial systems deployed globally.

Tasks

Role description

We are looking for a Robotics Software Engineer to develop and productize software across the full robotics stack from perception and motion planning to control and system integration. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys working across subsystem boundaries. You will take ownership of the engineering work required to turn promising research and algorithms into robust and mature capabilities that can be deployed and maintained in real-world robotic systems.

What You Will Work On

You will contribute across the full robotics software stack, including:

  • Perception: 2D/3D sensing, point-cloud processing, object and feature detection, pose estimation, calibration.
  • Motion Planning: collision checking, trajectory generation and optimization, kinematics, robot/world modeling, and integration of planning algorithms.
  • Robot Control: integration with industrial robot controllers, HAL layers, trajectory execution, real-time or near-real-time control interfaces, state monitoring, and coordination of multi-robotic systems.
  • System Integration: connecting robotics SW, application logic, hardware, and external systems into reliable end-to-end robotic applications.
  • Robotics Infrastructure: reusable software components, interfaces, configuration, logging, diagnostics, testing, simulation, and deployment infrastructure.

Your Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, test, and maintain robotics software primarily in C++ and Python.
  • Develop and integrate components across the full robotics SW stack.
  • Take algorithms and prototypes and mature them into reliable software components.
  • Build automated tests, simulation-based tests, hardware-in-the-loop tests, and system-level validation where appropriate.
  • Work with industrial robots, sensors, cameras, external axes, and other automation hardware.
  • Develop clean interfaces between robotics algorithms, hardware drivers, application software, and higher-level systems.
  • Diagnose complex problems that span software, algorithms, networking, robot controllers, sensors, and hardware.
  • Improve observability through structured logging, diagnostics, error reporting, and system health monitoring.
  • Support deployment, commissioning, troubleshooting, and validation of robotic systems.

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • Masters degree or higher in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
  • Strong software engineering skills in C++, with working knowledge of Python.
  • Experience developing software for robotic or other complex hardware systems.
  • Good understanding of several areas of robotics, such as, motion and trajectory planning, robot control, vision, sensor and robot calibration.
  • Experience with robotics middleware such as ROS/ROS2 or similar
  • Comfortable working with Linux and modern software development workflows using Git, code reviews, build systems, debugging tools, and automated testing.
  • Ability to debug problems across multiple layers of a robotic system rather than treating individual components in isolation.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, modularity, interfaces, and maintainability.

Experience in one or more of the following would be an advantage:

  • 3D perception using point clouds, depth cameras, stereo systems.
  • Libraries such as Eigen, PCL, OpenCV, or similar.
  • Collision detection, robot/world modeling, trajectory optimization, or numerical optimization.
  • Real-time or high-performance robot communication and control.
  • Profiling, performance optimization, concurrency, and multithreaded C++.
  • Deploying and supporting robotic systems outside a controlled R&D environment.
  • CI/CD and automated testing for robotics software.
  • Experience working with industrial robotic arms such as ABB

We do not expect you to be an expert in every part of the robotics stack. We are looking for strong software engineering fundamentals, depth in one or more robotics areas, and the ability and interest to work across subsystem boundaries.

Eligibility

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Switzerland or be eligible to obtain the required Swiss work authorization without employer-sponsored visa support.

Why Join MESH?

At MESH, you will work on robotics problems where advanced R&D meets real-world industrial deployment. Our goal is not only to develop new robotics capabilities, but to turn them into systems that solve challenging problems in real world deployments.

  • You will have opportunities to work across the full robotics SW stack including system integration, and the software architecture connecting them rather than being restricted to a narrow subsystem.
  • You will work directly on the engineering challenges that take robotics from promising prototypes to robust, repeatable, and deployable solutions.
  • Solve challenging real-world robotics problems. Work with industrial robots, 3D vision systems, complex environments, and applications where conventional automation approaches reach their limits.
  • See your work operate on real hardware. Develop software that moves beyond simulation and demos and becomes part of robotic systems deployed in real production environments.
  • Have impact across the system. As part of a small, multidisciplinary engineering team, you will work closely across robotics, software, and hardware, with the opportunity to influence both technical decisions and how our robotics platform evolves.

MESH is automating rebar fabrication and construction processes using robotics and software. Our mission is to bring modern robotics and industrial-grade automation to one of the most fragmented and under-invested industries, enabling faster, safer, and more precise construction through systems that integrate seamlessly into existing workflows.

We design and deploy robotic solutions that operate in harsh, real-world production environments — not labs or demos. Our work spans mechanical systems, robotics, software, and industrial automation, with a strong focus on robustness, simplicity, and deployability.

We value close collaboration and hands-on engineering and primarily work on-site with our hardware.

About the Role

As Robotics Product Engineer, you'll own the products Mesh has already brought to market — starting with Actuate and Node systems — which are running today in customer deployments. Your job is to keep them working well, get better at what they do, and grow them into their full potential in the field.

You'll sit at the intersection of software, hardware, and the customer floor. You're comfortable writing production Python, but just as comfortable being on-site (virtually or in person) with a customer's robotic cell, watching how a workflow actually behaves, and figuring out why it's not performing the way it should.

This is a role for someone who wants their work to matter to customers running Mesh products right now, and who gets satisfaction from taking a live system from "working" to "working well."

Tasks

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the primary engineering point of contact for customer deployments of Mesh Actuate, Mesh Node, and future shipped products
  • Monitor deployed systems, diagnose issues, identify root causes across the software/hardware stack and provide remote support
  • Design and implement improvements to robotic workflows — cycle time, reliability, error handling, edge-case behavior — based on real deployment data and customer feedback
  • Write and ship production Python code that improves product performance and stability
  • Work directly with industrial robot integrations, understanding both the software control layer and the physical/mechanical constraints of the cell
  • Translate patterns you see across multiple deployments into product or platform improvements, not just one-off fixes
  • Build tooling, monitoring, and diagnostics that make it faster to understand what's happening in a live deployment
  • Partner with customer-facing teams to prioritize the improvements that matter most

Requirements

  • An engineering background (formal or equivalent experience) that gives you the fundamentals to reason about mechanical and electrical systems, not just code
  • Self-direction — this role often means identifying the improvement that matters most, not waiting to be assigned one
  • Willingness to travel to customer sites.
  • Working proficiency in English; German and/or French is a strong plus

Nice to Have

  • Experience with a specific industrial robot platform or manufacturer's SDK/control interface
  • Familiarity with fleet monitoring, telemetry, or observability tooling for distributed hardware
  • Experience being the engineering liaison for enterprise or industrial customers

At MESH, you are a foundational builder, not just an employee. We offer a high-growth environment where your work directly transforms one of the world's most essential industries. Beyond a competitive salary, we provide a comprehensive Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP), ensuring you share in the long-term success and ownership of the company. Join us in Switzerland to turn ambitious robotics R&D into the industrial standard of tomorrow.

  • Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

  • Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

  • Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

  • Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

This Role Is Not For

  • Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

Location

  • Product leadership - significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain - experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • Nice to have - engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

PFASuiki setzt den globalen Standard für die sichere und nachhaltige Zerstörung von PFAS. Mit elektrochemischer Oxidation (ECO) verwandeln wir belastete Wasserströme in ungefährliches Abwasser und helfen, eine der großen Umweltherausforderungen unserer Zeit zu lösen.

Wir suchen eine Entsorgungsfachkraft (m/w/d), die PFASuiki zum zertifizierten Entsorgungsfachbetrieb nach § 56 KrWG macht und diesen Status dauerhaft sichert. Als verantwortliche Person nach EfbV leitest und beaufsichtigst Du unsere Entsorgungstätigkeiten, erledigst alle Formalitäten mit Prüfstelle und Behörden und berätst unser Team in allen Abfall- und Entsorgungsfragen.

Aufgaben

  • Zertifizierung als Entsorgungsfachbetrieb verantworten: Umfang festlegen (Tätigkeiten, Standorte, Abfallarten), Prüfstelle auswählen, Überwachungsvertrag abschließen, Erst- und Jahresprüfungen begleiten

  • Betriebsorganisation nach EfbV aufbauen und pflegen: Organisationsplan, Arbeitsanweisungen, Betriebstagebuch, Versicherungs-, Zuverlässigkeits- und Fachkundenachweise

  • Alle behördlichen Formalitäten erledigen: Anzeigen und Erlaubnisse nach KrWG, Anträge, Fragenkataloge und Fristen

  • Geschäftsführung, Operations, Technik und Vertrieb in Abfall- und Entsorgungsfragen beraten, von der AVV-Einstufung bis zur Wahl der Entsorgungsroute

  • Abfallströme aus unseren mobilen Einsätzen, Labor und Technikum einstufen, Analytik veranlassen und Entsorgungspartner qualifizieren

  • Entsorgungsnachweise, Begleitscheine, eANV und Register führen und Kunden belastbare Nachweise über den Verbleib liefern

  • Genehmigungsbedarf neuer Geschäftsmodelle bewerten

  • Mitarbeitende unterweisen, interne Audits durchführen und Änderungen im Abfall- und PFAS-Recht verfolgen

Anforderungen

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium, Fachschul- oder Berufsausbildung oder Meister in Chemie, Verfahrens-, Umwelt- oder Entsorgungstechnik oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet

  • Mindestens drei Jahre praktische Erfahrung in der Abfallwirtschaft, idealerweise mit gefährlichen oder flüssigen Abfällen

  • Fachkunde nach § 9 EfbV mit anerkanntem Fachkundelehrgang

  • Zuverlässigkeit im Sinne von § 8 EfbV, nachgewiesen durch Führungszeugnis und Gewerbezentralregisterauszug

  • Sichere Kenntnisse in KrWG, EfbV, NachwV und AVV sowie Praxis mit dem eANV

  • Erfahrung mit Zertifizierungsaudits und souveräner Umgang mit Behörden und Sachverständigen

  • Strukturierte, gründliche Arbeitsweise mit sicherem Gespür für Fristen und Dokumentation

title: Product Manager
description:
Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented.


The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But International Fintechs and non-US banks are left with two unsatisfying options to access it: Either they build on legacy clearing banks that are slow and unreliable, or they interface with middleware providers that don’t move and hold the dollars directly, but themselves rely on underlying legacy banks. Augustus collapses this stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of operators, unicorn early employees, ex-founders and people who walked away from degrees because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and n8n.


We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

The Role

You own Banking Experience: the accounts at the center of customer's relationship with the bank, and the API and dashboards they use to manage them.

In this role you’re responsible for redefining what beautiful software in banking looks like. You'll define account structures that give customers powerful building blocks for their products, and craft intuitive interfaces grounded in a deep understanding of their use cases and workflows.

You report to Will, Head of Product, and work closely with Simon, our CTO. You're expected to operate with full autonomy on your team's roadmap, collaborating with design and engineering.

Your First Six Months

  • Months 1-2: Take over day-to-day ownership of the Banking Experience team - the roadmap, the ways of working, the hard decisions. Establish yourself with customers and how they use our accounts. You define and ship your first project.

  • Months 3-4: Execution mode. You're unblocking engineering daily, making hard prioritization calls, and shipping your roadmap to customers. You're proactively raising the bar across accounts, API, and dashboard by feeding what you learn from customers into the product.

  • Months 5-6: You're working with live customers on the products you've built. Deposits and number of account holders are scaling. You've moved from execution to platform mode - evolving the roadmap based on what our customers are building on top of Augustus.

Who Will Thrive At Augustus

We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. We’re building a modern correspondent bank, and we win by having a better team. The people who succeed here share the following traits:

  • American Dream: You’d rather shoot for gold than settle for mediocrity. You pick the harder goal and stay optimistic when the odds are against you. If it feels easy, we aimed too low.

  • Live Player: You don’t need permission. You rebuild what’s broken without being asked, challenge how things are done, and move before the perfect moment.

  • Ever to Excel: You can’t accept good enough and you take your work personally. When it matters, you do what it takes and keep raising the bar for yourself and your team.

  • Genuine: You play for the company, not your title or turf. Low ego, low drama, no politics. You say it straight, also upwards and always assume good intent.

This role is for you if:

  • You want to spend time with customers to intimately understand and then innovate on their workflows.

  • You’re a structured and relentless problem solver.

  • You combine first-principles thinking with deep domain knowledge to make complex processes simple.

  • You have taste and care deeply about the quality of what you build.

  • You leverage AI to push the boundaries of what a PM can do.

  • You’re excited about building a programmable bank and helping shape what that means.

Hard Requirements

  • Experience end-to-end owning and building banking, fintech, or developer platform products.

  • Technical enough to spar on architectural decisions with engineers - you're comfortable in API design discussions, not just UI reviews.

  • You have experience with control planes, dashboards, or console products at infrastructure, finance, or developer tools companies.

  • You have strong opinions on information architecture and how to organize complex products so they feel simple

  • Comfortable in customer-facing roles - you've pitched, demoed, and closed early adopters yourself.

  • Based in New York or Berlin, or willing to relocate.

Pay transparency

Compensation packages at Augustus include base salary, equity, and benefits. New hire offers are made based on a candidate's experience, expertise and geographic location. The annual US base salary range for this role is $180,000-$230,000 + equity.

What We Offer

  • Career Growth: You will be given more responsibility and pushed to grow faster than ever before.

  • Network: Your peers are brilliant, highly motivated people. These people will be foundational in your future opportunities.

  • Real Participation: Employees are shareholders. You will think and act like an owner.

  • Perks & Benefits: Relocation support, visa support, the latest Apple gear (MacBook + AirPods), lunch benefit, gym benefit, a beautiful office in the heart of the city, 4x on-/offsites per year, and an annual development budget.

Additional to the global benefits above, we offer localized benefits such as comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance and a 401(k) retirement plan for our US team.

Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role
 
Palantir Foundry is an end-to-end platform for data-driven decision-making. We're transforming the way organisations securely integrate their data, so they can then build reliable, critical applications atop that unified foundation. Our customers use Foundry to perform rich analyses that drive core operations within their organisations. They can also build sophisticated, full-fledged programs, such as common operating pictures, alert-triaging inboxes, and resource allocation planning tools driven by rich-ML models.
 
As a Full Stack Engineer focused on application development in Foundry, you will be responsible for crafting the tools used by thousands of users to build the sophisticated applications that power their businesses. You will be architecting and developing interfaces, state management and access patterns to support data-intensive workflows that are both powerful and approachable. You may spend one day interviewing users to better understand their needs and identifying product gaps to improve. The next day, you might find yourself considering that customer context along with signal gathered from other customers in different industries, brainstorming approaches to handling intricate UX needs with your teammates.
 
You’ll regularly be faced with sophisticated technical problems, requiring you to scope out the solution design and finding an incremental path to shipping the new features. As part of this, you will own APIs and schemas that power your frontend code, or work with other backend engineers in developing them together.
 
We're hiring engineers who are passionate about solving real-world problems and empowering both customer app builders and end-users to do their work optimally. Below are some examples of the types of product work you’d get to do in this role:
 
Frontline
 
Foundry Software Engineers may be offered the opportunity to Frontline, an exclusive program unlike any other. This unique, short-term assignment involves being embedded with customers, allowing you to work directly with users and gain firsthand insight into how our products are used and the challenges our customers face. Unlike traditional engineering roles, Frontline immerses you in complex, ambiguous problems, empowering you to deliver impactful solutions across some of the world’s most important industries and institutions.
 
Some of our most successful products were built on the factory floor, addressing real-world problems for the world's most important institutions. These products were developed by some of our most successful product engineers, who began their careers in roles aligned with Frontline responsibilities, gaining a deep understanding of both our technology and our customers.
 
Frontliners operate across a broad spectrum of responsibilities, much like a startup CTO. They work in small teams to own the end-to-end execution of high-stakes projects. This spectrum ranges from discussing architecture and building custom web apps to conducting workshops with users and strategizing with customer executives. No two days are alike, as each day is diverse and impactful. By witnessing how customers engage with Foundry and experiencing these pain points firsthand, you’ll gain unique insights that feed directly back into our development process, helping to refine and enhance our products. After your frontline rotation is complete, you will return to your regular role where you can apply the experience and understanding you’ve gained.

Core Responsibilities
  • Working as part of a community of engineers building shared frontend tooling to enable teams across Foundry
  • Designing and building for high-scale data intensive APIs (example)
  • Developing interactive workflow UIs
  • Building products which aim to make technical concepts accessible for non-technical users
  • Creating low-code/no-code WYSIWYG tools, which enable application builders within Foundry to build products for their users

    • Technologies We Use
  • Typescript, React, and GQL are central to our frontend development.
  • Blueprint as a re-usable front end component library.
  • A combination of open-source and internal technologies that suit the problems at hand.
  • Industry-standard build tooling, including Gradle, Webpack, GitHub, and CircleCI.

    • What We Value
  • Passion for improving user workflows and building user interfaces that enable users to tackle their problems, while still maintaining engineering quality.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in teams of technical and non-technical individuals and understand how technical decisions impact the people who will use what you're building.
  • Skill and comfort working in a constantly evolving environment with dynamic objectives and iteration with users.
  • Experience brainstorming and iterating with product designers.
  • Experience building high-quality software in a fast-paced CI/CD development environment.
  • Proven ability to learn continuously, work independently, and make decisions with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to learn new technology and concepts, even without in-depth experience.
  • Active UK Security clearance, or eligibility and willingness to obtain a UK Security clearance is beneficial, but not necessary.

    • What We Require
  • 2+ years of frontend software engineering experience.
  • Strong frontend coding skills used to write clean, effective code, regardless of framework, and existing proficiency in JavaScript and understanding of how web technologies work.
  • Familiarity with data structures, loading patterns, frontend frameworks, and other technical tools and concepts.
  • Proficiency with programming languages such as JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar languages.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

    We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region.

A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role
 
Forward Deployed AI Engineers work directly with customers owning Gen AI strategy and implementation. On a daily basis, you will build end-to-end workflows, take them to production, and solve real world problems at the largest scale. You will have ample opportunity to contribute learnings from the field back to the Palantir AIP product suite.
 
You will be on the forefront of extending Palantir's existing footprint and strategy into new markets and problem spaces opened up by Gen AI.
 
Core Responsibilities
 
Forward Deployed AI Engineers’ responsibilities look similar to those of a hands-on AI startup CTO: you’ll work in small teams to own delivery of high stakes projects with clients. A day’s work may include building LLM workflows on a large scale, interacting with customers to understand their needs and set their AI strategy, but the most impact will be driven by implementing solutions into the real world of our partner's organisations.
 
Do you aspire to be an entrepreneur or an Applied AI leader? We believe Palantir is the best place — with the best colleagues — to learn how!

What We Value
  • Engineering mindset, focused on delivering production solutions with Gen AI, data processing pipelines, and advanced analytics tools.
  • Solving real business problems, not academic benchmarks.
  • Ability to collaborate efficiently in teams of technical and non-technical individuals.
  • Comfort working in a dynamic environment with evolving objectives and direct iteration with users.

    • What We Require
  • Past experience building solutions with LLMs and a deep understanding of overall Gen AI landscape.
  • Strong foundation in Machine Learning basics (Evaluation, Training, Problem Decomposition).
  • Strong engineering background. Preferred fields include but are not limited to Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, and Machine Learning.
  • Strong coder with demonstrated proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, C++, TypeScript/JavaScript, or similar.
  • Ability and interest in travelling up to 25%, as needed to client sites, but flexible based on personal preferences.
    • Life at Palantir
     
    We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region.
     
    In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the city and or country in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.
     
    If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please and let us know how we can help.
     
    Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

title: Backend Software Engineer - Infrastructure, Foundations
description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role
 
Backend Software Engineers at Palantir build software at scale to transform how organisations use data. Our Software Engineers are involved throughout the product lifecycle, from idea generation, design, prototyping, and production delivery. You will collaborate closely with technical and non-technical teammates to understand our customers' problems and build products that solve them. We encourage movement across teams to share context, skills, and experience, so you'll learn about many different technologies and aspects of each product. Engineers work autonomously and make decisions independently, within a community that will support and challenge you as you grow and develop, becoming a strong technical contributor and engineering leader.
 
Our Product Development organisation is made up of small teams of Software Engineers. Each team focuses on a specific aspect of a product. Our infrastructure teams are responsible for the lowest layers of our software stack, often focused on database technologies, distributed systems, large scale data systems, security, and application infrastructure. As a Software Engineer on infrastructure, you'll contribute high-quality code to underpin Palantir Foundry and Gotham with performant, secure, and scalable building blocks, enabling products deployed to the most important institutions in the public and private sector. You'll build the foundational capabilities that power our products used by research scientists, aerospace engineers, intelligence analysts, and economic forecasters, in countries around the world.
 
We’re hiring engineers who are passionate about solving real-world problems and empowering both developers and end-users to work optimally. If you’re motivated to develop reliable, performant, and scalable systems, and to design robust APIs and primitives, this role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our products and the people who use them.

Core Responsibilities
  • Building a performant search and indexing ecosystem for complex granularly permissioned data
  • Contributing to open-source data processing libraries, integrating the latest innovations to achieve performance gains
  • Building the distributed systems that power large scale compute workloads, orchestrating and efficiently scheduling hundreds of thousands of containers every hour
  • Designing architecture and opinionated APIs to keep application developers on the happy path
  • Tracing and performance observability in high scale distributed microservice architectures

  • Open-source technologies like Cassandra, ElasticSearch, Spark, Kafka, Kubernetes, Flink
  • Industry-standard build tooling, including Gradle and GitHub

  • Ability to learn new technology and concepts, even without in-depth experience. Experience developing and managing highly-available distributed systems is beneficial, but not required.
  • Bias towards quality and thoughtful about edge cases (“anything that can go wrong will go wrong”); writes code that is defensive against all possibilities.
  • Builds solutions and APIs with users in mind while maintaining a high engineering bar. Seeks to centralise and abstract complexity away from our users in order to expose simple, powerful APIs for consumers.
  • Active US Security clearance, or eligibility and willingness to obtain a US Security clearance is beneficial, but not necessary.

    • What We Require
  • Engineering background in Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics or similar field
  • Strong coding skills with demonstrated proficiency in programming languages, such as Java, C++, Python, Rust, or similar languages
  • Familiarity with storage and data processing systems, cloud infrastructure, and other technical tools

title: Analyste SOC N3
description:
Présentation de l’entreprise

Basée à Reims, ANETSYS est une entreprise de conseil et d’ingénierie informatique spécialisée dans la cybersécurité. Nous accompagnons des organisations publiques et privées sur des problématiques de sécurité numérique, de modernisation applicative, de transformation Cloud, de systèmes/réseaux et de résilience opérationnelle.

Forte de son expertise, l’équipe d’ANETSYS s’efforce de proposer des solutions technologiques de premier plan, répondant aux besoins et aux défis actuels.

Nous recherchons un Analyste SOC N3 habilitable pour intervenir au sein d’une équipe SOC en environnement de production sur un poste principalement orienté RUN.

Vos missions

Vous serez en charge de :

Investigation et analyse avancée des menaces: analyse approfondie des alertes, logs, événements de sécurité et comportements suspects.

  • Traitement des incidents complexes : compromission de comptes, attaques ciblées, malwares, phishing avancé, mouvements latéraux et vulnérabilités critiques.
  • Réponse à incident : pilotage technique des investigations, coordination des actions de remédiation et accompagnement des équipes concernées.
  • Threat Hunting : recherche proactive de comportements suspects et de signaux faibles au sein des environnements clients.
  • Analyse et amélioration des règles de détection : optimisation des use cases SIEM, réduction des faux positifs et amélioration de la couverture de détection.
  • Gestion des vulnérabilités : analyse des vulnérabilités critiques, évaluation des risques, suivi de la remédiation et recommandations techniques.
  • Amélioration continue du SOC : évolution des procédures, méthodes d’investigation, playbooks et automatisation des actions récurrentes.
  • Expertise et support N2 : accompagnement des analystes N2 sur les incidents complexes et transfert de compétences.
  • Veille cybersécurité : suivi des nouvelles menaces, techniques d’attaque et vulnérabilités afin d’adapter les capacités de détection du SOC.
  • Contribution à la stratégie de sécurité : recommandations techniques et participation à l’amélioration globale de la posture de sécurité des clients.

Profil

  • Bac+4 en informatique, cybersécurité ou domaine équivalent ;
  • Minimum 4 ans d’expérience en SOC, supervision sécurité ou exploitation sécurité
  • Expérience sur des activités de niveau N3 ;
  • Autonomie, rigueur et esprit d’analyse ;
  • Bonne capacité à travailler en équipe et à échanger avec les équipes techniques.

Vos compétences

Compétences techniques

  • Bonne connaissance du fonctionnement des applications, de leurs flux et de leurs environnements techniques ;
  • Analyse et qualification des alertes de sécurité ;
  • Analyse des logs applicatifs et de sécurité ;
  • Corrélation des événements issus du SIEM et des différentes sources de logs ;
  • Investigation et traitement des incidents de sécurité de niveau N2 ;
  • Maîtrise d’une solution SIEM telle que Splunk, QRadar, ELK ou équivalent ;

Environnement

SOC, SIEM, supervision applicative, collecte de logs, Windows, Linux, réseaux et environnements Cloud.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Missions variées et challenges internationaux.
  • Travail dans un SOC dynamique et innovant.
  • Opportunité de prendre des initiatives et de contribuer à la stratégie globale de sécurité.

title: Chargé(e) de Communication & Marketing H/F - Stage
description:
STAGE – CHARGÉ(E) DE COMMUNICATION & MARKETING

Fondation ICAPE Planète Bleue

Durée : 4 à 6 mois

Localisation : Fontenay-aux-Roses (92)
Début : Septembre / Octobre 2026

Qui sommes-nous ?

ICAPE Group est un groupe international spécialisé dans la distribution de circuits imprimés (PCB) et de pièces techniques sur mesure destinés à l’industrie électronique.

Présent à l’international, le Groupe accompagne ses clients dans de nombreux secteurs industriels et s’appuie sur des équipes réparties dans le monde entier.

Au-delà de son activité, ICAPE Group souhaite également agir concrètement en faveur de projets environnementaux et solidaires. C’est dans cette démarche qu’a été créée la Fondation ICAPE Planète Bleue.

La Fondation ICAPE Planète Bleue

La Fondation ICAPE Planète Bleue porte et soutient des initiatives à impact environnemental, social et solidaire.

À travers ses propres projets et le soutien apporté à des associations, elle souhaite contribuer concrètement à des causes liées notamment à la préservation des océans et de l’environnement, la solidarité, l’inclusion et l’accès à des expériences porteuses de sens pour des publics fragilisés.

Parmi ses projets emblématiques figure notamment Cap Magie Bleue, une association créée autour de la goélette Magie Bleue. Après plusieurs années de rénovation, ce bateau historique reprend la mer avec une nouvelle vocation : devenir un outil au service de la solidarité, de la sensibilisation à l’environnement et du monde associatif.

Votre mission

Dans le cadre du développement des activités de la Fondation, nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire en Communication & Marketing pour nous aider à faire connaître ses actions, valoriser les projets soutenus et développer l’engagement autour de ses initiatives.

Vous travaillerez sur des sujets très concrets, au contact des équipes, associations et partenaires, avec une vraie dimension communication, création de contenus et terrain.

Vos missions

Communication & création de contenus

  • Participer à la construction et au suivi du calendrier éditorial de la Fondation ;
  • Rédiger des contenus pour différents supports : réseaux sociaux, actualités, newsletters, site internet, présentations et supports de communication ;
  • Mettre en valeur les projets soutenus, les associations partenaires et leurs bénéficiaires ;
  • Recueillir témoignages, photos, vidéos, chiffres clés et informations sur les actions réalisées ;
  • Imaginer de nouveaux formats : interviews, portraits, vidéos courtes, infographies, témoignages, reportages terrain ;
  • Participer à la création et à l’adaptation de supports visuels et éditoriaux.

Communication digitale & réseaux sociaux

  • Participer à l’animation des réseaux sociaux et des différents canaux de communication ;
  • Contribuer à la mise à jour des contenus web ;
  • Proposer de nouveaux sujets et formats pour développer la visibilité de la Fondation ;
  • Participer au développement de la notoriété des différents projets ;
  • Suivre les performances des communications et identifier les contenus les plus engageants.

Événementiel & projets terrain

  • Participer à l’organisation des événements et opérations portés ou soutenus par la Fondation ;
  • Préparer les supports de communication, invitations et contenus associés ;
  • Participer à la communication avant, pendant et après les événements ;
  • Contribuer à la couverture des événements : photos, vidéos, interviews, contenus pour les réseaux sociaux ;
  • Participer aux initiatives permettant d’impliquer les collaborateurs, partenaires et associations autour des projets de la Fondation.

Valorisation des projets & de leur impact

  • Participer au suivi et à la valorisation des projets soutenus ;
  • Collecter et structurer les principaux chiffres et résultats ;
  • Créer des présentations, bilans et contenus permettant de montrer concrètement l’impact des actions ;
  • Réaliser une veille sur les initiatives et bonnes pratiques en matière de mécénat, d’engagement, d’environnement et de communication des fondations d’entreprise.

Profil recherché

Vous êtes étudiant(e) en Bac+2 (BTS), Bac+3 à Bac+5, en école de communication, marketing, commerce ou formation équivalente.

Nous recherchons avant tout une personne :

  • Créative, curieuse et force de proposition ;
  • Avec une très bonne capacité rédactionnelle ;
  • À l’aise avec les réseaux sociaux et la création de contenus ;
  • Organisée, autonome et polyvalente ;
  • Capable de travailler sur plusieurs projets simultanément et de gérer les priorités, y compris lorsque les délais sont courts ;
  • À l’écoute des équipes de la Fondation et de l’Association, capable de prendre en compte leurs retours et leurs demandes et de les traduire concrètement en actions de communication ;
  • À l’aise avec des interlocuteurs variés : collaborateurs, associations, partenaires et prestataires ;
  • Qui apprécie autant réfléchir à une idée que la mettre concrètement en œuvre.
  • Une sensibilité aux sujets liés à l’environnement, aux océans, à la solidarité, à l’inclusion, au monde associatif ou au mécénat sera particulièrement appréciée.
  • La maîtrise de Canva et/ou d’outils de création de contenus photo/vidéo est un plus.
  • Un bon niveau d’anglais serait également apprécié.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Ce stage offre l’opportunité de travailler sur des projets très variés et surtout concrets, avec une forte dimension humaine et terrain.

Vous pourrez participer à un projet de A à Z : imaginer une communication, rencontrer les acteurs concernés, créer les contenus, participer à l’événement ou à l’action puis en valoriser les résultats.

Vous rejoindrez un environnement international tout en travaillant sur des projets locaux et associatifs, avec une réelle liberté pour proposer de nouvelles idées, tester de nouveaux formats et contribuer au développement de la visibilité de la Fondation.

Nous recherchons une personne qui ait envie de faire, proposer, créer et raconter des projets qui ont du sens.

title: Traffic & Acquisition Manager SEO, SEA et GEO
description:
CDI à mi-temps évolutif vers un temps plein
17 h 30 par semaine
Pacé, près de Rennes
Prise de poste dès que possible

---

Size Up est une agence de marketing et de communication qui accompagne ses clients de la stratégie de marque jusqu’à l’acquisition.

  • Notre conviction : du branding à l’acquisition, chaque détail compte.

Nous travaillons principalement avec des entreprises B2B, mais également sur certains projets B2C. Notre équipe réunit aujourd’hui cinq personnes, en interne et en externe, avec des expertises complémentaires en stratégie, création, communication, acquisition et production de contenus.

  • Pour renforcer notre pôle acquisition, nous recherchons un Traffic & Acquisition Manager capable de générer du trafic qualifié, mais surtout de mesurer sa contribution aux objectifs commerciaux de nos clients.

Vos missions

Vous pilotez les différents leviers permettant d’améliorer la visibilité, le trafic, la génération de leads et les conversions de nos clients.

Vous intervenez aussi bien sur l’acquisition payante que sur le référencement naturel et l’optimisation de la présence des marques dans les moteurs de recherche et les outils d’intelligence artificielle.

Votre rôle ne consiste pas seulement à lancer des campagnes ou à produire des contenus. Vous devez comprendre les objectifs du client, sélectionner les bons leviers, suivre les résultats et optimiser continuellement les actions engagées.

---

Acquisition payante :

Vous concevez, déployez et optimisez des campagnes publicitaires sur différentes plateformes :

  • Google Ads
  • Microsoft Advertising
  • Meta Ads
  • LinkedIn Ads
  • YouTube Ads
  • ChatGPT Ads
  • Toute autre plateforme pertinente selon les objectifs et les audiences du client

Vous assurez la structuration des comptes, le paramétrage des campagnes, la gestion des audiences, le suivi des budgets, la création ou la coordination des annonces, les tests et l’optimisation des performances.

---

SEO, contenus et GEO :

Vous réalisez des audits SEO et identifiez les actions à mener sur les dimensions techniques, sémantiques, éditoriales et de popularité.

Vous prenez notamment en charge :

  • La recherche de mots-clés et l’analyse des intentions de recherche
  • La construction de stratégies et de calendriers éditoriaux
  • La génération, la rédaction et l’optimisation d’articles
  • L’intégration et la publication des contenus dans WordPress
  • L’optimisation des pages existantes
  • Le maillage interne
  • L’identification des problèmes techniques
  • Le suivi de l’indexation et des positions
  • L’optimisation de la visibilité dans les moteurs de recherche
  • Le développement de la visibilité dans les assistants et moteurs alimentés par l’intelligence artificielle
  • La veille sur les évolutions du SEO, du GEO et des nouveaux usages de recherche

---

Mesure et pilotage de la performance :

Vous mettez en place les outils nécessaires pour mesurer précisément les résultats obtenus.

Vous êtes capable de répondre à des questions simples mais essentielles :

  • Combien l’action a-t-elle coûté ?
  • Combien de trafic a-t-elle généré ?
  • Combien de prospects ou de ventes a-t-elle produits ?
  • Quel est le coût par lead ou par acquisition ?
  • Quel est le retour sur investissement ?
  • Que faut-il arrêter, maintenir, tester ou intensifier ?

Vous construisez des tableaux de bord, analysez les KPI et produisez des comptes rendus clairs et exploitables pour les clients.

Conseil et relation client

Vous participez aux réunions de suivi avec les clients.

Vous présentez les résultats obtenus, expliquez les écarts, recommandez les prochaines actions et êtes force de proposition.

Vous savez transformer des données parfois complexes en conclusions compréhensibles et en décisions concrètes.

---

Les outils à maîtriser idéalement :

Vous devez être opérationnel sur une grande partie des outils suivants :

  • Google Ads
  • Google Analytics 4
  • Google Search Console
  • Google Tag Manager
  • Looker Studio
  • Semrush
  • Ahrefs
  • Screaming Frog
  • WordPress
  • Meta Business Manager
  • LinkedIn Campaign Manager
  • Microsoft Advertising

La maîtrise de l’intelligence artificielle est obligatoire. Vous utilisez avec discernement ChatGPT, Claude ou d’autres solutions selon les besoins : recherche, analyse, rédaction, automatisation, idéation, audit et optimisation.

Nous ne recherchons pas quelqu’un qui confie sa réflexion à l’IA, mais une personne capable de l’utiliser pour travailler plus vite, approfondir ses analyses et améliorer la qualité de ses productions.

Vos compétences

Le profil recherché

Vous justifiez d’au moins trois ans d’expérience sur un poste en acquisition digitale, traffic management, SEO, SEA ou performance marketing. Une expérience de trois à cinq ans, idéalement en agence ou auprès de plusieurs clients, est attendue.

Vous êtes :

  • Autonome dans l’organisation et l’exécution de vos missions
  • À l’aise avec les chiffres, les KPI et l’analyse de données
  • Capable de gérer plusieurs comptes clients simultanément
  • Rigoureux dans le suivi des budgets et des performances
  • À l’aise à l’écrit comme à l’oral
  • Capable de rédiger et d’optimiser des contenus
  • Force de proposition
  • Curieux et persévérant
  • Capable de remettre en question une campagne ou une stratégie qui ne produit pas les résultats attendus

Vous n’avez pas besoin de maîtriser parfaitement toutes les plateformes dès votre arrivée. En revanche, vous devez disposer de bases solides en Google Ads, SEO, analytics et tracking, ainsi que d’une réelle capacité à apprendre et à expérimenter.

---

La veille fait partie du poste

Chez Size Up, la veille n’est pas une activité occasionnelle réalisée en dehors du temps de travail.

Elle fait pleinement partie des missions et peut être réalisée pendant les heures de travail. Nous attendons de la personne recrutée qu’elle explore les nouveaux outils, teste de nouvelles méthodes, suive les évolutions des plateformes et partage ses découvertes avec l’équipe.

Cette veille doit cependant rester orientée vers l’action : tester, mesurer, documenter et déterminer ce qui peut réellement améliorer les résultats de nos clients.

Avantages

Conditions proposées

  • CDI à mi-temps
  • 17 h 30 par semaine
  • Poste évolutif vers un temps plein selon les compétences développées, les résultats obtenus et les souhaits du salarié
  • Rémunération : 1800 € à 2300€ net selon profil
  • Convention collective Syntec
  • Statut et classification déterminés selon le profil retenu et les dispositions de la convention collective
  • Période d’essai : 3 mois
  • Bureaux : à Pacé, près de Rennes
  • Télétravail : 1 jour /semaine pendant la période d’essai, puis 2 jours /semaine après validation de la période d’essai
  • 7 semaines de congés payés
  • Prise de poste dès que possible

Pour candidater

Envoyez-nous votre CV, accompagné de quelques exemples concrets de campagnes, audits, contenus ou résultats obtenus.

Au-delà des certifications et des intitulés de poste, nous souhaitons comprendre votre manière de travailler :

  • Les budgets que vous avez pilotés
  • Les résultats que vous avez obtenus

Si vous aimez chercher, tester, mesurer et améliorer, nous serons ravis d’échanger avec vous.
