title: Closed Procedure: Senior Account Director - Strategic Account in Maritime Logistics for SITA
description:
Senior Account Director - Strategic Account in Maritime Logistics for SITA

 

Executive summary: A senior international key account role for a professional who excels in relationship management, stakeholder engagement, and strategic account development. In this position, you will be responsible for retaining, deepening, and further strengthening the partnership with one of SITA’s ( https://www.sita.aero/about-us/ )  most strategic clients.

Highlights: Senior Account Director - Strategic Account in Maritime Logistics | SITA

·      End-to-end responsibility for a strategic international key account

·      Strong focus on relationship management, retention, and deepening the partnership with C-level, IT directors, Enterprise architects, both on the IT organization of the client as well the Business organization.

·      International sales and stakeholder management role with high visibility in the customer environment

·      Significant impact on client satisfaction, continuity and commercial development, including revenue management

·      Strong focus on managed IT and Connectivity services (infrastructure) and differentiated value propositions, based on the portfolio of SITA

·      Key position within an international team and complex IT enterprise and Business environment

·      Operational / dotted leadership of a highly skilled IT team of 6 FTE at client site

 

Purpose of the role

For SITA, we are looking for a Senior Account Director who will take international responsibility for the strategic international key account. In this role, the emphasis is on retaining, deepening, and future-proofing an existing client relationship with significant commercial and operational value. The focus is not on aggressive revenue growth, but on stability, continuity and additional commercial opportunities within an established international account.

 

About the role, building future proof relationships

As Senior Account Director, you will be responsible for managing and further developing the strategic international key account within SITA. You will operate in an international environment where relationship development focusing on account retention, you understand the complexity of enterprise. IT, data and connectivity sales and know how to create structural value within an existing client relationship.

 

The ideal candidate is an experienced sales professional with proven knowledge of strategic international key account as an organization, for example from a previous role as a supplier or strategic partner. IT knowledge and experience with managed services are important, but deep client knowledge, insight into decision-making structures, and an understanding of international stakeholder dynamics are even more critical in this position. You can build sustainable relationships at multiple levels, create internal and external alignment in a smart and distinctive way.

 

About SITA

SITA has been a leading technology partner for the international travel and transport sector since 1949. In its early years, the SITA company built one of the first large-scale communications networks for aviation and today continues to play a global role in making travel and logistics processes smarter, safer, and more efficient. SITA has since expanded this expertise into maritime services and managed services for logistics organizations

 

SITA supports organizations with contact center solutions, connectivity, digital collaboration, security, and managed services. Within this context, strategic international key account for whom SITA delivers services worldwide that directly contribute to customer contact, collaboration, and operational continuity.

Client context

The strategic international key account one of the world’s leading container shipping and logistics companies, with approximately 18.000 employees globally, 340 + offices in 120 + countries, and connections to more than 550 ports worldwide. The organization is known for its strong focus on quality, digitalization, customer centricity, and operational excellence.

For this role, insight into the international dynamics of a complex logistics organization is essential. You understand how technology, service delivery, and stakeholder management come together in an environment where continuity, reliability, and client satisfaction have a direct impact on the business.

The partnership between SITA and the strategic international key account is built on a strong foundation. Your assignment will be to further deepen this relationship, strengthen SITA’s position, and carefully and strategically develop new opportunities within the account.

 

Portfolio and services at the key account

·       Contact centre and voice solutions

·       Global connectivity solutions

·       Managed services for communication and office environments

·       Management of digital workplaces and office environments

·       Security solutions

 

What will you do?

·       You will have end-to-end responsibility for the international account management strategic key account within SITA.

·       You will build and deepen sustainable relationships with stakeholders at operational, tactical, and strategic levels.

·       You will safeguard the existing revenue base and drive maximum client retention in an environment where managed services are largely viewed as a commodity.

·       You will identify commercial opportunities and translate them into distinctive, relevant, and viable propositions.

·       You will clearly operate as a farmer rather than a hunter account retention, and strategic growth is the main focus.

·       You will position SITA as a partner that adds value more intelligently, effectively, and innovatively than the market expects.

·       You will work effectively with internal teams, senior stakeholders, and specialists to serve the client optimally.

·       You will provide day-to-day direction to a highly skilled IT delivery team of 6 FTE at the client (virtual and extended account team).

 

Terms of employment

This position offers a fixed gross monthly salary between €9.000,- and €11.000,- gross monthly, complemented by an attractive variable compensation model. The bonus structure consists of a sales incentive based on revenue, with approximately 40% of the variable compensation linked to renewals. In addition, you will receive commission on closed deals. With strong performance, a total package of up to approximately €160,000 OTE is achievable.

Procedure

Following a successful introductory phone call, you will have 2 face-to-face meetings with a SoundPeople senior consultant. If both sides see sufficient reason to move forward, we will introduce you to SITA. You will then go through three interview rounds with the client:

 

The first interview round will take place with a Account Executive of SITA (Central Europe) and an HR professional. The second round will be with the SVP of Central Europe and the current Account Director. In the final stage, the ultimate selection and terms of employment will be aligned with the President of Europe and the COO.

 

Interested?

 

This opportunity is designed for an accomplished enterprise account leader who understands that a mature strategic relationship still requires energy, precision and continuous development. If you can combine executive stakeholder management with commercial ownership and coordinated delivery, we would like to hear from you.

 

Contact Sven Fremeijer at Sound People BV, Executive Search

LinkedIn:  https://www.linkedin.com/in/svenfremeijer/


Who are we looking for?

We are looking for a senior sales professional with extensive experience in complex enterprise environments and a strong understanding of international client dynamics. Ideally, you know the strategic international key account from a supplier or partner perspective and understand the organization, its decision-making processes, and the interests at play. You combine commercial sharpness with high-level know how to create momentum based on trust, substance, and personal leadership.

 

·      Proven experience in MSP, IT, managed services and/or Telco environments

·      Deep client knowledge and preferably previous experience with strategic key account

·      Creative, innovative, and strategically strong in commercial positioning

·      Excellent networker and a credible sparring partner at C-level

·      Structured, results-driven, and operationally strong

·      Able to move organizations forward through relationships and trust, rather than hierarchy or pressure

·      Must: Excellent communication skills in an international environment.

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within Doit's AI Neobank App.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

title: Director, Enterprise Sales (EMEA)
Enterprise SDR - London
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

What the job actually feels like

This is a build job.

When you join, BLP has no UK pipeline, no UK case studies, and no local playbook. It’s not the well-oiled machine with sophisticated processes for everything. What you get instead: an experienced Account Executive sitting next to you, a reporting line to the VP of Business Development and a strong DACH SDR team behind you. You get a winning product and a market nobody here has sold into yet. All of that comes with strong support from the Switzerland HQ.


Your first job is to work out who buys, why, and what makes them pick up the phone. You will hear no far more often than yes. The yes is a 30-minute discovery call with a CFO, COO, or Head of Finance at a large UK manufacturer or industrial business, where you run the meeting, present the value, and map the stakeholders live.

If you want a finished machine to plug into, this is the wrong role. If you want to help build the machine, read on.

 

About the role

As our Founding SDR in London, you own outbound into UK enterprise accounts. You will prospect and open relationships with Finance and Procurement leaders (CFO, COO, Head of Shared Services, Process Excellence, AP) and generate qualified opportunities for our agentic AI platform automating Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash. Don’t expect inbounds to carry you from day one.

You are one of the first commercial hires on the ground in a new market. You prospect, you run the connect calls, and you help write the playbook the next UK hires will use. You report directly to the VP of Business Development for now, work day to day with the UK Account Executive as a tag-team, and lean on the DACH SDR team for what already works.

You will monitor the UK market with regards to procurement and finance processes, ERP transformation announcements and buying triggers, and turn what you learn into better targeting. We need you to flag what is not working early and bring it to the team, so we fix the approach fast instead of grinding on a broken one.

Once the UK team reaches critical mass and shows initial success, we hire a local team lead (internally or externally).

 

Tech stack

You will work with a sharp outbound stack: HubSpot as our CRM and source of truth, Clay for enrichment and signal-based prospecting, Claude for AI assisted tasks and research, and LinkMatch to keep LinkedIn and HubSpot in sync without manual logging. That said, the work has a strong outbound and calling focus. You will help decide what to add as the motion matures.

 

We're excited about you because

  • You have roughly 2 to 5 years of experience in a B2B SaaS SDR or BDR role, most of it outbound, and you have built or helped build an outbound motion rather than only working an established one.

  • You know the UK market and can navigate UK enterprise buyers, ideally with experience selling to Finance, Procurement, or Operations.

  • You can run a discovery call with a senior stakeholder: you hold the room, communicate clearly, adapt to a CFO or a Head of Procurement, and understand the buying center.

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity. No inbound, no case studies, no script on day one does not rattle you, it interests you. You see opportunity.

  • You enjoy problem-solving and have a natural curiosity that drives you to find creative solutions.

  • You are looking for a role that comes with key responsibility beyond the typical SDR scope.

  • You take ownership, ask for help when you are stuck, act on feedback, and pass on what you learn to the people who join after you.

Bonus points

  • You have been a founding or first SDR in a new market, or helped stand up a new territory.

  • You know the ERP domain, or have sold Finance, Procurement, or industrial software and are familiar with P2P/O2C processes.

  • You are familiar with HubSpot as a CRM and Clay.

  • You speak another European language.

 

What you'll get

  • London Office. This role is based in our London office, You will spend regular time with your DACH peers in our HQ in Zurich and are invited over for onboarding.

  • Onboarding built for a founding rep. There is onboarding material that trains you on our product, you get a buddy from the DACH SDR team and direct support from the VP Business Development.

  • High earning potential. Uncapped commission and potential for a 6-figure package.

  • Equal OTEs. As we share the same incentives, you'll be comped as the Account Executives.

  • Opportunities to grow. You're controlling your personal development and career trajectory in a rapidly growing, internationally expanding startup.

  • Exceptional colleagues. You'll be growing alongside individuals from exceptional academic backgrounds and careers.

 

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time.

That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.

About the Role

You'll help build the geometric foundation of the next-generation world map — joining our World Map Research Engineering team (Geospatial Alignment) as a Research Engineer or Senior Research Engineer. This is an end-to-end applied research role that spans from strong engineering and data-systems work to R&D in 3D deep learning, transformers, and foundation models. You'll develop new algorithms, produce the research data and evaluation assets needed to advance them, and engineer the resulting capabilities into dependable production systems.

The World Map team works with heterogeneous captures from phones and handheld devices, aerial imagery, LiDAR, and 360 cameras, as well as external geographic and elevation data. The central challenge is to harmonize these data sources, quantify uncertainty, and maintain consistency as the map evolves.

You'll work at the intersection of cutting-edge research and scalable engineering — developing new approaches to geospatial registration, correspondence, and geometric optimization, then productionizing these technologies to directly improve Niantic Spatial's world model.

What You'll Do

  • Geospatial Registration — Develop and advance algorithms for world-scale georeferencing and registration across imagery, 3D reconstructions, point clouds, and geographic reference data.

  • 3D Geometry & Correspondence — Build and improve methods spanning multi-view geometry, SfM, SLAM, feature matching, learned correspondence, bundle adjustment, point-cloud registration, and ICP.

  • Data & Evaluation — Create the data and evaluation flywheel for world-scale mapping — design and maintain large-scale datasets, pipelines, benchmarks, and evaluation methodologies that expose hard failure modes, accelerate research iteration, and support production.

  • Learning-Based 3D Reasoning — Explore and develop learning-based approaches for geospatial understanding, combining transformers and 3D foundation models with geometric priors and uncertainty modeling.

  • Production Robustness — Design robust solutions for challenging real-world conditions: sparse or noisy GPS, changing appearance, inconsistent reconstruction quality, large geographic extents, and imperfect reference maps.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration — Partner with leading researchers in visual localization, 3D computer vision, and mapping — as well as engineering and product teams — to identify high-impact problems and turn research breakthroughs into end-to-end production systems.

  • Research Communication — Share results clearly through technical writing, design reviews, and internal presentations; contribute to publications and open research where appropriate.

What You'll Bring

  • Strong grounding in 3D computer vision, machine learning, robotics, photogrammetry, or a closely related area.

  • Strong Python skills and experience with modern ML and scientific-computing libraries (PyTorch, NumPy, SciPy).

  • Strong software engineering skills — you can turn research prototypes into reliable, scalable, and maintainable systems.

  • A track record of taking an algorithm from research idea and experimental prototype through evaluation, benchmarking, and deployment on real-world data.

  • Clear written and verbal communication; able to collaborate effectively across research and engineering disciplines.

  • A strong publication record or active involvement in the research community at venues such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR, SIGGRAPH, 3DV, ICRA, or RSS.

  • Experience with learning-based approaches for visual or 3D understanding — transformers, point transformers, foundation models, or methods combining learned representations with explicit geometric priors.

  • Experience with aerial or satellite imagery, GNSS/GPS, geodesy, mapping systems, or large-scale spatial data.

title: Member of Scientific Staff, Cell Culture and Functional Assays
description:
LOCATION: King's Cross, London · PATTERN: Lab-based, full-time

The opportunity

We're a stealth startup in AI and bio, building infrastructure for data generation. The team is small and elite, the problems are hard, and the foundations are being laid right now. You'd help write them from the first line, with real ownership and a direct line to the founders.

This role covers the cell side of our protein characterisation work. You would keep the cell lines healthy and run the assays that show how a designed protein behaves on a living cell, week after week, to the same standard.

About us

AI for biology has a data problem. The data that matters most doesn't exist yet, so we're building the infrastructure to produce it, with quality and traceability built in from day one.

We're in stealth and heads-down on execution. We'll share more about what we're building once you've spoken with the team.

The role

You will run cell culture and the cell-based assays for our protein characterisation work. That means the mammalian lines the assays depend on, from thaw through routine passage to a banked and documented stock, and the weekly rhythm of seeding, treating, reading and reporting plates.

Most of it runs in 384-well plates with imaging-based or flow cytometry readouts. You will run those assays as designed, with the controls and replicates that make a curve defensible, and you will be the person who notices when a plate, a line or a reagent lot has started to drift.

Assay design and the shape of the cascade sit with the scientist who leads this work today, so you are not being asked to invent the panel. You are being asked to make it run the same way every week, to record what you did in a form the rest of the system can read, and to tighten the protocols as they settle, including moving them towards the plate formats our automation will take on.

Your first 90 days

FIRST 30 DAYS

◆ Take over routine culture and banking for the protein cell lines, working to the protocols we already run.

◆ Learn the panel end to end by running each assay alongside the scientist who owns it.

DAYS 30 TO 60

◆ Run at least one assay in the panel independently, including its controls and acceptance criteria.

◆ Revise one culture or assay protocol so that someone else could follow it without asking you.

DAYS 60 TO 90

◆ Hold the weekly assay schedule on your own and return results on the agreed turnaround.

◆ Bring one protocol to a tighter precision bar, or into a plate format ready for automation.

Who you are

You are a hands-on cell biologist who takes assay variability personally. You have run the same assay often enough to tell a real effect from a bad plate, and you would rather find the cause than repeat the run.

The week has a rhythm in this job: cells to feed, plates to seed, runs to finish, numbers to return. You are happy with that, you keep records someone else can pick up, and you say early when something looks wrong rather than at the end of the week.

We do not hire people into boxes. The team is small, and early hires here end up owning work beyond the job they joined for. Nobody arrives with every part of this role. If you are strong in most of it and quick to learn the rest, we want to hear from you.

MUST HAVE

◆ Strong hands-on mammalian cell culture: adherent and suspension lines, aseptic technique, and thawing, passaging and banking to a high and consistent standard.

◆ Experience running cell-based assays end to end, including relevant controls, replicates and dose-response curves behind a reported number.

◆ Comfort with plate-based work and the arithmetic that goes with it, such as dilution series, plate maps and normalisation.

◆ Careful, traceable record-keeping that someone else can follow without asking you.

◆ A PhD in cell biology, pharmacology, immunology or a related field, or an MSc and two to three years of relevant lab experience.

NICE TO HAVE

◆ Reporter cell line bioassays for binding or blockade.

◆ Receptor internalisation, lysosomal trafficking or cytotoxicity assays.

◆ High-content or fluorescence imaging, and the image analysis behind it.

◆ 384-well formats, liquid handlers or other plate-based automation.

◆ Flow cytometry, for example for surface receptor quantification.

Why this is unusual

Most cell-based assay roles sit inside a discovery project. You build an assay, you answer a question with it, and the assay goes quiet. This one is closer to running an instrument. The same assays run every week against a stream of new molecules, and the number that comes out is the product.

That changes what good looks like. Precision matters more than novelty, a protocol is only finished when someone else can run it and get your answer, and every passage, plate and reagent lot is captured as structured data, because a result is only as trustworthy as the cells behind it.

Some people find that energising; some find it outside their lane. Worth knowing in advance which one you are.

How we work

This is a lab-based role at our site in King's Cross, London. The cells are in the lab, so most of your week will be too, with room for writing and analysis away from the bench. The wider team is distributed and travels, so you will work with people who are not always in the building.

We work in the open. Decisions are written down, work happens centrally rather than scattered across tools, and the week opens with a session the whole company attends. There is a quarterly offsite. Each person owns their area and makes the call inside it, and we will expect that of you early rather than late.

UK benefits are 30 days of annual leave plus public holidays, a pension with a 10% employer contribution, and top-tier Bupa private health cover. More is added as the team grows.

The team you will join

You will join the protein characterisation team and report to its lead. Day to day you will work with the scientist who designs the assay cascade, with the protein production and molecular characterisation scientists upstream of you, with the functional genomics team who share the cell culture suite, and with the engineers building the software and automation the lab runs on.

We are a small, elite team, and this is the first seat given entirely to the cell-based side of the work.

Our process

Our process has four stages. A short screening call about the role and the practicalities. A behavioural interview about how you work, run from the same template for every candidate, before anything technical. A technical stage with the protein characterisation team, built around real work rather than a puzzle, including time with us in person at the lab. Then references, aimed at whatever we still want to understand.

If you are not sure whether you match every line above, apply anyway. We would rather read it and decide.

Vous participerez directement au run de la production et serez progressivement autonome sur l’exploitation des services dont vous avez la responsabilité.

Vous serez notamment amené à :

  • surveiller quotidiennement la santé des applications et services en production ;
  • analyser les logs, métriques, traces et alertes afin d’identifier rapidement les anomalies ;
  • construire et améliorer les dashboards permettant de suivre les principaux composants et flux de la plateforme ;
  • investiguer les incidents de production jusqu’à identification de leur cause racine ;
  • suivre le bon fonctionnement des principaux flux métier et techniques ;
  • participer aux déploiements et vérifier leur bon déroulement en production ;

L’objectif est que chaque Senior Engineer puisse progressivement opérer de manière autonome les services qu’il développe, sans faire du Lead Developer le point de passage systématique pour chaque incident.

Infrastructure, DevOps & reliability

Sans nécessairement être un spécialiste DevOps ou SRE, vous devez être à l’aise avec l’environnement dans lequel votre code fonctionne.

Vous contribuerez notamment à :

  • intervenir sur les pipelines CI/CD ;
  • contribuer aux pratiques Infrastructure as Code ;
  • comprendre les problématiques de networking applicatif, configuration, secrets et dépendances externes ;
  • suivre les bases de données ;
  • améliorer les procédures de déploiement et de recovery ;
  • contribuer aux sujets de continuité et reprise d’activité.

Le Founding Engineer / Lead Developer conserve la responsabilité de la cohérence globale de l’architecture et des standards de plateforme, mais chaque Senior Engineer porte la fiabilité opérationnelle de son périmètre.

Software craftsmanship & qualité

  • Adhérer et faire vivre aux valeurs de l'artisanat logiciel.
  • Produire un code lisible, testé, documenté et maintenable.
  • Contribuer à faire progresser collectivement la qualité du codebase.
  • Appliquer et enrichir les standards engineering : tests automatisés, CI/CD, documentation, observabilité et sécurité.

Sécurité & conformité

En tant qu’assureur, Quarzo Life évolue dans un environnement particulièrement exigeant en matière de fiabilité, de sécurité et de traçabilité.

Vous contribuerez notamment à :

  • intégrer les principes de security et privacy by design dans les développements ;
  • renforcer la sécurité applicative et infrastructure ;
  • assurer la traçabilité des traitements et événements importants ;
  • participer aux chantiers techniques liés à notre trajectoire ISO 27001 ;
  • contribuer à la gestion des vulnérabilités et à la sécurisation des dépendances ;
  • prendre en compte les exigences de résilience et de continuité propres à une plateforme financière régulée.

AI-native engineering

Nous considérons les outils IA comme une nouvelle composante du métier de software engineer.

Nous attendons de nos développeurs qu’ils sachent utiliser intelligemment les assistants de développement et LLM pour accélérer leur travail tout en conservant une forte capacité de jugement sur l’architecture, le code produit et la sécurité.

  • identifier des usages IA pertinents dans notre produit et nos outils internes ;
  • contribuer à définir les bonnes pratiques de l’équipe autour de ces nouveaux outils.

Pilotage d’un portefeuille hôtels :

  • Définir et piloter la stratégie tarifaire et de distribution
  • Analyser la performance : occupation, ADR, RevPAR, pick-up, paceSuivre et optimiser les résultats au quotidien

Distribution & outils

  • Piloter le channel management et la visibilité en ligne
  • Gérer et contrôler les mises à jour sur PMS, RMS, Channel Manager, OTA
  • Assurer une utilisation optimale des outils métiers

Reporting & recommandations

  • Produire des analyses régulières et des reportings stratégiques
  • Formuler des recommandations argumentées et actionnables

Contribution interne

description:

  • 2-4+ years of quota-carrying, full-cycle B2B sales experience, ideally in SaaS.

  • A track record you can prove: quota beaten, deals closed, healthy cycle times.

  • Fluent in German and English. You sell into DACH in German; we run internally in English.

  • A completed bachelor's degree. Business or economics is a plus, but any field is welcome.
  • AI-native and ops-minded (HubSpot or a comparable CRM).
  • Bonus points: Mittelstand / ERP / manufacturing / distribution experience, or you've carried a full-cycle number in a new or greenfield market.

You'll thrive here if:

  • You'd rather build your own pipeline than wait for leads. Outbound is your instinct.
  • You like the phone, and it's where you win.
  • You own the whole deal, first touch to signature, and you want it that way.
  • You measure yourself by revenue closed, not activity.
  • You're excited to work from our Zürich office, 5 days a week, at startup intensity.

Benefits

  • Own the number, own the upside. You run your own book end to end, and your commission reflects what you close.
  • Founding-level impact. What you learn in the field becomes how Hoshii sells. You're improving the motion, not inheriting it.
  • Total ownership, zero bureaucracy. You drive every deal you touch, start to finish.
  • A direct line to the founder and the commercial lead. Your read on the market shapes strategy, not just your own deals.
  • Equity. Meaningful ownership in what you're helping build

That's what gets our attention first.

title: Senior Product Security Engineer / Architect [Lausanne]
description:
Do you want to be part of a new entrepreneurial adventure and help build the next global FinTech, then we might just have the job for you.

Taurus is a FINMA-regulated securities firm, headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, and providing digital asset trading and financial services to its clients. It is also a world-leading provider of digital asset infrastructure solutions to banks, corporations and private companies. Using blockchain technology, Taurus platform covers cryptocurrencies, tokenized securities, tokenized assets (such as NFTs), digital currencies, and stable coins.

We are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to support our fast global growth.

Tasks

A deeply hands-on, individual-contributor role where you'll raise the security bar of the product itself. You're the security partner engineers want in the room: someone who can open a diff, understand the attack surface, build the automation that enforces the fix, and ship it the same day. Much of that surface is cryptographic (keys, signing, HSMs, and the trust boundary around them), so that's where you'll have the most impact.

Responsibilities

  • Own product security for all applicable digital asset products: Taurus-PROTECT, Taurus-CAPITAL, Taurus-EXPLORER and Taurus-NETWORK. Contribute to financial services product security.

  • Contribute to security architecture for HSMs, confidential computing, MPC, and cryptographic systems

  • Perform security reviews of application code, cryptographic workflows, smart contracts, HSM integrations, and enclave-based components

  • Model threats of new features and review architectural designs before release

  • Lead and review penetration tests, reproduce findings, and validate remediation plans

  • Build and own the automation that enforces security guardrails — across CI/CD pipelines, software supply chains, Kubernetes environments, and deployment platforms

  • Pair with product engineering teams to design and ship fixes, not just file findings

  • Review authorization models, privilege management, identity integrations, and operational access controls

  • Support incident response, vulnerability management, and security investigations

  • Support client audits, RFPs, security workshops, and regulatory discussions

  • Translate regulatory and compliance requirements into practical technical controls

  • Monitor security news and trends; identify potential impact on products and ensure timely application of corrective actions

Requirements

Experience

  • Master or PhD in computer sciences, IT security engineering or cryptography
  • 7+ years in application security, product security, offensive security, or security engineering
  • Background in security-critical environments — financial services, payments, identity, custody, embedded systems, or regulated platforms
  • Fluent written and spoken English

Key Requirements

Application & product security:

  • Strong security code review experience in at least two of: Go, C/C++, TypeScript, Python
  • Threat modeling, secure design reviews, and penetration testing
  • Ability to identify business logic flaws, authorization issues, cryptographic misuse, and complex attack paths

Cryptography & key management:

  • Strong applied-cryptography foundation: PKI, TLS, X.509; AES, RSA, ECDSA, EdDSA; key management and key ceremonies; secure key storage and signing workflows
  • Experience with HSM technologies and PKCS#11 environments

Infrastructure & cloud security:

  • Strong Kubernetes and container security experience
  • Familiarity with cloud IAM, workload identity, secrets management, and policy-as-code
  • A builder’s mindset — you implement security controls, not only review them

Secure hardware & confidential computing:

  • Experience with one or more of: Thales / Luna HSM, AWS CloudHSM, Azure Managed HSM, Intel SGX, AMD SEV-SNP, AWS Nitro Enclaves, Azure Confidential Computing

Client & communication skills:

  • Comfortable engaging security teams, auditors, regulators, enterprise clients, and prospect CISOs
  • Able to explain complex security topics clearly and pragmatically

A strong plus

  • Blockchain and smart contract security
  • MPC and threshold signature systems
  • Fuzzing and secure software testing
  • Security compliance and regulatory frameworks (FINMA, DORA, MiCA, ISO 27001, SOC 2, FIPS 140-3)
  • Public security research, CVEs, bug bounty experience, or open-source security contributions
  • Experience supporting RFPs, security questionnaires, and customer due diligence
  • Degree in Computer Science, Security, or equivalent practical experience

Benefits

  • An opportunity to work at the intersection of digital assets and finance
  • A skilled and experienced team, including world-renowned experts
  • A fast-paced learning environment, entrepreneurial spirit and team spirit
  • A great moment to join as the company grows and expands
  • State-of-the-art technology and IT infrastructure
  • Hybrid remote work and flexible working hours
  • Fun team events

As the company evolves in a dynamic and innovative environment, its DNA is based on merit. As such, there will be significant growth opportunities for candidates with an open and deliver-oriented mindset. We are an equal opportunity employer.

description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.

 

Role

As an iOS Software Engineer, you own the iOS client experience, how AI feels, responds, and performs in users’ hands. This is not a thin integration role. You will build a production-grade iOS application where AI interactions are central to product experience, and performance, reliability, and user trust are critical.

 

Focus

  • Build and maintain iOS applications using Swift and SwiftUI.

  • Integrate AI-powered features through backend APIs.

  • Design UX patterns for AI interactions, including loading states, streaming responses, retries, and fallbacks.

  • Optimize performance, memory usage, and battery efficiency.

  • Capture user signals and feedback to support AI evaluation and iteration.

  • Collaborate closely with backend and ML engineers on API design and system behavior.

  • Maintain high App Store quality, stability, and production reliability.

 

Ideal Experiences

  • 3+ years of iOS development experience using Swift.

  • Hands-on experience integrating AI-powered features into mobile apps.

  • Strong understanding of async/await, concurrency, and background tasks.

  • Solid iOS performance and memory optimization skills.

  • Experience shipping and maintaining production iOS apps.

  • Comfort designing for latency, partial failure, and non-deterministic AI behavior.

  • Exposure to CoreML or light on-device ML.

  • Familiarity with feature flags or remote configuration systems.

  • Strong intuition for AI UX patterns and user trust considerations.

 

Outcomes

  • Stable, smooth, and reliable real-world use iOS applications.

  • Performance is optimized: responsive, low-latency, and efficient on memory and CPU.

  • Production issues are detected early, monitored effectively, and resolved with clear root-cause analysis.

 

Tech Stack

  • Swift

  • SPM

  • SwiftUI

  • SQL / noSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

 

How We Work

Understanding is non-negotiable

Understanding leads to believing. Believing leads to winning.

If it's on you, it's in your control.

True ownership sounds harsh until you feel how liberating it is. If every problem is yours, you stop spending energy on who to blame and start spending it on how to fix it. Effective leaders default to 'it's on me'. Not out of guilt, but out of agency.

Conflict is a gift

Honesty is an expression of care.

Singular Photonics is a fast-growing fabless semiconductor start-up, developing Single-Photon Avalanche Diode (SPAD) sensors that bring advanced computation directly into imaging. Based at Orchard Brae House in Edinburgh, we are a close-knit team at the forefront of the photonics revolution.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer to take a leading role in developing the Software Development Kit (SDK) for our SPAD sensors and cameras. You will build the interfaces that let customers configure our hardware, stream sensor data and turn single-photon measurements into results, supporting applications from early prototyping through to production. This role includes developing, documenting, and maintaining code for key sensor operations in various client languages. You will work closely with our hardware, firmware and applications engineers.

Key Responsibilities

  • SDK Development: Design, build and maintain the SDK and its client-language bindings
  • Sensor Configuration: Implement functions to query and set up sensor configurations.
  • Firmware Integration: Integrate and maintain communication with sensor firmware over Verilog, working alongside our firmware engineers.
  • Data Management: Read, buffer and stream high-rate sensor data efficiently, keeping up with the throughput single-photon imaging generates.
  • Data Processing: Develop algorithms for fluorescence lifetime, Raman spectra, diffuse correlation spectroscopy and time-of-flight data
  • Visualisation & Signal Processing: Create tools for visualising sensor output and multi-dimensional data.
  • API Integration: Expand SDK capabilities with partner APIs.
  • Cross-Platform Development: Ensure compatibility across Windows and Linux.
  • Cloud Integration: Enable cloud-based data processing and management.
  • Quality, Testing & Documentation: Write the tests, documentation and release notes that go with production software, and help shape our development and release process as the team grows.

Experience & Skills

  • A minimum of three years’ experience designing and maintaining production software, including ownership of code through to release.
  • Strong programming skills in [C++ or a comparable systems language], and comfortable moving between application-level and lower-level code.
  • Experience working with hardware or sensor interfaces, and methodical debugging across the hardware and software boundary.
  • Experience with Git and a collaborative development workflow including code review.
  • Clear technical writing - you will be documenting an API that customers depend on.
  • Comfortable in a small company where priorities shift and everyone pitches in.
  • Experience building or maintaining an SDK, library or public API used by third parties.
  • Experience with single-photon detection, TCSPC, LiDAR or time-of-flight systems desirable
  • Signal processing, or algorithm work on high-rate or multi-dimensional data.
  • Python binding frameworks
  • GPU or parallel processing experience.

Educational Background

  • HNC/HND or undergraduate degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Key Attributes & Behaviours

  • Strategic thinker with a pragmatic, execution-focused mindset.
  • Pragmatic judgement about when code is good enough to ship, and when it is not.
  • Methodical debugger, comfortable when the problem could be in the software, the firmware or the hardware.
  • Works well with all stakeholders who are not software specialists.
  • Takes ownership end to end, from first design discussion to supporting a user
  • Resilient and adaptable, and committed to high standards.

This position offers a rare opportunity to own the software that customers use to get results from SPAD sensor technology. You will be a key member of a small, ambitious team, building something from the ground up and seeing the direct impact of your work as the company scales.

Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The Role

As an AI Transformation Strategist, you'll work directly with our most strategic customers to understand their objectives and key challenges, identify high-impact AI opportunities, and translate them into measurable business value.

You'll be building AI solutions on Omnea's procurement automation platform, combining the structured data flowing through requests, approvals, contracts, and supplier records with AI. Omnea gives AI the operational context of how a business actually buys, so it can move past answering questions and start taking action inside procurement itself: routing requests, flagging risk, drafting contract terms, negotiating with suppliers. There is no AI without that context.

You'll prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to executives, and ensure successful implementation, adoption, and value realisation, growing Omnea's footprint at those customers as you go.

This customer-facing role is ideal for people who enjoy working directly with customers and turning complex business challenges into practical AI solutions. The focus is on problem framing, solution design, and business impact rather than pure implementation. While you will prototype AI solutions, the primary goal is to deliver meaningful business value to customers.

  • Identify High-Impact AI Opportunities: Work closely with enterprise customers to understand their strategic priorities and operational challenges, identifying where AI can deliver measurable business value.

  • Judgment on business impact matters more than raw build speed: which use case actually moves the metric the customer cares about, and which is just an impressive demo.

title: Account Manager Lille
description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Pourquoi Deliveroo ?

Nous transformons la façon dont le monde mange et fait ses courses en rendant leur accès plus pratique et agréable. Nous connectons les consommateurs, les restaurants, les magasins et les cyclistes. Nous donnons à chaque personne la possibilité d'acheter ce qu'elles veulent, comme elles le veulent, quand elles le veulent et où elles le veulent.

Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie, à l'avant-garde d'un secteur qui connaît une des expansions les plus rapides au monde. Nous avançons rapidement, valorisons l'autonomie, et sommes toujours en recherche de nouvelles idées et de personnes talentueuses pour nous rejoindre!

Le rôle est basé à Lille (France).

Tes principales missions :  

  • Gérer un portefeuille de restaurants clés sur des zones matures, où l'expertise et l'attention au détail font toute la différence.
  • Développer des partenariats privilégiés et durables en devenant le point de contact expert de votre zone et en mettant à profit vos connaissances Food Tech.
  • Optimiser la performance de vos comptes grâce à un accompagnement personnalisé, construit sur le long terme et nourri par la data.
  • Analyser les résultats de vos restaurants, identifier les leviers d'amélioration et recommander des actions concrètes à votre manager tout en restant agile et ouvert à la nouveauté.
  • Proposer et mettre en place des campagnes marketing et promotionnelles ciblées pour booster l'attractivité de vos restaurants partenaires.
  • Suivre de près le déroulé des opérations afin de garantir la meilleure expérience restaurant et client possible.

Ton expérience et tes qualités :

  • Tu as déjà 2 à 3 ans d'expérience sur un rôle similaire où la gestion d'un portefeuille de partenaires était centrale à ta mission.
  • Tu sais négocier et anticiper les discussions commerciales tout en gardant à l'esprit les valeurs de Deliveroo.
  • Tu sais garder le contrôle de ton portefeuille, identifier les nouvelles tendances du marché et partager du feedback utile à tes partenaires ainsi qu'à ton manager.
  • Le terrain est un lieu où tu te sens à ta place : tu sais construire des relations de confiance avec tes partenaires tout en gardant un œil attentif sur la concurrence.
  • Tu sais te montrer proactif, analyser les résultats de tes actions et proposer des recommandations concrètes à ton manager.
  • Tu travailles de manière autonome tout en gardant le cap fixé, sais t'approprier des objectifs précis et mets tout en œuvre pour les atteindre.
  • Tu sais concevoir des actions spécifiques, adaptées à la fois aux besoins de tes partenaires et à la stratégie définie par ton manager.
  • Tu sais identifier, comprendre et analyser les données de performance (commerciales et opérationnelles) pour garantir un niveau de service irréprochable.
  • Tu sais t'exprimer en anglais (à l'oral comme à l'écrit)
  • Tu arrives à convaincre tout en construisant des relations commerciales solides, durables, où Deliveroo devient le partenaire de choix
  • Et si tu cherches un poste où tu travailles en full remote depuis Lille, tout en gardant un lien fort avec le terrain et les équipes, alors c'est peut‑être le rôle qu'il te faut !

La vie chez Deliveroo

Notre équipe est en forte croissance, notre impact très important, et nous cherchons à répondre aux questions les plus stimulantes du moment. Nous progressons rapidement, nous explorons toujours de nouvelles idées et nous sommes très transparents quant aux décisions que nous prenons et à ce qui motive nos choix.

Il y a tellement de questions que nous souhaitons résoudre, et encore plus que nous n'avons pas encore rencontrées. Comment les données et la technologie peuvent-elles aider les restaurants à développer leur activité à mesure que les habitudes des consommateurs évoluent ? Comment pouvons-nous prédire ce qu'une personne souhaitera pour dîner avant même que l'idée ne lui vienne à l'esprit ? Chez Deliveroo, ces questions ne sont que quelques-uns des défis ambitieux auxquels nous nous efforçons de répondre – et il n'y a aucun projet qui ne peut pas devenir le vôtre. Aucune solution n'appartient à une équipe en particulier, ce qui vous ouvre d'extraordinaires possibilités en termes de développement et d'impact personnel.

Avantages et diversité

À compétences égales, ce poste est ouvert aux travailleurs et travailleuses en situation de handicap ou assimilés au sens de l'article L5212-13 du Code du travail. Deliveroo s'engage en faveur de la diversité, l'égalité professionnelle, l'emploi des personnes en situation de handicap.

Deliveroo France valorise la diversité sans discrimination de genre, race, sexualité, religion ou préférences personnelles. Avec un score de 99/100 à l'Indice de l'Égalité Hommes-Femmes 2023, nous sommes engagés envers l'égalité des chances. Rejoignez-nous avec votre passion pour la nourriture dans une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!
